`README.md`:

```md
<p align="center">
  <img src="docs/logo.svg" width="128" height="128" alt="Questkeeper logo">
</p>

<h1 align="center">Questkeeper</h1>

<p align="center">
  An unofficial Windows companion for AdventureQuest Worlds players. It reads the game's own network traffic on your
  machine while you play and shows your character, reputation and inventory in one place — read-only,
  nothing sent anywhere.
</p>

<p align="center">
  <a href="https://github.com/agvmdsa/QuestKeeper/releases/latest"><img src="docs/download-windows.svg" width="368" alt="Download the latest Questkeeper for Windows"></a>
</p>

<p align="center">
  <sub>Self-contained single file · SHA-256 checksum next to every release · <a href="#install">how to install</a></sub>
</p>

<p align="center">
  <a href="https://github.com/agvmdsa/QuestKeeper/actions/workflows/ci.yml"><img src="https://github.com/agvmdsa/QuestKeeper/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main" alt="CI status of the main branch"></a>
</p>

## Why

Seeing what you own, your faction ranks and what is missing for the next rank means clicking through the game and the Wiki. Questkeeper listens to the data the game already sends to your own computer and shows it in one screen while you play.

- **Read-only.** It never sends anything to the game and never acts for you.
- **One screen.** Your character, your factions (closest to the next rank first) and the Hard Farms list, with what you own marked from your captured inventory.
- **Local.** Everything is saved on your computer. **Forget my data** (in **Settings**) removes it. No telemetry.

## Install

You need 64-bit Windows and [Npcap](https://npcap.com/), which you install yourself from its own site: its license does not allow other programs to bundle it. Npcap is free for personal use on up to five computers.

1. Download `Questkeeper-Setup-vX.Y.Z.exe` from the [latest release](https://github.com/agvmdsa/QuestKeeper/releases/latest) and run it. It has a page that tells you whether Npcap is installed and opens the official download page if it is not.
2. Start Questkeeper from the Start menu. Windows asks for administrator rights each time, because the capture driver needs them.
3. The builds are not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn you: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, if you trust the file.
4. Optional: compare the download with `SHA256SUMS.txt` (`Get-FileHash .\Questkeeper-Setup-vX.Y.Z.exe -Algorithm SHA256` in PowerShell).

No installer? Download `Questkeeper-vX.Y.Z-win-x64.zip` instead, extract it anywhere and run `Questkeeper.exe`. Nothing else is needed but Npcap.

Your data, logs and crash reports live in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\AqwCompanion`; delete that folder to remove everything the app stored. Uninstalling asks whether to remove it too.

## Using it

Open the app, then open the game launcher and log in. The capture starts by itself and has to be listening before the login, because the game sends your data only once, during it. Your character appears on its own.

- **Character chip** (top bar): switch between characters when several are logged in, for example from another launcher or client.
- **Hard Farms:** press **Update from the Wiki** in its card; the list is imported on your click and never bundled (CC BY-SA 3.0).
- **Settings** (the gear): **Start with Windows** (opens the app in the notification area when you sign in), debug mode, the privacy text, **Forget my data**, credits.
- **Debug mode** (Settings, Ctrl+Shift+D or the tray menu): a second window with the capture controls, the capture numbers and the diagnostics export. Start there if nothing appears.
- **Tray icon:** closing the window hides it and the capture keeps listening. **Exit** in the tray menu really closes the app.

If you open the app while already logged in to the game, it shows the data saved from your last session and says so; switching server or logging in again sends the login again.

## What it reads

From the server's messages only: the character name and level, experience, gold, AC, class points, days played, membership days, slots, boosts, faction reputation, and each owned item (name, type, quantity, level, flags). It never reads or keeps your e-mail, IP address, password, user or character ids, or anything about other players. It listens only to the game's TCP ports 5588 to 5594, and drops the client-to-server side, where the login travels, before looking at it.

After the login it follows a few of your own plain events: gold and experience gained, items picked up or sold, and class points. The last kill is shown on the character strip.

- Not tracked yet: buying, quest rewards, reputation gains, level-ups, trades and bank moves. The numbers can drift from the game until you log in again.
- The app assumes the gold and experience events carry the amount gained. Kill a monster and compare **Last kill** with what the game showed; if they differ, do not trust the numbers.
- The bank, quests and achievements are not read. Class points of owned classes are not captured, so Hard Farms matches classes by name.
- Tested on a real Windows machine by the author only. The tray icon, Start with Windows and other setups may behave differently.

## Build from source

You need the [.NET 10 SDK](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download) (the exact version is in `global.json`).

```sh
dotnet build AqwCompanion.slnx -c Release   # build everything
dotnet test AqwCompanion.slnx -c Release    # unit tests, the architecture tests and the headless UI tests
dotnet run --project src/AqwCompanion.App   # run the app (the capture needs Windows, Npcap and an elevated terminal)
```

A `vX.Y.Z` tag runs `.github/workflows/release.yml`: tests, a self-contained single-file `win-x64` publish, and a zip with its `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The version comes from the tag (MinVer).

## Not affiliated

Questkeeper is an unofficial fan project. It is not made by, endorsed by or connected to Artix Entertainment. AdventureQuest Worlds and its content belong to their owners.

```

`installer/Questkeeper.iss`:

```iss
; Questkeeper installer (Inno Setup 6).
;
; Built by .github/workflows/release.yml after the single-file publish, with the version from the tag:
;   iscc /DMyAppVersion=0.2.0 /DMyAppVersionLabel=0.2.0 installer\Questkeeper.iss
; The publish folder (out\publish) holds Questkeeper.exe, renamed from AqwCompanion.exe by the workflow.
;
; Npcap is NOT bundled and NOT downloaded here: its license forbids redistribution without the Nmap Project's permission.
; The installer only checks for it (the same two files the app checks) and sends the player to the official download page.

#ifndef MyAppVersion
  #define MyAppVersion "0.0.0"
#endif
#ifndef MyAppVersionLabel
  #define MyAppVersionLabel MyAppVersion
#endif
#define MyAppName "Questkeeper"
#define MyAppExe "Questkeeper.exe"
#define MyAppUrl "https://github.com/agvmdsa/QuestKeeper"
#define NpcapUrl "https://npcap.com/#download"
; The folder that already holds the settings and saved data of earlier versions (the assembly kept its first name).
#define MyDataFolder "AqwCompanion"

[Setup]
; Never change this id: it is how Windows knows later versions replace this one.
AppId={{6F3C1A52-8B7E-4D0A-9C41-2E5D7A90B1C3}
AppName={#MyAppName}
AppVersion={#MyAppVersionLabel}
VersionInfoVersion={#MyAppVersion}
AppPublisher=agvmdsa
AppPublisherURL={#MyAppUrl}
AppSupportURL={#MyAppUrl}/issues
AppUpdatesURL={#MyAppUrl}/releases
DefaultDirName={autopf}\{#MyAppName}
DefaultGroupName={#MyAppName}
DisableProgramGroupPage=yes
; The app asks for administrator rights at every start (the capture driver needs them), so the installer does too.
PrivilegesRequired=admin
ArchitecturesAllowed=x64compatible
ArchitecturesInstallIn64BitMode=x64compatible
OutputDir=..\dist
OutputBaseFilename=Questkeeper-Setup-v{#MyAppVersionLabel}
SetupIconFile=..\src\AqwCompanion.App\Assets\app.ico
UninstallDisplayIcon={app}\{#MyAppExe}
Compression=lzma2
SolidCompression=yes
WizardStyle=modern
; The app hides in the notification area when its window is closed, so ask the player to exit it from there before updating.
AppMutex=Local\{#MyDataFolder}
CloseApplications=no

[Languages]
Name: "english"; MessagesFile: "compiler:Default.isl"

[Tasks]
Name: "desktopicon"; Description: "Create a desktop shortcut"; GroupDescription: "Shortcuts:"; Flags: unchecked

[Files]
Source: "..\out\publish\*"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion recursesubdirs createallsubdirs

[Icons]
Name: "{group}\{#MyAppName}"; Filename: "{app}\{#MyAppExe}"
Name: "{group}\Uninstall {#MyAppName}"; Filename: "{uninstallexe}"
Name: "{autodesktop}\{#MyAppName}"; Filename: "{app}\{#MyAppExe}"; Tasks: desktopicon

[Run]
; Only offered when Npcap is missing; the player decides by leaving the box checked or not.
Filename: "{#NpcapUrl}"; Description: "Open the Npcap download page (needed to read the game data)"; Flags: shellexec postinstall skipifsilent; Check: not NpcapInstalled
; shellexec: the app asks for administrator rights, and only ShellExecute can show that prompt (CreateProcess fails with code 740).
Filename: "{app}\{#MyAppExe}"; Description: "Start {#MyAppName}"; Flags: shellexec nowait postinstall skipifsilent

[UninstallRun]
; "Start with Windows" in the app's settings creates this scheduled task.
Filename: "{sys}\schtasks.exe"; Parameters: "/Delete /TN ""{#MyAppName}"" /F"; Flags: runhidden; RunOnceId: "RemoveQuestkeeperTask"

[Code]
var
  NpcapPage: TWizardPage;
  NpcapStatus: TNewStaticText;
  NpcapOpenButton: TNewButton;
  NpcapCheckButton: TNewButton;

// The same two files the app looks for.
function NpcapInstalled: Boolean;
begin
  Result := FileExists(ExpandConstant('{sys}\Npcap\wpcap.dll')) or FileExists(ExpandConstant('{sys}\wpcap.dll'));
end;

procedure RefreshNpcap;
begin
  if NpcapInstalled then
  begin
    NpcapStatus.Caption := 'Npcap is installed. Questkeeper can read the game data.';
    NpcapOpenButton.Visible := False;
    NpcapCheckButton.Visible := False;
  end
  else
  begin
    NpcapStatus.Caption := 'Npcap was not found on this computer. You can finish this setup now and install Npcap afterwards, ' +
      'but Questkeeper shows nothing until it is installed.';
    NpcapOpenButton.Visible := True;
    NpcapCheckButton.Visible := True;
  end;
end;

procedure OpenNpcapPage(Sender: TObject);
var
  ErrorCode: Integer;
begin
  ShellExec('open', '{#NpcapUrl}', '', '', SW_SHOWNORMAL, ewNoWait, ErrorCode);
end;

procedure CheckNpcapAgain(Sender: TObject);
begin
  RefreshNpcap;
end;

procedure InitializeWizard;
var
  Intro: TNewStaticText;
begin
  NpcapPage := CreateCustomPage(wpSelectDir, 'Npcap',
    'Questkeeper reads the game data with the Npcap packet capture driver.');

  Intro := TNewStaticText.Create(NpcapPage);
  Intro.Parent := NpcapPage.Surface;
  Intro.WordWrap := True;
  Intro.AutoSize := False;
  Intro.Left := 0;
  Intro.Top := 0;
  Intro.Width := NpcapPage.SurfaceWidth;
  Intro.Height := ScaleY(60);
  Intro.Caption :=
    'Npcap is a separate program with its own license, so it is not included in this setup. ' +
    'You install it yourself from the official site: it is free for personal use on up to five computers.';

  NpcapStatus := TNewStaticText.Create(NpcapPage);
  NpcapStatus.Parent := NpcapPage.Surface;
  NpcapStatus.WordWrap := True;
  NpcapStatus.AutoSize := False;
  NpcapStatus.Left := 0;
  NpcapStatus.Top := Intro.Top + Intro.Height + ScaleY(8);
  NpcapStatus.Width := NpcapPage.SurfaceWidth;
  NpcapStatus.Height := ScaleY(48);
  NpcapStatus.Font.Style := [fsBold];

  NpcapOpenButton := TNewButton.Create(NpcapPage);
  NpcapOpenButton.Parent := NpcapPage.Surface;
  NpcapOpenButton.Left := 0;
  NpcapOpenButton.Top := NpcapStatus.Top + NpcapStatus.Height + ScaleY(8);
  NpcapOpenButton.Width := ScaleX(200);
  NpcapOpenButton.Height := ScaleY(26);
  NpcapOpenButton.Caption := 'Open the Npcap download page';
  NpcapOpenButton.OnClick := @OpenNpcapPage;

  NpcapCheckButton := TNewButton.Create(NpcapPage);
  NpcapCheckButton.Parent := NpcapPage.Surface;
  NpcapCheckButton.Left := NpcapOpenButton.Left + NpcapOpenButton.Width + ScaleX(8);
  NpcapCheckButton.Top := NpcapOpenButton.Top;
  NpcapCheckButton.Width := ScaleX(120);
  NpcapCheckButton.Height := ScaleY(26);
  NpcapCheckButton.Caption := 'Check again';
  NpcapCheckButton.OnClick := @CheckNpcapAgain;
end;

procedure CurPageChanged(CurPageID: Integer);
begin
  if CurPageID = NpcapPage.ID then
    RefreshNpcap;
end;

procedure CurUninstallStepChanged(CurUninstallStep: TUninstallStep);
var
  DataDir: String;
begin
  if CurUninstallStep = usPostUninstall then
  begin
    DataDir := ExpandConstant('{localappdata}\{#MyDataFolder}');
    if (not UninstallSilent) and DirExists(DataDir) then
      if MsgBox('Also remove what Questkeeper saved on this computer (settings, saved characters, logs)?',
        mbConfirmation, MB_YESNO or MB_DEFBUTTON2) = IDYES then
        DelTree(DataDir, True, True, True);
  end;
end;

`src/AqwCompanion.App/App.axaml.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.GameData;
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Elevation;
using AqwCompanion.App.Shell;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Controls.ApplicationLifetimes;
using Avalonia.Markup.Xaml;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace AqwCompanion.App;

public partial class CompanionApp : Application
{
    private TrayController? _tray;

    /// <summary>Brings the main window to the front; used when a second launch signals this running app. UI thread only.</summary>
    public void OpenMainWindow() => _tray?.Open();

    public override void Initialize() => AvaloniaXamlLoader.Load(this);

    public override void OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted()
    {
        if (ApplicationLifetime is IClassicDesktopStyleApplicationLifetime desktop)
        {
            var services = CompositionRoot.Build(AppPaths.ForCurrentUser(AppInfo.ExeName, StartupArguments.TryGetDataRoot(desktop.Args ?? [])));
            var main = services.GetRequiredService<MainViewModel>();
            var window = new MainWindow { DataContext = main };
            // Started by the sign-in task, the app waits in the notification area; its window opens from the tray icon.
            if (!StartupArguments.IsBackground(desktop.Args ?? []))
            {
                desktop.MainWindow = window;
            }

            // Closing the window hides it to the notification area; only Exit (or an OS shutdown) ends the app.
            desktop.ShutdownMode = ShutdownMode.OnExplicitShutdown;
            services.GetRequiredService<AvaloniaMainWindowHost>().Attach(window);
            var tray = services.GetRequiredService<TrayController>();
            window.KeepInTray(tray);
            _tray = tray;
            var trayIcon = new TrayIconSetup(tray);
            TrayIcon.SetIcons(this, [trayIcon.Icon]);
            _ = main.HardFarms.RestoreAsync();
            main.Debug.Start();
            var capture = services.GetRequiredService<CaptureSession>();
            _ = capture.RestoreAsync();
            _ = capture.StartAsync();
            desktop.Exit += (_, _) =>
            {
                trayIcon.Dispose();
                services.Dispose();
            };
        }

        base.OnFrameworkInitializationCompleted();
    }
}

using System.Reflection;

namespace AqwCompanion.App;

public static class AppInfo
{
    private static readonly Assembly Assembly = typeof(AppInfo).Assembly;

    public static string ProductName { get; } =
        Assembly.GetCustomAttribute<AssemblyProductAttribute>()?.Product ?? "Questkeeper";

    public static string Version { get; } =
        Assembly.GetCustomAttribute<AssemblyInformationalVersionAttribute>()?.InformationalVersion ?? "0.0.0";

    public static string ExeName { get; } = Assembly.GetName().Name ?? "AqwCompanion";
}

`src/AqwCompanion.App/AppPaths.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.App;

public sealed record AppPaths(string Root)
{
    public string LogDirectory => Path.Combine(Root, "logs");
    public string CrashDirectory => Path.Combine(Root, "crashes");
    public string ExportDirectory => Path.Combine(Root, "exports");
    public string DataDirectory => Path.Combine(Root, "data");
    public string ReputationDirectory => Path.Combine(Root, "reputation");
    public string SettingsPath => Path.Combine(Root, "settings.json");
    public string DatabasePath => Path.Combine(DataDirectory, "companion.db");

    /// <summary>The per-user root, or <paramref name="dataRoot"/> when it names an existing directory (an elevated relaunch).</summary>
    public static AppPaths ForCurrentUser(string appName, string? dataRoot = null) =>
        dataRoot is not null && Directory.Exists(dataRoot)
            ? new(dataRoot)
            : new(Path.Combine(Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.LocalApplicationData), appName));
}

`src/AqwCompanion.App/CompositionRoot.cs`:

```cs
using System.Net;
using AqwCompanion.App.Debug;
using AqwCompanion.App.Diagnostics;
using AqwCompanion.App.GameData;
using AqwCompanion.App.HardFarms;
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure;
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.AutoStart;
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Elevation;
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using AqwCompanion.App.Inventory;
using AqwCompanion.App.Settings;
using AqwCompanion.App.Shell;
using AqwCompanion.Capture;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Diagnostics;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Forgetting;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Persistence;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;
using Avalonia.Threading;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Serilog;

namespace AqwCompanion.App;

public static class CompositionRoot
{
    public static ServiceProvider Build(AppPaths paths)
    {
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        services.AddLogging(builder => builder.AddSerilog(dispose: false));
        services.AddSingleton(paths);
        services.AddSingleton(_ => new SnapshotRedactor());
        services.AddSingleton<DiagnosticsExporter>();
        // The wiki fetcher applies its own deadline per call, so the client has none.
        services.AddSingleton<IWikiPageFetcher>(sp => new WikiPageFetcher(
            CreateHttpClient(System.Threading.Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan), AppInfo.Version, sp.GetRequiredService<ILogger<WikiPageFetcher>>()));
        services.AddSingleton(TimeProvider.System);
        services.AddSingleton<IStoredDataStore>(sp => new LiteDbStoredDataStore(sp.GetRequiredService<AppPaths>().DatabasePath));
        services.AddSingleton(sp => new StoredData(
            sp.GetRequiredService<IStoredDataStore>(),
            StoredKeys.Obsolete,
            (operation, exceptionTypeName) => Log.Error("Stored data {SafeOperation} failed: {ExceptionType}", operation, exceptionTypeName)));
        services.AddSingleton<IDelay, TaskDelay>();
        services.AddSingleton<IHardFarmStore, HardFarmStore>();
        services.AddSingleton<IHardFarmSync>(sp => new HardFarmSync(
            sp.GetRequiredService<IWikiPageFetcher>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<IHardFarmStore>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<IDelay>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<TimeProvider>()));
        services.AddSingleton<IUrlLauncher, ProcessUrlLauncher>();
        services.AddSingleton(sp => new HardFarmsViewModel(
            sp.GetRequiredService<IHardFarmStore>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<IHardFarmSync>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<IActiveInventory>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<IUrlLauncher>(),
            OnUiThread));
        services.AddSingleton<IGameDataStore, GameDataStore>();
        services.AddSingleton<IProcessElevation, WindowsProcessElevation>();
        services.AddSingleton<IApplicationExit, AvaloniaApplicationExit>();
        services.AddSingleton(sp => new CaptureSession(
            () => OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? new LivePacketSource() : new NullPacketSource(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<IProcessElevation>(),
            NpcapAvailability.Check,
            OperatingSystem.IsWindows,
            sp.GetRequiredService<IGameDataStore>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<IDelay>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<TimeProvider>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<IApplicationExit>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<AppPaths>()));
        services.AddSingleton<AvaloniaMainWindowHost>();
        services.AddSingleton<IMainWindowHost>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<AvaloniaMainWindowHost>());
        services.AddSingleton(sp => new TrayController(
            sp.GetRequiredService<CaptureSession>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<IMainWindowHost>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<IApplicationExit>(),
            debug: sp.GetRequiredService<DebugModeController>()));
        services.AddSingleton<IActiveInventory, ActiveInventory>();
        services.AddSingleton(sp => new GameDataViewModel(sp.GetRequiredService<CaptureSession>(), OnUiThread));
        services.AddSingleton<IAppSettingsStore>(sp => new JsonAppSettingsStore(sp.GetRequiredService<AppPaths>().SettingsPath));
        services.AddSingleton<IProcessRunner, ProcessRunner>();
        services.AddSingleton<IAutoStart>(sp => new ScheduledTaskAutoStart(
            sp.GetRequiredService<IProcessRunner>(), Environment.ProcessPath, Environment.UserDomainName + "\\" + Environment.UserName, OperatingSystem.IsWindows));
        services.AddSingleton(sp => new SettingsViewModel(
            sp.GetRequiredService<IAppSettingsStore>(), sp.GetRequiredService<ForgetCoordinator>(), sp.GetRequiredService<IAutoStart>()));
        services.AddSingleton<ISettingsDialog, AvaloniaSettingsDialog>();
        services.AddSingleton<IDebugWindowHost, AvaloniaDebugWindowHost>();
        services.AddSingleton<DebugModeController>();
        services.AddSingleton(sp => new ForgetCoordinator(
            () => sp.GetRequiredService<StoredData>().Clear(),
            () =>
            [
                sp.GetRequiredService<HardFarmsViewModel>(),
                new LegacyReputationFolder(sp.GetRequiredService<AppPaths>()),
                sp.GetRequiredService<CaptureSession>(),
            ]));
        services.AddSingleton<DiagnosticsViewModel>();
        services.AddSingleton<MainViewModel>();

        return services.BuildServiceProvider(new ServiceProviderOptions
        {
            ValidateOnBuild = true,
            ValidateScopes = true,
        });
    }

    // Runs the action at once on the UI thread, otherwise posts it there; for view models fed from background threads.
    private static void OnUiThread(Action action)
    {
        if (Dispatcher.UIThread.CheckAccess())
        {
            action();
        }
        else
        {
            Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(action);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>One long-lived client: no cookies, no automatic redirects (the fetcher validates each hop).</summary>
    private static HttpClient CreateHttpClient(TimeSpan timeout) =>
        new(new SocketsHttpHandler
        {
            AllowAutoRedirect = false,
            UseCookies = false,
            AutomaticDecompression = DecompressionMethods.All,
        })
        {
            Timeout = timeout,
        };
}

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Dashboard/DashboardView.axaml`:

```axaml
<UserControl xmlns="https://github.com/avaloniaui"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Debug/AvaloniaDebugWindowHost.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Diagnostics;
using AqwCompanion.App.GameData;
using AqwCompanion.App.HardFarms;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Debug;

/// <summary>Opens <see cref="DebugWindow"/> as an ordinary window next to the main one; showing it twice brings the open one forward.</summary>
public sealed class AvaloniaDebugWindowHost(GameDataViewModel gameData, DiagnosticsViewModel diagnostics, HardFarmsViewModel hardFarms) : IDebugWindowHost
{
    private DebugWindow? _window;
    private bool _closingByCode;

    public event EventHandler? Closed;

    public void Show()
    {
        if (_window is { } open)
        {
            open.Activate();
            return;
        }

        var window = new DebugWindow { DataContext = new DebugViewModel(gameData, diagnostics, hardFarms) };
        window.Closed += (_, _) =>
        {
            _window = null;
            if (!_closingByCode)
            {
                Closed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
            }
        };
        _window = window;
        window.Show();
    }

    public void Close()
    {
        if (_window is not { } window)
        {
            return;
        }

        _closingByCode = true;
        try
        {
            window.Close();
        }
        finally
        {
            _closingByCode = false;
        }
    }
}

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Debug/DebugModeController.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Settings;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Debug;

/// <summary>Keeps the debug window and the saved debug mode in step: the switch opens it, closing it turns the switch off.</summary>
public sealed class DebugModeController
{
    private readonly SettingsViewModel _settings;
    private readonly IDebugWindowHost _host;

    public DebugModeController(SettingsViewModel settings, IDebugWindowHost host)
    {
        _settings = settings;
        _host = host;
        settings.DebugModeChanged += (_, _) => Apply();
        host.Closed += (_, _) => _settings.DebugMode = false;
    }

    /// <summary>Opens the window when the saved mode is on; call once the main window exists.</summary>
    public void Start() => Apply();

    /// <summary>Turns the debug mode on or off, as the shortcut and the tray menu do.</summary>
    public void Toggle() => _settings.DebugMode = !_settings.DebugMode;

    private void Apply()
    {
        if (_settings.DebugMode)
        {
            _host.Show();
        }
        else
        {
            _host.Close();
        }
    }
}

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Diagnostics/DiagnosticsViewModel.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Diagnostics;
using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
using Serilog;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Diagnostics;

public partial class DiagnosticsViewModel(AppPaths paths, DiagnosticsExporter exporter) : ObservableObject
{
    [ObservableProperty]
    private string _status = string.Empty;

    public string LogDirectory => paths.LogDirectory;

    [RelayCommand]
    private void Export()
    {
        try
        {
            var output = Path.Combine(paths.ExportDirectory, $"diagnostics-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd-HHmmss}.zip");
            exporter.Export(new DiagnosticsRequest(
                paths.LogDirectory, AppInfo.Version, output));
            Status = $"Exported to {output}";
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
        {
            Log.Error(ex, "Diagnostics export failed");
            Status = $"Export failed ({ex.GetType().Name}).";
        }
    }
}

`src/AqwCompanion.App/GameData/CaptureFailure.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.App.GameData;

/// <summary>Why a Capture session failed.</summary>
public enum CaptureFailure
{
    None,

    /// <summary>The source ended at once and saw no game traffic, for example because no network device could be opened.</summary>
    NoDevice,

    /// <summary>The source stopped with an error.</summary>
    DriverError,
}

`src/AqwCompanion.App/GameData/CaptureSession.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Elevation;
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure;
using AqwCompanion.Capture;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Forgetting;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.GameData;

/// <summary>
/// One Capture session at a time: checks the system, Npcap and administrator rights, listens through a packet source until it is
/// stopped or the source ends, keeps one snapshot per Character (newest wins) and stores them. It logs nothing that comes
/// from the traffic. State is guarded by a lock; <see cref="Changed"/> is raised outside of it and may come from capture threads.
/// After a login, the live events of the connection replace the Character's snapshot; those updates are saved a few seconds after
/// the last one (through <see cref="IDelay"/>, one pending save at a time) and at once when the session stops.
/// </summary>
public sealed class CaptureSession(
    Func<IPacketSource> sourceFactory,
    IProcessElevation elevation,
    Func<NpcapStatus> npcap,
    Func<bool> isWindows,
    IGameDataStore store,
    IDelay delay,
    TimeProvider clock,
    IApplicationExit exit,
    AppPaths paths) : IForgettable
{
    /// <summary>The most Characters kept; the oldest is dropped first.</summary>
    public const int MaxCharacters = GameDataStore.MaxCharacters;

    /// <summary>How long after the last live update the snapshots are saved.</summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan SaveDelay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);

    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private CaptureState _state;
    private CaptureFailure _failure;
    private readonly HashSet<string> _capturedNames = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private CharacterSnapshot[] _characters = [];
    private CaptureEngine? _engine;
    private IPacketSource? _source;
    private Run? _current;
    private Run? _lastRun;
    private bool _quiesced;
    private bool _forgotten;
    private bool _restoreStarted;
    private int _epoch;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _liveCounts = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private readonly Dictionary<string, DateTimeOffset> _liveAt = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    private bool _dirty;
    private bool _saving;
    private long _saveStamp;
    private CancellationTokenSource? _saveCts;

    /// <summary>Raised on every state change, every captured Character and every live update, never periodically. May come from any thread.</summary>
    public event EventHandler? Changed;

    public CaptureState State
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _state;
            }
        }
    }

    public CaptureFailure Failure
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _failure;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>What the engine has counted so far; zero before the first start.</summary>
    public CaptureCounters Counters
    {
        get
        {
            CaptureEngine? engine;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                engine = _engine;
            }

            return engine?.Counters ?? default;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>How far the server data got so far (counts only); zero before the first start.</summary>
    public CaptureStageCounters Stages
    {
        get
        {
            CaptureEngine? engine;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                engine = _engine;
            }

            return engine?.Stages ?? default;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Why messages were unreadable, which known commands were read and which unknown names were seen (counts only); all zero before the first start.</summary>
    public CaptureDecodeDiagnostics Decoding
    {
        get
        {
            CaptureEngine? engine;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                engine = _engine;
            }

            return engine?.Decoding ?? CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.Empty;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>How the connections went and the shapes of the first unreadable messages (counts and classes only); zero before the first start.</summary>
    public CaptureConnectionDiagnostics Connections
    {
        get
        {
            CaptureEngine? engine;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                engine = _engine;
            }

            return engine?.Connections ?? CaptureConnectionDiagnostics.Empty;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// What the packet source of the current or last run says about itself, read on access: numbers and exception type
    /// names only. Empty before a run, when the source has nothing to say, and after Forgetting.
    /// </summary>
    public string Details
    {
        get
        {
            IPacketSource? source;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                source = _source;
            }

            try
            {
                return (source as ICaptureDiagnostics)?.Describe() ?? string.Empty;
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The numbers of the live reading after the logins; all zero before the first start.</summary>
    public CaptureLiveDiagnostics Live
    {
        get
        {
            CaptureEngine? engine;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                engine = _engine;
            }

            return engine?.Live ?? CaptureLiveDiagnostics.Empty;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>One snapshot per Character name (ignoring case); a newer capture replaces the older one.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<CharacterSnapshot> Characters
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return _characters;
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>True when a Character of this name (ignoring case) was captured during this run of the app, not only restored from storage.</summary>
    public bool IsCapturedThisSession(string name)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _capturedNames.Contains(name);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>True when the Character (ignoring case) has received at least one live update since it was captured.</summary>
    public bool IsLive(string name) => LiveUpdateCount(name) > 0;

    /// <summary>How many live updates the Character (ignoring case) received since it was captured; kept in memory only.</summary>
    public int LiveUpdateCount(string name)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _liveCounts.GetValueOrDefault(name);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>When the Character (ignoring case) received its last live update; null when it received none. Kept in memory only.</summary>
    public DateTimeOffset? LastLiveUpdateUtc(string name)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            return _liveAt.TryGetValue(name, out var at) ? at : null;
        }
    }

    string IForgettable.Name => "Game data";

    /// <summary>Loads the stored Characters once. Ignored after Forgetting or Quiescing started and when Characters already has data.</summary>
    public async Task RestoreAsync()
    {
        int epoch;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_restoreStarted || _quiesced || _forgotten)
            {
                return;
            }

            _restoreStarted = true;
            epoch = _epoch;
        }

        var loaded = await Task.Run(store.Load).ConfigureAwait(false);

        var changed = false;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (epoch == _epoch && !_quiesced && !_forgotten && _characters.Length == 0 && loaded.Count > 0)
            {
                _characters = [.. loaded.Take(MaxCharacters)];
                changed = true;
            }
        }

        if (changed)
        {
            OnChanged();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Runs one session and returns when it ends (stop, end of the source or failure). No-op when already listening or quiesced.</summary>
    public async Task StartAsync()
    {
        var run = Begin();
        if (run is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            await RunAsync(run).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        finally
        {
            run.Finished.TrySetResult();
        }
    }

    private async Task RunAsync(Run run)
    {
        var token = run.Cts.Token;
        var source = Task.Run(() =>
        {
            var packetSource = sourceFactory();
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (_current == run)
                {
                    _source = packetSource;
                }
            }

            return packetSource.RunAsync(run.Engine.Accept, token);
        });
        await Settle(source).ConfigureAwait(false);

        var state = CaptureState.Done;
        var failure = CaptureFailure.None;
        if (source.IsFaulted)
        {
            state = CaptureState.Failed;
            failure = CaptureFailure.DriverError;
        }
        else if (!token.IsCancellationRequested
            && run.Engine.Counters is { SegmentsSeen: 0, CharactersCaptured: 0 })
        {
            state = CaptureState.Failed;
            failure = CaptureFailure.NoDevice;
        }

        var raise = false;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_current == run)
            {
                _current = null;
                _state = state;
                _failure = failure;
                raise = true;
            }
        }

        Cancel(run.Cts);
        run.Cts.Dispose();
        FlushSave();
        if (raise)
        {
            OnChanged();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Ends a listening session; the state becomes Done.</summary>
    public void Stop()
    {
        var changed = EndRun(CaptureState.Done);
        FlushSave();
        if (changed)
        {
            OnChanged();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Stops the session and waits until the running <see cref="StartAsync"/> has finished (the devices are closed) or the
    /// timeout passes, whichever comes first. Never throws and never waits longer than the timeout, even when the source
    /// ignores the cancellation. Does nothing when no session runs.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task StopAndWaitAsync(TimeSpan timeout)
    {
        try
        {
            Stop();
            Task? finished;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                finished = _lastRun?.Finished.Task;
            }

            if (finished is null || finished.IsCompleted)
            {
                return;
            }

            await Task.WhenAny(finished, Task.Delay(timeout)).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // Closing must never fail because of the wait.
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Starts this program again as administrator and closes it when that worked.</summary>
    public bool RelaunchAsAdministrator()
    {
        var started = elevation.TryRelaunchElevated(paths.Root);
        if (started)
        {
            exit.Exit();
        }

        return started;
    }

    void IForgettable.Quiesce()
    {
        bool changed;
        CancellationTokenSource? cts;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _quiesced = true;
            _epoch++;
            changed = EndRunLocked(CaptureState.Done, out cts);
        }

        Cancel(cts);
        FlushSave();
        if (changed)
        {
            OnChanged();
        }
    }

    void IForgettable.Resume()
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _quiesced = false;
        }
    }

    void IForgettable.Forget()
    {
        CancellationTokenSource? cts;
        CancellationTokenSource? saveCts;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _epoch++;
            cts = _current?.Cts;
            _current = null;
            _characters = [];
            _capturedNames.Clear();
            _liveCounts.Clear();
            _liveAt.Clear();
            _dirty = false;
            _saving = false;
            saveCts = _saveCts;
            _saveCts = null;
            _engine = null;
            _source = null;
            _state = CaptureState.Idle;
            _failure = CaptureFailure.None;
            _quiesced = false;
            _forgotten = true;
        }

        Cancel(cts);
        Cancel(saveCts);
        OnChanged();
    }

    // Decides under the lock whether a session starts: an early state ends it at once, otherwise a run is created.
    private Run? Begin()
    {
        Run? run = null;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_quiesced || _state == CaptureState.Listening)
            {
                return null;
            }

            _failure = CaptureFailure.None;
            if (Preflight() is { } early)
            {
                _state = early;
            }
            else
            {
                var engine = new CaptureEngine(clock);
                run = new Run(engine);
                engine.CharacterCaptured += snapshot => OnCaptured(run, snapshot);
                engine.CharacterUpdated += snapshot => OnUpdated(run, snapshot);
                _engine = engine;
                _source = null;
                _current = run;
                _lastRun = run;
                _state = CaptureState.Listening;
            }
        }

        OnChanged();
        return run;
    }

    private CaptureState? Preflight()
    {
        if (!isWindows())
        {
            return CaptureState.NotSupported;
        }

        switch (npcap())
        {
            case NpcapStatus.Missing:
                return CaptureState.NpcapMissing;
            case NpcapStatus.NotSupported:
                return CaptureState.NotSupported;
        }

        return elevation.IsElevated ? null : CaptureState.NeedsAdministrator;
    }

    private void OnCaptured(Run run, CharacterSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_current != run)
            {
                return;
            }

            var list = _characters
                .Where(c => !string.Equals(c.Profile.Name, snapshot.Profile.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                .Append(snapshot)
                .ToList();
            if (list.Count > MaxCharacters)
            {
                list.RemoveRange(0, list.Count - MaxCharacters);
            }

            _characters = [.. list];
            _capturedNames.Add(snapshot.Profile.Name);
            _liveCounts.Remove(snapshot.Profile.Name);
            _liveAt.Remove(snapshot.Profile.Name);
            _dirty = false;
            store.Save(_characters);
        }

        OnChanged();
    }

    // A live event changed the snapshot of a Character: replace it, count it and save it a few seconds after the last one.
    private void OnUpdated(Run run, CharacterSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_current != run)
            {
                return;
            }

            var index = Array.FindIndex(_characters, c => string.Equals(c.Profile.Name, snapshot.Profile.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            if (index < 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            var name = _characters[index].Profile.Name;
            _characters = [.. _characters.Select((c, i) => i == index ? snapshot : c)];
            _liveCounts[name] = _liveCounts.GetValueOrDefault(name) + 1;
            _liveAt[name] = clock.GetUtcNow();
            _dirty = true;
            _saveStamp++;
            if (!_saving)
            {
                _saving = true;
                _saveCts = new CancellationTokenSource();
                var token = _saveCts.Token;
                var epoch = _epoch;
                _ = Task.Run(() => SaveAfterQuietAsync(epoch, token));
            }
        }

        OnChanged();
    }

    // Waits SaveDelay after the last update (more updates while waiting wait again), then saves once. A wait that was cancelled
    // (by a flush or by forgetting) ends without touching anything: whoever cancelled it settled the state.
    private async Task SaveAfterQuietAsync(int epoch, CancellationToken token)
    {
        try
        {
            while (true)
            {
                long stamp;
                lock (_gate)
                {
                    stamp = _saveStamp;
                }

                await delay.DelayAsync(SaveDelay, token).ConfigureAwait(false);
                lock (_gate)
                {
                    if (token.IsCancellationRequested || epoch != _epoch)
                    {
                        return;
                    }

                    if (_saveStamp != stamp)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (_dirty)
                    {
                        _dirty = false;
                        store.Save(_characters);
                    }

                    _saving = false;
                    _saveCts = null;
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                if (!token.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    // The wait itself failed: drop the pending state so the next update starts a new one.
                    _saving = false;
                    _saveCts = null;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Saves the live updates not saved yet at once and ends the pending wait.
    private void FlushSave()
    {
        CancellationTokenSource? cts;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            cts = _saveCts;
            _saveCts = null;
            _saving = false;
            if (_dirty)
            {
                _dirty = false;
                store.Save(_characters);
            }
        }

        Cancel(cts);
    }

    private bool EndRun(CaptureState state)
    {
        bool changed;
        CancellationTokenSource? cts;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            changed = EndRunLocked(state, out cts);
        }

        Cancel(cts);
        return changed;
    }

    // Detaches the current run (its late captures are ignored) and sets the state. The caller cancels the token outside the lock.
    private bool EndRunLocked(CaptureState state, out CancellationTokenSource? cts)
    {
        cts = null;
        if (_state != CaptureState.Listening)
        {
            return false;
        }

        cts = _current?.Cts;
        _current = null;
        _state = state;
        return true;
    }

    private static void Cancel(CancellationTokenSource? cts)
    {
        try
        {
            cts?.Cancel();
        }
        catch (ObjectDisposedException)
        {
        }
    }

    private static async Task Settle(Task task)
    {
        try
        {
            await task.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // How the source ended after the cancel does not change the outcome.
        }
    }

    private void OnChanged() => Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);

    private sealed class Run(CaptureEngine engine)
    {
        public CaptureEngine Engine { get; } = engine;

        public CancellationTokenSource Cts { get; } = new();

        public TaskCompletionSource Finished { get; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    }
}

`src/AqwCompanion.App/GameData/GameDataStore.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Persistence;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Reputation;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.GameData;

/// <summary>
/// Maps the captured Characters to one stored value of plain DTOs and validates it on load. Failures never reach the caller:
/// the stored data module swallows and reports them.
/// </summary>
public sealed class GameDataStore(StoredData data) : IGameDataStore
{
    /// <summary>The most Characters kept.</summary>
    public const int MaxCharacters = 16;

    /// <summary>The most items kept per list (owned items, house items).</summary>
    public const int MaxItems = 5000;

    private const int KnownFlags = 255;

    public sealed record GameDataDto(List<CharacterDto> Characters);

    public sealed record CharacterDto(
        ProfileDto Profile,
        List<FactionDto> Factions,
        List<ItemDto> Items,
        List<ItemDto> HouseItems,
        DateTimeOffset CapturedAtUtc);

    public sealed record ProfileDto(
        string Name,
        int Level,
        long Exp,
        long ExpToLevel,
        long Gold,
        int Coins,
        int ClassPoints,
        int DaysPlayed,
        int BagSlots,
        int BankSlots,
        int HouseSlots,
        int LoadoutSlots,
        bool IsMember,
        int MembershipDays,
        int BoostXp,
        int BoostGold,
        int BoostClassPoints,
        int BoostReputation);

    public sealed record FactionDto(int FactionId, string Name, int Rank, int Rep, int RepToRank, int SpillRep);

    /// <summary>An owned item; <paramref name="CharItemId"/> is 0 in data stored before it existed.</summary>
    public sealed record ItemDto(string Name, string Type, int Quantity, int Stack, int Level, int Flags, int ItemId, int? ClassId, int CharItemId = 0);

    public IReadOnlyList<CharacterSnapshot> Load()
    {
        var stored = data.Load(StoredKeys.GameData);
        if (stored?.Value?.Characters is not { } dtos)
        {
            return [];
        }

        var characters = new List<CharacterSnapshot>();
        var names = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        foreach (var dto in dtos)
        {
            if (characters.Count >= MaxCharacters)
            {
                break;
            }

            if (ToSnapshot(dto) is { } snapshot && names.Add(snapshot.Profile.Name))
            {
                characters.Add(snapshot);
            }
        }

        return characters;
    }

    public void Save(IReadOnlyList<CharacterSnapshot> characters)
    {
        if (characters.Count == 0)
        {
            data.Remove(StoredKeys.GameData);
            return;
        }

        data.Save(
            StoredKeys.GameData,
            new GameDataDto(characters.Select(ToDto).ToList()),
            characters.Max(c => c.CapturedAtUtc));
    }

    private static CharacterDto ToDto(CharacterSnapshot c)
    {
        var p = c.Profile;
        return new CharacterDto(
            new ProfileDto(
                p.Name, p.Level, p.Exp, p.ExpToLevel, p.Gold, p.Coins, p.ClassPoints, p.DaysPlayed, p.BagSlots, p.BankSlots,
                p.HouseSlots, p.LoadoutSlots, p.IsMember, p.MembershipDays, p.BoostXp, p.BoostGold, p.BoostClassPoints, p.BoostReputation),
            c.Factions.Select(f => new FactionDto(f.FactionId, f.Name, f.Rank, f.Rep, f.RepToRank, f.SpillRep)).ToList(),
            c.Items.Select(ToDto).ToList(),
            c.HouseItems.Select(ToDto).ToList(),
            c.CapturedAtUtc);
    }

    private static ItemDto ToDto(OwnedItem i) =>
        new(i.Name, i.Type, i.Quantity, i.Stack, i.Level, (int)i.Flags, i.ItemId, i.ClassId, i.CharItemId);

    private static CharacterSnapshot? ToSnapshot(CharacterDto? dto)
    {
        if (dto?.Profile is not { } p || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.Name)
            || p.Level < 0 || p.Exp < 0 || p.ExpToLevel < 0 || p.Gold < 0 || p.Coins < 0 || p.ClassPoints < 0 || p.DaysPlayed < 0
            || p.BagSlots < 0 || p.BankSlots < 0 || p.HouseSlots < 0 || p.LoadoutSlots < 0 || p.MembershipDays < 0
            || p.BoostXp < 0 || p.BoostGold < 0 || p.BoostClassPoints < 0 || p.BoostReputation < 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var profile = new CharacterProfile(
            p.Name, p.Level, p.Exp, p.ExpToLevel, p.Gold, p.Coins, p.ClassPoints, p.DaysPlayed, p.BagSlots, p.BankSlots,
            p.HouseSlots, p.LoadoutSlots, p.IsMember, p.MembershipDays, p.BoostXp, p.BoostGold, p.BoostClassPoints, p.BoostReputation);
        var factions = (dto.Factions ?? [])
            .Where(f => f is not null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(f.Name)
                && f.FactionId >= 0 && f.Rank >= 0 && f.Rep >= 0 && f.RepToRank >= 0 && f.SpillRep >= 0)
            .DistinctBy(f => f.FactionId)
            .Select(f => new FactionStanding(f.FactionId, f.Name, f.Rank, f.Rep, f.RepToRank, f.SpillRep))
            .ToList();
        return new CharacterSnapshot(profile, factions, ToItems(dto.Items), ToItems(dto.HouseItems), dto.CapturedAtUtc);
    }

    private static List<OwnedItem> ToItems(List<ItemDto>? dtos) =>
        (dtos ?? [])
            .Where(i => i is not null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(i.Name)
                && i.Quantity >= 0 && i.Stack >= 0 && i.Level >= 0 && i.ItemId >= 0 && i.CharItemId >= 0 && i.ClassId is null or >= 0)
            .Take(MaxItems)
            .Select(i => new OwnedItem(i.Name, i.Type ?? string.Empty, i.Quantity, i.Stack, i.Level, (ItemFlags)(i.Flags & KnownFlags), i.ItemId, i.ClassId, i.CharItemId))
            .ToList();
}

using System.Globalization;
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Formatting;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.GameData;

/// <summary>
/// The Game data tab: controls a <see cref="CaptureSession"/> and shows the selected Character's profile, faction standings
/// and items. The session raises its change event from capture threads, so the app passes <c>onUiThread</c> to run the
/// update on the UI thread (without it, inline); a burst of changes queues one update at a time, with no timer. The profile, the
/// standings and the items follow the live updates by themselves, there is no refresh to press for them. It never logs.
/// </summary>
public partial class GameDataViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    public const string TitleText = "Game data";
    public const string StartText = "Start capture";
    public const string StopText = "Stop capture";
    public const string RefreshText = "Refresh numbers";
    public const string RestartText = "Restart as administrator";
    public const string NpcapUrl = "https://npcap.com/";
    public const string IdleText = "Not capturing.";
    public const string NotSupportedText = "Capturing is only available on Windows.";
    public const string NpcapMissingText = "Npcap is not installed. Install it from https://npcap.com/ and press Start capture again.";
    public const string NeedsAdministratorText = "Capturing needs administrator rights.";
    public const string ListeningText = "Waiting for a login. Open the game launcher now.";
    public const string DoneText = "Capture finished.";
    public const string NoDeviceText = "No network device could be opened.";
    public const string DriverErrorText = "The capture driver reported an error.";
    public const string PrivacyText = "It starts by itself when the app opens and listens until you press Stop capture. It reads your login data and your own gold, experience, item and class point events, and never your e-mail address, IP address, password or other players' data.";
    public const string CaptureDetailsText = "Capture details";
    public const string LiveNotTrackedText = "Buying, quests, reputation and level-ups are not tracked yet; log in again to refresh.";
    public const string EarlierSessionHintText = "A game session that started before this app was opened is running. Its data cannot be read until you log in again, for example by switching server.";
    public const string NoCharacterText = "No character yet";
    public const string FooterWaitingText = "Waiting for a login";
    public const string FooterCapturingText = "Capturing";
    public const string EmptyText = "The capture is already listening. Open the game launcher and log in; your data appears here when the login has been read.";

    private readonly Action<Action> _onUiThread;

    public GameDataViewModel(CaptureSession session, Action<Action>? onUiThread = null)
    {
        _session = session;
        _onUiThread = onUiThread ?? (action => action());
        StartCommand = new AsyncRelayCommand(session.StartAsync, () => CanStart);
        StopCommand = new RelayCommand(session.Stop, () => IsListening);
        RestartAsAdministratorCommand = new RelayCommand(() => session.RelaunchAsAdministrator(), () => NeedsAdministrator);
        RefreshCommand = new RelayCommand(RefreshNumbers);
        Refresh();
        session.Changed += (_, _) => QueueRefresh();
    }

    public IAsyncRelayCommand StartCommand { get; }

    public IRelayCommand StopCommand { get; }

    public IRelayCommand RestartAsAdministratorCommand { get; }

    /// <summary>Re-reads the capture numbers once; there is no timer.</summary>
    public IRelayCommand RefreshCommand { get; }

    /// <summary>Raised after the properties updated, when the selected Character's snapshot is another object than before.</summary>
    public event EventHandler? ActiveSnapshotChanged;

    public string StateText { get; private set; } = IdleText;

    /// <summary>A short line for the window footer: waiting, capturing, or the state itself when it needs the player's attention.</summary>
    public string FooterText { get; private set; } = IdleText;

    public string CountersText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>Why messages were unreadable, as numbers only; empty when there is nothing to say.</summary>
    public string DecodingText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public bool HasDecoding => DecodingText.Length > 0;

    /// <summary>How the connections went, as numbers only; empty before anything was seen.</summary>
    public string ConnectionsText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public bool HasConnections => ConnectionsText.Length > 0;

    public string HintText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>The shapes of the first unreadable messages, as sizes and classes only; empty when there are none.</summary>
    public string SamplesText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public string CommandsText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public bool HasCommands => CommandsText.Length > 0;

    /// <summary>The names of commands the capture does not know yet, with counts; empty when there are none.</summary>
    public string OtherNamesText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public bool HasOtherNames => OtherNamesText.Length > 0;

    /// <summary>What the packet source says about its run (numbers and exception type names only), or empty.</summary>
    public string DetailsText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public bool HasDetails => DetailsText.Length > 0;

    public bool IsListening { get; private set; }

    public bool CanStart => !IsListening;

    public bool NeedsAdministrator { get; private set; }

    public bool NpcapMissing { get; private set; }

    public IReadOnlyList<string> CharacterNames { get; private set; } = [];

    public bool HasCharacters => CharacterNames.Count > 0;

    public bool HasOneCharacter => CharacterNames.Count == 1;

    /// <summary>The selected Character's name for the top bar chip, or a waiting text.</summary>
    public string CharacterChipText => _selectedCharacter ?? NoCharacterText;

    /// <summary>The first letter of the selected Character's name for the chip's badge, or "?".</summary>
    public string SelectedCharacterInitial => _selectedCharacter is { Length: > 0 } name ? name[..1].ToUpperInvariant() : "?";

    public bool HasSeveralCharacters => CharacterNames.Count > 1;

    /// <summary>The selected Character's name, or null when there is none; a name that does not exist is ignored.</summary>
    public string? SelectedCharacter
    {
        get => _selectedCharacter;
        set
        {
            if (value is null || string.Equals(value, _selectedCharacter, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return;
            }

            var match = CharacterNames.FirstOrDefault(name => string.Equals(name, value, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            if (match is not null)
            {
                _selectedCharacter = match;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CharacterChipText));
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedCharacterInitial));
                UpdateActive();
            }
        }
    }

    public string ProfileHeadline { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>Says whether the selected Character was captured in this session or saved earlier; empty when there is none.</summary>
    public string CapturedText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public bool HasCapturedText => CapturedText.Length > 0;

    /// <summary>How many live updates the selected Character got and since when, plus what is not tracked; empty when it got none.</summary>
    public string LiveText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public bool HasLiveText => LiveText.Length > 0;

    /// <summary>The gold and exp of the last kill as the capture read them, to compare with the game; empty when there is none.</summary>
    public string LastGainText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public bool HasLastGain => LastGainText.Length > 0;

    public IReadOnlyList<string> ProfileLines { get; private set; } = [];

    /// <summary>The numbers shown across the top of the dashboard; empty when there is no Character.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<ProfileFigure> ProfileFigures { get; private set; } = [];

    public IReadOnlyList<GameFactionRow> Factions { get; private set; } = [];


    /// <summary>The selected Character's snapshot, or null.</summary>
    public CharacterSnapshot? ActiveSnapshot => _active;

    // A burst of session changes (every live event raises one) queues a single refresh: while one is waiting for the UI thread, the
    // others add nothing, because the refresh reads the newest state when it runs.
    private void QueueRefresh()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _refreshQueued, 1) == 1)
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            _onUiThread(() =>
            {
                Volatile.Write(ref _refreshQueued, 0);
                Refresh();
            });
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            Volatile.Write(ref _refreshQueued, 0);
            throw;
        }
    }

    private void Refresh()
    {
        _characters = _session.Characters;
        CharacterNames = [.. _characters.Select(c => c.Profile.Name).OrderBy(name => name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)];

        var state = _session.State;
        IsListening = state == CaptureState.Listening;
        NeedsAdministrator = state == CaptureState.NeedsAdministrator;
        NpcapMissing = state == CaptureState.NpcapMissing;
        StateText = StateTextFor(state, _session.Failure, _session.Counters.CharactersCaptured);
        FooterText = state == CaptureState.Listening
            ? (_session.Counters.CharactersCaptured > 0 ? FooterCapturingText : FooterWaitingText)
            : StateText;
        ReadNumbers();

        _selectedCharacter = ChooseSelection();

        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(StateText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(FooterText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasOneCharacter));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CountersText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(DecodingText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasDecoding));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CommandsText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasCommands));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(OtherNamesText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasOtherNames));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(OtherNamesText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasOtherNames));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HintText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasHint));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ConnectionsText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasConnections));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SamplesText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasSamples));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(DetailsText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasDetails));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsListening));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CanStart));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(NeedsAdministrator));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(NpcapMissing));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CharacterNames));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasCharacters));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasSeveralCharacters));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedCharacter));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CharacterChipText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedCharacterInitial));
        StartCommand.NotifyCanExecuteChanged();
        StopCommand.NotifyCanExecuteChanged();
        RestartAsAdministratorCommand.NotifyCanExecuteChanged();

        UpdateActive();
    }

    private void RefreshNumbers()
    {
        ReadNumbers();
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CountersText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(DecodingText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasDecoding));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CommandsText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasCommands));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HintText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasHint));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ConnectionsText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasConnections));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SamplesText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasSamples));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(DetailsText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasDetails));
    }

    private void ReadNumbers()
    {
        var counters = _session.Counters;
        var stages = _session.Stages;
        CountersText = string.Create(
            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
            $"Segments seen {Format(counters.SegmentsSeen)} · dropped {Format(counters.SegmentsDropped)} · messages read {Format(counters.MessagesDecoded)} · characters captured {Format(counters.CharactersCaptured)} · unreadable {Format(stages.MessagesUnreadable)} · profile parts {Format(stages.ProfilePartsSeen)} · inventory parts {Format(stages.InventoryPartsSeen)}");
        var decoding = _session.Decoding;
        DecodingText = DecodingTextFor(decoding);
        CommandsText = CommandsTextFor(decoding);
        OtherNamesText = OtherNamesTextFor(decoding);
        var connections = _session.Connections;
        ConnectionsText = ConnectionsTextFor(connections);
        SamplesText = SamplesTextFor(connections);
        DetailsText = _session.Details;
        var startedEarlier = connections.ConnectionsSeen - connections.ConnectionsWithSyn > 0;
        var capturedNow = counters.CharactersCaptured > 0 || _session.Characters.Any(c => _session.IsCapturedThisSession(c.Profile.Name));
        HintText = startedEarlier && !capturedNow ? EarlierSessionHintText : string.Empty;
    }

    private static string ConnectionsTextFor(CaptureConnectionDiagnostics connections) =>
        connections.ConnectionsSeen == 0
            ? string.Empty
            : string.Create(
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                $"Connections: {Format(connections.ConnectionsSeen)} seen, {Format(connections.ConnectionsWithSyn)} with the start of the stream, {Format(connections.ConnectionsWithProfile)} with a profile, {Format(connections.ConnectionsWithInventory)} with an inventory, {Format(connections.ConnectionsCompleted)} completed");

    private static string SamplesTextFor(CaptureConnectionDiagnostics connections)
    {
        if (connections.UnreadableSamples.Count == 0)
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var parts = connections.UnreadableSamples.Select((s, index) => string.Create(
            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
            $"#{index + 1} {Format(s.EncodedLength)} B ({s.Reading}) -> {Format(s.DecodedLength)} B {s.FirstBytes}, entropy {s.EntropyBits:0.0}"));
        return "Unreadable messages: " + string.Join(" · ", parts);
    }

    private static string DecodingTextFor(CaptureDecodeDiagnostics decoding)
    {
        (string Label, DecodeFailure Reason)[] reasons =
        [
            ("not base64", DecodeFailure.NotBase64),
            ("no compression header", DecodeFailure.NoCompressionHeader),
            ("inflate failed", DecodeFailure.InflateFailed),
            ("too big", DecodeFailure.TooBigWhenInflated),
            ("not JSON", DecodeFailure.InflatedNotJson),
            ("invalid JSON", DecodeFailure.InvalidJson),
            ("no command", DecodeFailure.NoCommand),
            ("too large", DecodeFailure.TooLarge),
        ];
        var parts = reasons.Where(r => decoding.Failure(r.Reason) > 0).Select(r => $"{r.Label} {Format(decoding.Failure(r.Reason))}").ToList();
        return parts.Count == 0 ? string.Empty : "Unreadable: " + string.Join(" · ", parts);
    }

    private static string OtherNamesTextFor(CaptureDecodeDiagnostics decoding) =>
        decoding.OtherNames.Count == 0
            ? string.Empty
            : "Other commands seen: " + string.Join(" · ", decoding.OtherNames.Select(n => $"{n.Key} {Format(n.Value)}"));

    private static string CommandsTextFor(CaptureDecodeDiagnostics decoding)
    {
        var parts = new List<string>();
        foreach (var name in CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.KnownCommands.Append(CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.OtherCommand))
        {
            var count = decoding.Command(name);
            if (count == 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            parts.Add(name == "initUserData"
                ? $"initUserData {Format(count)} (own profile {Format(decoding.InitUserDataAccepted)}, ignored {Format(decoding.InitUserDataIgnored)}: no gold {Format(decoding.InitUserDataIgnoredNoGold)}, no name {Format(decoding.InitUserDataIgnoredNoName)})"
                : $"{name} {Format(count)}");
        }

        return parts.Count == 0 ? string.Empty : "Commands read: " + string.Join(" · ", parts);
    }

    // Keeps the selection while that Character exists; otherwise the most recently captured one on a first selection, else the first by name.
    private string? ChooseSelection()
    {
        if (CharacterNames.Count == 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var kept = _selectedCharacter is null
            ? null
            : CharacterNames.FirstOrDefault(name => string.Equals(name, _selectedCharacter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        if (kept is not null)
        {
            return kept;
        }

        return _selectedCharacter is null
            ? _characters.OrderBy(c => c.CapturedAtUtc).Last().Profile.Name
            : CharacterNames[0];
    }

    private void UpdateActive()
    {
        var snapshot = _selectedCharacter is null
            ? null
            : _characters.FirstOrDefault(c => string.Equals(c.Profile.Name, _selectedCharacter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
        var changed = !ReferenceEquals(snapshot, _active);
        _active = snapshot;

        ProfileHeadline = snapshot is null ? string.Empty : string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"{snapshot.Profile.Name} · Lv {snapshot.Profile.Level}");
        CapturedText = snapshot is null ? string.Empty : CapturedTextFor(snapshot);
        LiveText = snapshot is null ? string.Empty : LiveTextFor(snapshot);
        LastGainText = snapshot is null ? string.Empty : LastGainTextFor(snapshot);
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ActiveSnapshot));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ProfileHeadline));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CapturedText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasCapturedText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(LiveText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasLiveText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(LastGainText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasLastGain));

        // Only what changed is rebuilt: a gold update keeps the same standings and items, so their lists (and scroll positions) stay.
        if (snapshot is null || snapshot.Profile != _shownProfile)
        {
            _shownProfile = snapshot?.Profile;
            ProfileLines = snapshot is null ? [] : ProfileLinesFor(snapshot.Profile);
            ProfileFigures = snapshot is null ? [] : ProfileFiguresFor(snapshot.Profile);
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ProfileLines));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ProfileFigures));
        }

        if (snapshot is null || !ReferenceEquals(snapshot.Factions, _shownFactions))
        {
            _shownFactions = snapshot?.Factions;
            Factions = snapshot is null
                ? []
                : [.. snapshot.Factions.OrderBy(Missing).ThenBy(f => f.Name, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase).Select(FactionRow)];
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Factions));
        }

        if (changed)
        {
            ActiveSnapshotChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        }
    }

    private string LiveTextFor(CharacterSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        var count = _session.LiveUpdateCount(snapshot.Profile.Name);
        return count == 0
            ? string.Empty
            : string.Create(
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                $"Live: {Format(count)} {(count == 1 ? "update" : "updates")} since {LocalTimeText.Format(snapshot.CapturedAtUtc)}. {LiveNotTrackedText}");
    }

    private string LastGainTextFor(CharacterSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        var live = _session.Live;
        return !_session.IsLive(snapshot.Profile.Name) || (live.LastGoldGain == 0 && live.LastExpGain == 0)
            ? string.Empty
            : string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"Last kill: +{Format(live.LastGoldGain)} gold, +{Format(live.LastExpGain)} exp");
    }

    private string CapturedTextFor(CharacterSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        var time = LocalTimeText.Format(snapshot.CapturedAtUtc);
        return _session.IsCapturedThisSession(snapshot.Profile.Name)
            ? $"Captured {time} in this session."
            : $"Saved from an earlier session ({time}). Log in again to refresh it.";
    }

    private static string StateTextFor(CaptureState state, CaptureFailure failure, int captured) => state switch
    {
        CaptureState.NotSupported => NotSupportedText,
        CaptureState.NpcapMissing => NpcapMissingText,
        CaptureState.NeedsAdministrator => NeedsAdministratorText,
        CaptureState.Listening => captured > 0
            ? string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"Listening. {Format(captured)} {(captured == 1 ? "character" : "characters")} captured so far. Log in another client to add more, or press Stop capture.")
            : ListeningText,
        CaptureState.Done => captured > 0
            ? string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"{DoneText} {Format(captured)} {(captured == 1 ? "character" : "characters")} captured.")
            : DoneText,
        CaptureState.Failed => failure == CaptureFailure.NoDevice ? NoDeviceText : DriverErrorText,
        _ => IdleText,
    };

    private static List<string> ProfileLinesFor(CharacterProfile p)
    {
        var lines = new List<string>
        {
            "Gold: " + Format(p.Gold),
            "AC: " + Format(p.Coins),
            "Experience: " + Format(p.Exp) + " / " + Format(p.ExpToLevel),
            "Class points: " + Format(p.ClassPoints),
            "Days played: " + Format(p.DaysPlayed),
            "Membership: " + MembershipText(p),
            "Bag slots: " + Format(p.BagSlots),
            "Bank slots: " + Format(p.BankSlots),
            "House slots: " + Format(p.HouseSlots),
            "Loadouts: " + Format(p.LoadoutSlots),
        };
        AddBoost(lines, "XP boost", p.BoostXp);
        AddBoost(lines, "Gold boost", p.BoostGold);
        AddBoost(lines, "Class points boost", p.BoostClassPoints);
        AddBoost(lines, "Reputation boost", p.BoostReputation);
        return lines;
    }

    private static List<ProfileFigure> ProfileFiguresFor(CharacterProfile p) =>
    [
        new("Gold", Format(p.Gold)),
        new("Exp", Format(p.Exp) + " / " + Format(p.ExpToLevel)),
        new("AC", Format(p.Coins)),
        new("Class points", Format(p.ClassPoints)),
        new("Days played", Format(p.DaysPlayed)),
    ];

    private static void AddBoost(List<string> lines, string label, int value)
    {
        if (value != 0)
        {
            lines.Add(label + ": " + Format(value));
        }
    }

    private static string MembershipText(CharacterProfile p)
    {
        if (p.MembershipDays < 0)
        {
            var ago = -(long)p.MembershipDays;
            return "Expired " + Format(ago) + (ago == 1 ? " day ago" : " days ago");
        }

        return p.IsMember
            ? "Member, " + Format(p.MembershipDays) + (p.MembershipDays == 1 ? " day left" : " days left")
            : "Not a member";
    }

    // What is still missing for the next rank; a faction at the maximum rank has nothing to earn and goes last.
    private static long Missing(FactionStanding f) =>
        f.Rank >= MaxRank ? long.MaxValue : Math.Max(0, (long)f.RepToRank - f.SpillRep);

    private static GameFactionRow FactionRow(FactionStanding f)
    {
        var maxed = f.Rank >= MaxRank;
        return new GameFactionRow(
            f.Name,
            "Rank " + Format(f.Rank),
            Format(f.Rep),
            maxed ? "Max rank" : Format(f.SpillRep) + " / " + Format(f.RepToRank),
            maxed ? Format(0) : Format(Math.Max(0, f.RepToRank - f.SpillRep)),
            maxed ? 1 : f.RepToRank <= 0 ? 0 : Math.Clamp((double)f.SpillRep / f.RepToRank, 0, 1),
            maxed);
    }

    private static string Format(long value) => value.ToString("N0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
}
