`src/AqwCompanion.App/HardFarms/HardFarmStore.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Persistence;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.HardFarms;

/// <summary>
/// Maps the wiki data to two stored values (the list, and the per-index type data). Plain DTOs are stored (the models carry computed members and a lookup table).
/// Failures never reach the caller: the stored data module swallows and reports them. The old type table is an obsolete key.
/// </summary>
public sealed class HardFarmStore(StoredData data) : IHardFarmStore
{
    public sealed record ListDto(List<GroupDto> Groups, string? Credit);

    public sealed record GroupDto(string Name, List<string> Slugs);

    public sealed record IndexesDto(List<IndexDto> Indexes);

    public sealed record IndexDto(string IndexSlug, string Type, List<EntryDto> Entries, DateTimeOffset ReadAtUtc);

    public sealed record EntryDto(string Slug, string Name);

    public StoredHardFarmList? LoadList()
    {
        var stored = data.Load(StoredKeys.HardFarmList);
        if (stored?.Value is not { Groups: { } groups } dto)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var list = new HardFarmList(
            groups.Where(g => g is not null && g.Slugs is not null)
                .Select(g => new HardFarmGroup(g.Name ?? string.Empty, g.Slugs.Where(WikiUrls.IsValidSlug).ToList()))
                .ToList(),
            dto.Credit);
        return new StoredHardFarmList(list, stored.ReadAtUtc);
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<StoredIndex> LoadIndexes() => ReadIndexes();

    public StoredTypeTable? LoadTypes()
    {
        var indexes = ReadIndexes();
        return indexes.Count == 0
            ? null
            : new StoredTypeTable(WikiTypeTable.From(indexes.Select(i => i.Index)), indexes.Max(i => i.ReadAtUtc));
    }

    private List<StoredIndex> ReadIndexes()
    {
        var result = new List<StoredIndex>();
        if (data.Load(StoredKeys.HardFarmIndexes)?.Value is not { Indexes: { } dtos })
        {
            return result;
        }

        foreach (var dto in dtos)
        {
            if (dto is null || !WikiUrls.IsTypeIndex(dto.IndexSlug ?? string.Empty) || ParseType(dto.Type) is not { } type)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var entries = (dto.Entries ?? [])
                .Where(e => e is not null && WikiUrls.IsValidSlug(e.Slug))
                .DistinctBy(e => e.Slug, StringComparer.Ordinal)
                .Select(e => new WikiIndexEntry(e.Slug, e.Name ?? string.Empty))
                .ToList();
            var stored = new StoredIndex(new WikiIndex(dto.IndexSlug!, type, entries), dto.ReadAtUtc);

            // A repeated index keeps its place but the last copy wins.
            var existing = result.FindIndex(i => i.Index.IndexSlug == stored.Index.IndexSlug);
            if (existing >= 0)
            {
                result[existing] = stored;
            }
            else
            {
                result.Add(stored);
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    public void SaveList(HardFarmList list, DateTimeOffset readAtUtc) =>
        data.Save(
            StoredKeys.HardFarmList,
            new ListDto(list.Groups.Select(g => new GroupDto(g.Name, g.Slugs.ToList())).ToList(), list.Credit),
            readAtUtc);

    public void SaveIndex(WikiIndex index, DateTimeOffset readAtUtc)
    {
        var all = ReadIndexes();
        var replacement = new StoredIndex(index, readAtUtc);
        var existing = all.FindIndex(i => i.Index.IndexSlug == index.IndexSlug);
        if (existing >= 0)
        {
            all[existing] = replacement;
        }
        else
        {
            all.Add(replacement);
        }

        data.Save(
            StoredKeys.HardFarmIndexes,
            new IndexesDto(all.Select(i => new IndexDto(
                i.Index.IndexSlug,
                i.Index.Type.ToString(),
                i.Index.Entries.Select(e => new EntryDto(e.Slug, e.Name)).ToList(),
                i.ReadAtUtc)).ToList()),
            all.Max(i => i.ReadAtUtc));
    }

    /// <summary>The type of a stored name; null for anything that is not exactly the name of a defined type (no numbers, lists or other case).</summary>
    private static WikiType? ParseType(string? text) =>
        text is { Length: > 0 }
        && Enum.TryParse<WikiType>(text, ignoreCase: false, out var type)
        && Enum.IsDefined(type)
        && string.Equals(Enum.GetName(type), text, StringComparison.Ordinal)
            ? type
            : null;
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/HardFarms/HardFarmSync.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;
using Serilog;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.HardFarms;

/// <summary>Where a pass is: <see cref="Done"/> of <see cref="Total"/> index pages finished, the page being read, and the wait before a retry (null when not waiting).</summary>
public sealed record SyncProgress(int Done, int Total, string Label, string? Waiting);

public enum SyncStatus
{
    /// <summary>Everything needed was read and stored.</summary>
    Updated,

    /// <summary>Something was stored, but part of the pass was skipped, rejected or stopped; see the message and <see cref="SyncResult.Pending"/>.</summary>
    Partial,

    /// <summary>Nothing new was stored.</summary>
    Failed,

    /// <summary>The user cancelled; whatever was already saved stays.</summary>
    Cancelled,
}

/// <summary>What a pass did. <see cref="Pending"/> are the index pages (slugs) still unread or older than the allowed age.</summary>
public sealed record SyncResult(SyncStatus Status, string Message, IReadOnlyList<string> Pending);

/// <summary>
/// Told after every save: <see cref="List"/> is set only when the list itself was stored; <see cref="Types"/> is the type table
/// rebuilt from every index stored so far (with <see cref="TypesReadAtUtc"/>, the newest index read time).
/// </summary>
public sealed record SyncUpdate(HardFarmList? List, DateTimeOffset? ListReadAtUtc, WikiTypeTable Types, DateTimeOffset? TypesReadAtUtc);

/// <summary>The numbers of a pass; the defaults are the agreed ones, tests inject their own.</summary>
public sealed record HardFarmSyncOptions
{
    /// <summary>The pause before every request but the first.</summary>
    public TimeSpan Pause { get; init; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3);

    /// <summary>An answer that took longer than this doubles the next pause.</summary>
    public TimeSpan SlowAnswer { get; init; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(8);

    /// <summary>The longest pause after doubling.</summary>
    public TimeSpan MaxPause { get; init; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(12);

    /// <summary>The wait before the second, third... attempt of a page (the last one repeats).</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<TimeSpan> RetryWaits { get; init; } = [TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10), TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30)];

    public int MaxAttempts { get; init; } = 3;

    /// <summary>This many failed requests in a row (any pages) stop the pass.</summary>
    public int MaxConsecutiveFailures { get; init; } = 3;

    /// <summary>An index read more recently than this is not read again.</summary>
    public TimeSpan IndexMaxAge { get; init; } = TimeSpan.FromDays(7);

    public TimeSpan ListTimeout { get; init; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

    public TimeSpan IndexTimeout { get; init; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60);
}

public interface IHardFarmSync
{
    /// <summary>The type index pages (slugs, in fetch order) that were never read or were read longer ago than the allowed age. Never throws.</summary>
    IReadOnlyList<string> GetPending();

    /// <summary>
    /// Runs one pass: robots.txt, the list, then every pending type index, one request at a time. Each success is saved at once and
    /// reported through <paramref name="saved"/>. Never throws; cancellation is reported as <see cref="SyncStatus.Cancelled"/>.
    /// </summary>
    Task<SyncResult> RunAsync(Action<SyncProgress>? progress, Action<SyncUpdate>? saved, CancellationToken ct);
}

/// <summary>
/// The user-triggered import as a queue (see the AQW-0019 design): robots.txt, /syfarm, then one job per type index that is not
/// recent. A failed page goes to the back of the queue and is retried after a growing wait; the wiki refusing us, or several
/// failures in a row, stop the pass. Everything read is stored page by page, so a stopped or cancelled pass loses nothing.
/// </summary>
public sealed class HardFarmSync : IHardFarmSync
{
    private const string NotAnsweringWell = "The Wiki is not answering well; try again later.";
    private const string ListName = "the Hard Farming list";

    // A list far shorter than the stored one is not trusted (the Wiki page may be half loaded or vandalised).
    private const double DropThreshold = 0.5;
    private const int DropMinPrevious = 10;

    private readonly IWikiPageFetcher _fetcher;
    private readonly IHardFarmStore _store;
    private readonly IDelay _delay;
    private readonly TimeProvider _clock;
    private readonly HardFarmSyncOptions _options;
    private readonly HardFarmListParser _listParser = new();
    private readonly WikiIndexParser _indexParser = new();

    public HardFarmSync(
        IWikiPageFetcher fetcher,
        IHardFarmStore store,
        IDelay delay,
        TimeProvider clock,
        HardFarmSyncOptions? options = null)
    {
        _fetcher = fetcher;
        _store = store;
        _delay = delay;
        _clock = clock;
        _options = options ?? new HardFarmSyncOptions();
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<string> GetPending()
    {
        try
        {
            return PendingFrom(_store.LoadIndexes().ToDictionary(i => i.Index.IndexSlug, i => i.ReadAtUtc), _clock.GetUtcNow());
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OutOfMemoryException)
        {
            Log.Error("Reading the pending Wiki pages failed: {ExceptionType}", ex.GetType().Name);
            return [.. WikiUrls.TypeIndexSlugs];
        }
    }

    public async Task<SyncResult> RunAsync(Action<SyncProgress>? progress, Action<SyncUpdate>? saved, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var pass = new Pass(this, progress, saved, ct);
        try
        {
            return await pass.RunAsync();
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            return pass.Finish(SyncStatus.Cancelled, "Update cancelled. Everything read so far was kept.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OutOfMemoryException)
        {
            Log.Error("The Hard Farms update failed unexpectedly: {ExceptionType}", ex.GetType().Name);
            return pass.Finish(SyncStatus.Failed, "The update failed unexpectedly. Whatever was read before it is kept.");
        }
    }

    private bool IsFresh(DateTimeOffset readAt, DateTimeOffset now)
    {
        var age = now - readAt;
        return age < _options.IndexMaxAge && age > -TimeSpan.FromDays(1);
    }

    private IReadOnlyList<string> PendingFrom(IReadOnlyDictionary<string, DateTimeOffset> readAt, DateTimeOffset now) =>
        WikiUrls.TypeIndexSlugs.Where(slug => !(readAt.TryGetValue(slug, out var at) && IsFresh(at, now))).ToList();

    private static string PathOf(string slug) => new Uri(WikiUrls.Page(slug)).PathAndQuery;

    private static string PageName(string slug) => slug == WikiUrls.HardFarmSlug ? ListName : "/" + slug;

    private static string Describe(string page, PageFetchResult result) => result.Kind switch
    {
        PageFailureKind.Timeout => $"Could not read {page}: it took too long to answer.",
        PageFailureKind.Network => $"Could not read {page}: the connection failed.",
        PageFailureKind.Http => $"Could not read {page}: the Wiki answered HTTP {result.HttpStatus}.",
        PageFailureKind.Blocked => $"Could not read {page}: the request was not allowed.",
        PageFailureKind.TooLarge => $"Could not read {page}: the page is larger than allowed.",
        PageFailureKind.NotHtml => $"Could not read {page}: the answer was not a web page.",
        _ => $"Could not read {page}: the connection failed.",
    };

    private static string Seconds(TimeSpan span) => ((int)Math.Ceiling(span.TotalSeconds)).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);

    private static async Task<ParseResult<T>?> ParseAsync<T>(IPageParser<T> parser, PageSnapshot snapshot, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        try
        {
            return parser.CanParse(snapshot) ? await Task.Run(() => parser.Parse(snapshot), ct) : null;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException and not OutOfMemoryException)
        {
            Log.Error("A wiki page could not be parsed: {ExceptionType}", ex.GetType().Name);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private sealed record Job(string Slug, int Attempts)
    {
        public bool IsList => Slug == WikiUrls.HardFarmSlug;
    }

    /// <summary>The state of one pass.</summary>
    private sealed class Pass(HardFarmSync owner, Action<SyncProgress>? progress, Action<SyncUpdate>? saved, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<string, DateTimeOffset> _readAt = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        private readonly List<WikiIndex> _indexes = [];
        private readonly List<string> _problems = [];
        private readonly List<string> _warnings = [];
        private int _done;
        private int _consecutiveFailures;
        private TimeSpan _lastAnswer;
        private bool _firstRequestSent;
        private bool _savedAnything;
        private int _indexesRead;
        private int _listCount = -1;
        private string? _stopped;

        private HardFarmSyncOptions Options => owner._options;

        public async Task<SyncResult> RunAsync()
        {
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            foreach (var stored in await Task.Run(() => owner._store.LoadIndexes(), CancellationToken.None))
            {
                _readAt[stored.Index.IndexSlug] = stored.ReadAtUtc;
                _indexes.Add(stored.Index);
            }

            var needed = owner.PendingFrom(_readAt, owner._clock.GetUtcNow());
            _done = WikiUrls.TypeIndexSlugs.Count - needed.Count;

            // 1. robots.txt, and every path this pass needs is checked before the first page is requested.
            Report("robots.txt", null);
            var robotsResult = await TimedAsync(() => owner._fetcher.FetchRobotsAsync(ct));
            if (!robotsResult.IsSuccess)
            {
                return Finish(SyncStatus.Failed, "Could not read the Wiki's robots.txt. The update was stopped and nothing was changed.");
            }

            var robots = RobotsTxt.Parse(robotsResult.Snapshot!.Payload);
            foreach (var slug in needed.Prepend(WikiUrls.HardFarmSlug))
            {
                if (!robots.IsAllowed(PathOf(slug)))
                {
                    return Finish(SyncStatus.Failed, $"The Wiki's robots.txt does not allow reading /{slug}. The update was stopped and nothing was changed.");
                }
            }

            // 2. and 3. The queue: the list first, then the indexes in their order.
            var queue = new Queue<Job>(needed.Select(slug => new Job(slug, 0)).Prepend(new Job(WikiUrls.HardFarmSlug, 0)));
            while (queue.Count > 0 && _stopped is null)
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                var job = queue.Dequeue();
                await ProcessAsync(job, queue);
            }

            if (_stopped is not null)
            {
                return Finish(_savedAnything ? SyncStatus.Partial : SyncStatus.Failed, _stopped);
            }

            var pending = owner.PendingFrom(_readAt, owner._clock.GetUtcNow());
            var clean = _problems.Count == 0 && _warnings.Count == 0 && pending.Count == 0;
            return Finish(clean ? SyncStatus.Updated : _savedAnything ? SyncStatus.Partial : SyncStatus.Failed, null);
        }

        public SyncResult Finish(SyncStatus status, string? headline)
        {
            var pending = owner.PendingFrom(_readAt, owner._clock.GetUtcNow());
            var parts = new List<string>();
            if (headline is not null)
            {
                parts.Add(headline);
            }

            if (status != SyncStatus.Failed || _savedAnything)
            {
                var stored = new List<string>();
                if (_listCount >= 0)
                {
                    stored.Add($"{_listCount} entries in the list");
                }

                if (_indexesRead > 0)
                {
                    stored.Add($"{_indexesRead} index {(_indexesRead == 1 ? "page" : "pages")}");
                }

                if (stored.Count > 0)
                {
                    parts.Add("Stored " + string.Join(" and ", stored) + ".");
                }
                else if (status == SyncStatus.Updated)
                {
                    parts.Add("Everything was already up to date.");
                }
            }

            parts.AddRange(_problems);
            parts.AddRange(_warnings);
            if (pending.Count > 0 && status is SyncStatus.Partial or SyncStatus.Cancelled)
            {
                parts.Add($"{pending.Count} {(pending.Count == 1 ? "page" : "pages")} pending.");
            }

            return new SyncResult(status, string.Join(' ', parts), pending);
        }

        private async Task ProcessAsync(Job job, Queue<Job> queue)
        {
            var page = PageName(job.Slug);
            var label = job.IsList
                ? "Hard Farming list"
                : $"Index {WikiUrls.TypeIndexSlugs.ToList().IndexOf(job.Slug) + 1} of {WikiUrls.TypeIndexSlugs.Count} · /{job.Slug}";

            var wait = Pause();
            string? waiting = null;
            if (job.Attempts > 0)
            {
                var waits = Options.RetryWaits;
                var retryWait = waits.Count == 0 ? TimeSpan.Zero : waits[Math.Min(job.Attempts - 1, waits.Count - 1)];
                if (retryWait > wait)
                {
                    wait = retryWait;
                }

                waiting = $"Waiting {Seconds(wait)} s before trying {page} again";
            }

            Report(label, waiting);
            await owner._delay.DelayAsync(wait, ct);
            if (waiting is not null)
            {
                Report(label, null);
            }

            var timeout = job.IsList ? Options.ListTimeout : Options.IndexTimeout;
            var result = await TimedAsync(() => owner._fetcher.FetchPageAsync(WikiUrls.Page(job.Slug), timeout, ct));
            ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

            if (result.IsSuccess)
            {
                _consecutiveFailures = 0;
                await HandlePageAsync(job, page, result.Snapshot!);
                return;
            }

            var message = Describe(page, result);
            var blocked = result.Kind == PageFailureKind.Blocked
                || (result.Kind == PageFailureKind.Http && result.HttpStatus is 403 or 429);
            if (blocked)
            {
                _stopped = $"{message} {NotAnsweringWell}";
                return;
            }

            // Every failed request counts toward stopping the pass, retried or not; a success resets the count.
            var retriable = result.Kind is PageFailureKind.Timeout or PageFailureKind.Network or PageFailureKind.None
                || (result.Kind == PageFailureKind.Http && result.HttpStatus >= 500);
            if (++_consecutiveFailures >= Options.MaxConsecutiveFailures)
            {
                _stopped = $"{message} {NotAnsweringWell}";
                return;
            }

            if (!retriable)
            {
                _problems.Add(message);
                Finished(job);
                return;
            }

            if (job.Attempts + 1 < Options.MaxAttempts)
            {
                queue.Enqueue(job with { Attempts = job.Attempts + 1 });
            }
            else
            {
                _problems.Add(message);
                Finished(job);
            }
        }

        private async Task HandlePageAsync(Job job, string page, PageSnapshot snapshot)
        {
            if (job.IsList)
            {
                await HandleListAsync(snapshot);
                return;
            }

            var parsed = await ParseAsync(owner._indexParser, snapshot, ct);
            if (parsed is { Outcome: ParseOutcome.Ok, Data: { } index })
            {
                ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                var now = owner._clock.GetUtcNow();
                await Task.Run(() => owner._store.SaveIndex(index, now), CancellationToken.None);
                _readAt[job.Slug] = now;
                var existing = _indexes.FindIndex(i => i.IndexSlug == index.IndexSlug);
                if (existing >= 0)
                {
                    _indexes[existing] = index;
                }
                else
                {
                    _indexes.Add(index);
                }

                _savedAnything = true;
                _indexesRead++;
                Finished(job);
                Notify(null, null);
            }
            else if (job.Slug == WikiUrls.ClassesSlug)
            {
                // Nothing can be typed without the class index, so the other pages would be requested for nothing.
                _stopped = "The class index could not be understood (the page layout may have changed), so the update was stopped. What was saved is kept.";
            }
            else
            {
                _problems.Add($"Could not understand {page} (the page layout may have changed), so it was skipped.");
                Finished(job);
            }
        }

        private async Task HandleListAsync(PageSnapshot snapshot)
        {
            var parsed = await ParseAsync(owner._listParser, snapshot, ct);
            switch (parsed?.Outcome)
            {
                case ParseOutcome.Ok when parsed.Data is { } list:
                                        var previous = await Task.Run(() => owner._store.LoadList()?.List.Count, CancellationToken.None);
                    if (previous is >= DropMinPrevious
                        && list.Count < previous.Value * DropThreshold)
                    {
                        _warnings.Add(
                            $"The Hard Farming list shrank from {previous.Value} to {list.Count} entries (the page may have been damaged), so the previous list was kept.");
                        return;
                    }

                    ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                    var now = owner._clock.GetUtcNow();
                    await Task.Run(() => owner._store.SaveList(list, now), CancellationToken.None);
                    _savedAnything = true;
                    _listCount = list.Count;
                    Notify(list, now);
                    break;
                case ParseOutcome.Suspicious:
                    _warnings.Add("The Hard Farming list looked wrong (the page layout may have changed), so the previous list was kept.");
                    break;
                default:
                    _warnings.Add("The Hard Farming list could not be understood (the page layout may have changed), so the previous list was kept.");
                    break;
            }
        }

        private void Finished(Job job)
        {
            if (!job.IsList)
            {
                _done++;
            }
        }

        private TimeSpan Pause()
        {
            if (!_firstRequestSent)
            {
                return Options.Pause;
            }

            if (_lastAnswer > Options.SlowAnswer)
            {
                var doubled = Options.Pause + Options.Pause;
                return doubled < Options.MaxPause ? doubled : Options.MaxPause;
            }

            return Options.Pause;
        }

        private async Task<PageFetchResult> TimedAsync(Func<Task<PageFetchResult>> request)
        {
            var started = owner._clock.GetTimestamp();
            try
            {
                return await request();
            }
            finally
            {
                _lastAnswer = owner._clock.GetElapsedTime(started);
                _firstRequestSent = true;
            }
        }

        private void Report(string label, string? waiting)
        {
            try
            {
                progress?.Invoke(new SyncProgress(_done, WikiUrls.TypeIndexSlugs.Count, label, waiting));
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OutOfMemoryException)
            {
                Log.Error("A progress handler failed: {ExceptionType}", ex.GetType().Name);
            }
        }

        private void Notify(HardFarmList? list, DateTimeOffset? listReadAt)
        {
            try
            {
                saved?.Invoke(new SyncUpdate(
                    list,
                    listReadAt,
                    WikiTypeTable.From(_indexes),
                    _readAt.Count == 0 ? null : _readAt.Values.Max()));
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OutOfMemoryException)
            {
                Log.Error("A saved-data handler failed: {ExceptionType}", ex.GetType().Name);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Formatting;
using AqwCompanion.App.Inventory;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Forgetting;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Inventory;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;
using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;
using Serilog;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.HardFarms;

public enum HardFarmsState
{
    Idle,
    Updating,
}

/// <summary>
/// The Hard Farms tab: the imported list with item types and what the character already owns. The sync reports from the
/// thread pool, so the app passes <c>onUiThread</c> to run what it reports on the UI thread (without it, inline).
/// </summary>
public partial class HardFarmsViewModel : ObservableObject, IForgettable
{
    public const string EmptyText = "Click 'Update from the Wiki' to import the Hard Farming list. The list shows up in a few seconds; the item types keep arriving for a minute or two.";
    public const string UpdateText = "Update from the Wiki";
    public const string ContinueText = "Continue";
    public const string UpdateAccessibleName = "Update the Hard Farming list from the Wiki";
    public const string ContinueAccessibleName = "Continue reading the pending Wiki pages";
    public const string NoMatchesText = "No entries match the filters.";
    private const int MaxReportLines = 200;

    public const string NoInventoryHint = "log in to the game to see what you own";
    public const string LicenseText = "AQW Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0)";

    public static readonly FilterOption<WikiType> AllTypes = new(null, "All types");
    public static readonly GroupOption AllGroups = new(null, "All groups");
    public static readonly FilterOption<Ownership> AllOwnership = new(null, "All");

    private static readonly IReadOnlyList<FilterOption<WikiType>> TypeChoices =
        [AllTypes, .. Enum.GetValues<WikiType>().Select(t => new FilterOption<WikiType>(t, t.ToString()))];

    private static readonly IReadOnlyList<FilterOption<Ownership>> OwnedChoices =
        [AllOwnership, new(Ownership.Missing, "Missing"), new(Ownership.Owned, "Owned"), new(Ownership.Unknown, "Unknown")];

    private readonly IHardFarmStore _store;
    private readonly IHardFarmSync _sync;
    private readonly IActiveInventory _inventory;
    private readonly IUrlLauncher _launcher;
    private readonly Action<Action> _onUiThread;

    private HardFarmList? _list;
    private WikiTypeTable _types = WikiTypeTable.Empty;
    private DateTimeOffset? _listReadAt;
    private IReadOnlyList<Candidate> _candidates = [];
    private CancellationTokenSource? _updateCts;
    private IReadOnlyList<string> _pending = [];
    private bool _everRead;

    // Bumped by Quiesce and Forget: work that started before it must not bring data back.
    private int _epoch;

    // Set by Quiesce: the update command does nothing until Resume or Forget.
    private bool _quiesced;

    // Bumped whenever data is applied: a restore that started earlier must not overwrite it.
    private int _dataVersion;

    // One entry of the full list with everything that does not depend on the filters or the inventory computed once.
    private sealed record Candidate(string Slug, string Name, WikiType Type, string Group, string WikiUrl);

    private IReadOnlyList<HardFarmRow> _all = [];

    public HardFarmsViewModel(
        IHardFarmStore store,
        IHardFarmSync sync,
        IActiveInventory inventory,
        IUrlLauncher launcher,
        Action<Action>? onUiThread = null)
    {
        _onUiThread = onUiThread ?? (action => action());
        _store = store;
        _sync = sync;
        _inventory = inventory;
        _launcher = launcher;
        _typeFilter = AllTypes;
        _groupFilter = AllGroups;
        _ownedFilter = AllOwnership;
        inventory.Changed += OnInventoryChanged;
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<FilterOption<WikiType>> TypeOptions => TypeChoices;

    public IReadOnlyList<FilterOption<Ownership>> OwnedOptions => OwnedChoices;

    [ObservableProperty]
    private IReadOnlyList<GroupOption> _groupOptions = [AllGroups];

    [ObservableProperty]
    private FilterOption<WikiType> _typeFilter;

    [ObservableProperty]
    private GroupOption _groupFilter;

    [ObservableProperty]
    private FilterOption<Ownership> _ownedFilter;

    [ObservableProperty]
    private string _searchText = string.Empty;

    [ObservableProperty]
    private IReadOnlyList<HardFarmRow> _rows = [];

    [ObservableProperty]
    [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(IsUpdating), nameof(IsIdle), nameof(ShowEmptyState), nameof(ShowPending))]
    [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor(nameof(UpdateCommand), nameof(CancelCommand))]
    private HardFarmsState _state = HardFarmsState.Idle;

    [ObservableProperty]
    [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(HasProgress))]
    private string _progressText = string.Empty;

    [ObservableProperty]
    [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(HasStatus))]
    private string _statusText = string.Empty;

    [ObservableProperty]
    private string _summaryText = string.Empty;

    [ObservableProperty]
    private string _lastUpdatedText = string.Empty;

    [ObservableProperty]
    private string _creditText = string.Empty;

    [ObservableProperty]
    [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(ShowEmptyState), nameof(ShowNoMatches))]
    private bool _hasList;

    public bool IsUpdating => State == HardFarmsState.Updating;

    public bool IsIdle => State == HardFarmsState.Idle;

    public bool HasProgress => ProgressText.Length > 0;

    public bool HasStatus => StatusText.Length > 0;

    /// <summary>True until a list exists and no update is running; the view shows <see cref="EmptyText"/> then.</summary>
    public bool ShowEmptyState => !HasList && !IsUpdating;

    /// <summary>True when a list exists but the filters hide all of it.</summary>
    public bool ShowNoMatches => HasList && Rows.Count == 0;

    public bool HasCredit => CreditText.Length > 0;

    /// <summary>True when something was read before and index pages are still missing or old.</summary>
    public bool CanContinue => _everRead && _pending.Count > 0;

    public bool ShowPending => CanContinue && IsIdle;

    public string UpdateButtonText => CanContinue ? ContinueText : UpdateText;

    public string UpdateButtonAccessibleName => CanContinue ? ContinueAccessibleName : UpdateAccessibleName;

    public string PendingText => string.Create(
        CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
        $"{_pending.Count} {(_pending.Count == 1 ? "page" : "pages")} pending — {ContinueText}");

    public string EmptyStateText => EmptyText;

    private void NotifyPending()
    {
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CanContinue));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowPending));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(UpdateButtonText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(UpdateButtonAccessibleName));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(PendingText));
    }

    private bool CanUpdate() => State == HardFarmsState.Idle && !_quiesced;

    private bool CanCancel() => State == HardFarmsState.Updating;

    [RelayCommand(CanExecute = nameof(CanUpdate))]
    private async Task UpdateAsync()
    {
        if (_quiesced)
        {
            return;
        }

        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        _updateCts = cts;
        var epoch = _epoch;
        State = HardFarmsState.Updating;
        StatusText = string.Empty;
        ProgressText = "Starting...";
        SyncResult? result = null;
        string? failure = null;
        try
        {
            result = await _sync.RunAsync(
                p => _onUiThread(() =>
                {
                    if (epoch == _epoch)
                    {
                        ProgressText = ProgressLine(p);
                    }
                }),
                u => _onUiThread(() =>
                {
                    if (epoch == _epoch)
                    {
                        ApplyUpdate(u);
                    }
                }),
                cts.Token);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            failure = "Update cancelled.";
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OutOfMemoryException)
        {
            Log.Error("The Hard Farms update failed unexpectedly: {ExceptionType}", ex.GetType().Name);
            failure = "The update failed unexpectedly.";
        }
        finally
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(_updateCts, cts))
            {
                _updateCts = null;
            }
        }

        if (epoch != _epoch)
        {
            // Forgetting ran meanwhile: the data was forgotten, so nothing of this run is shown or kept in view.
            return;
        }

        if (result is not null)
        {
            _pending = result.Pending;
        }

        ProgressText = string.Empty;
        StatusText = result?.Message ?? failure ?? string.Empty;
        State = HardFarmsState.Idle;
        NotifyPending();
    }

    private static string ProgressLine(SyncProgress p) =>
        p.Waiting is { Length: > 0 } ? $"{p.Label} · {p.Waiting}" : p.Label;

    private void ApplyUpdate(SyncUpdate update)
    {
        _everRead = true;
        Apply(update.List ?? _list, update.Types, update.List is not null ? update.ListReadAtUtc : _listReadAt);
        NotifyPending();
    }

    [RelayCommand(CanExecute = nameof(CanCancel))]
    private void Cancel() => _updateCts?.Cancel();

    [RelayCommand]
    private void OpenOnWiki(HardFarmRow? row)
    {
        if (row is null || !WikiUrls.IsSafePageUrl(row.WikiUrl))
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            _launcher.Open(row.WikiUrl);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OutOfMemoryException)
        {
            Log.Error("Opening a wiki page failed: {ExceptionType}", ex.GetType().Name);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Loads the stored list and type table in the background. Does nothing after <see cref="Forget"/> or when a list is already
    /// shown; when an update brought newer types meanwhile, those are kept.
    /// </summary>
    public async Task RestoreAsync()
    {
        var epoch = _epoch;
        var version = _dataVersion;
        var (list, types, pending) = await Task.Run(() => (_store.LoadList(), _store.LoadTypes(), _sync.GetPending()));
        if ((list is null && types is null) || _list is not null || epoch != _epoch)
        {
            return;
        }

        var newerTypes = version != _dataVersion;
        Apply(list?.List, newerTypes ? _types : types?.Table ?? WikiTypeTable.Empty, list?.ReadAtUtc);
        if (!newerTypes)
        {
            _pending = pending;
            _everRead = true;
            NotifyPending();
        }
    }

    public string Name => "Hard Farms";

    /// <summary>
    /// Stops a running update and makes its late answers have no effect; the update command does nothing until <see cref="Resume"/>.
    /// Removes no data. Pressing Update again after <see cref="Resume"/> starts over.
    /// </summary>
    public void Quiesce()
    {
        _quiesced = true;
        _epoch++;
        _dataVersion++;
        _updateCts?.Cancel();
        _updateCts = null;
        ProgressText = string.Empty;
        State = HardFarmsState.Idle;
        UpdateCommand.NotifyCanExecuteChanged();
    }

    /// <summary>Undoes <see cref="Quiesce"/> when the stored data could not be removed.</summary>
    public void Resume()
    {
        _quiesced = false;
        UpdateCommand.NotifyCanExecuteChanged();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The saved data was removed: forgets the list, the types and the filters and returns to the empty state.
    /// Answers of work that started before this call are ignored.
    /// </summary>
    public void Forget()
    {
        _epoch++;
        _dataVersion++;
        _updateCts = null;
        _quiesced = false;
        _list = null;
        _types = WikiTypeTable.Empty;
        _listReadAt = null;
        _pending = [];
        _everRead = false;
        _candidates = [];
        _all = [];
        GroupOptions = [AllGroups];
        TypeFilter = AllTypes;
        GroupFilter = AllGroups;
        OwnedFilter = AllOwnership;
        SearchText = string.Empty;
        HasList = false;
        LastUpdatedText = string.Empty;
        CreditText = string.Empty;
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasCredit));
        ProgressText = string.Empty;
        StatusText = string.Empty;
        State = HardFarmsState.Idle;
        Refilter();
        NotifyPending();
        UpdateCommand.NotifyCanExecuteChanged();
    }

    // A drop-down can write null back when its items are replaced; that means "All".
    partial void OnTypeFilterChanged(FilterOption<WikiType> value)
    {
        if (value is null)
        {
            TypeFilter = AllTypes;
            return;
        }

        Refilter();
    }

    partial void OnGroupFilterChanged(GroupOption value)
    {
        if (value is null)
        {
            GroupFilter = AllGroups;
            return;
        }

        Refilter();
    }

    partial void OnOwnedFilterChanged(FilterOption<Ownership> value)
    {
        if (value is null)
        {
            OwnedFilter = AllOwnership;
            return;
        }

        Refilter();
    }

    partial void OnSearchTextChanged(string value) => Refilter();

    private void OnInventoryChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (_list is not null)
        {
            RebuildRows();
            Refilter();
        }
    }

    private void Apply(HardFarmList? list, WikiTypeTable types, DateTimeOffset? readAt)
    {
        _dataVersion++;
        _list = list;
        _types = types;
        _listReadAt = readAt;
        HasList = list is not null && list.Count > 0;
        LastUpdatedText = UpdatedTextFormatter.Format(readAt);
        CreditText = list is null ? string.Empty : CreditLine(list.Credit);
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasCredit));

        var groupNames = list?.Groups.Where(g => g.Slugs.Count > 0).Select(g => g.Name).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList() ?? [];
        var options = new List<GroupOption> { AllGroups };
        options.AddRange(groupNames.Select(name => new GroupOption(name, name)));
        var chosenGroup = GroupFilter?.Name;
        GroupOptions = options;
        GroupFilter = options.FirstOrDefault(o => o.Name is not null && o.Name == chosenGroup) ?? AllGroups;

        _candidates = list is null
            ? []
            : list.Entries.Where(entry => WikiUrls.IsValidSlug(entry.Slug)).Select(entry =>
            {
                var row = types.Find(entry.Slug);
                return new Candidate(entry.Slug, row?.Name ?? Prettify(entry.Slug), row?.Type ?? WikiType.Other, entry.Group, WikiUrls.Page(entry.Slug));
            }).ToList();
        RebuildRows();
        Refilter();
    }

    private void RebuildRows()
    {
        var inventory = _inventory.Current;
        _all = _candidates
            .Select(c => new HardFarmRow(
                c.Slug,
                c.Name,
                c.Type,
                c.Group,
                OwnershipMatcher.Match(c.Slug, _types.Find(c.Slug)?.Name, inventory),
                c.WikiUrl))
            .ToList();
        MissingReportText = BuildMissingReport();
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(MissingReportText));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(HasMissingReport));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// For the debug window: every entry that found no match in the inventory, with the name keys that were tried, so a name the
    /// matching misses can be seen and fixed. Empty without a loaded inventory and when everything matches.
    /// </summary>
    public string MissingReportText { get; private set; } = string.Empty;

    public bool HasMissingReport => MissingReportText.Length > 0;

    private string BuildMissingReport()
    {
        var missing = _all.Where(row => row.Ownership == Ownership.Missing).ToList();
        if (missing.Count == 0)
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var lines = new List<string>
        {
            string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"{missing.Count} of {_all.Count} entries have no match in the inventory:"),
        };
        foreach (var row in missing.Take(MaxReportLines))
        {
            var keys = OwnershipMatcher.KeysTried(row.Slug, _types.Find(row.Slug)?.Name);
            lines.Add($"{row.Name} [{row.Slug}] tried: {string.Join(", ", keys)}");
        }

        if (missing.Count > MaxReportLines)
        {
            lines.Add(string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"... and {missing.Count - MaxReportLines} more."));
        }

        return string.Join('\n', lines);
    }

    private void Refilter()
    {
        var type = TypeFilter?.Value;
        var group = GroupFilter?.Name;
        var owned = OwnedFilter?.Value;
        var needle = (SearchText ?? string.Empty).Trim();

        var scope = new List<HardFarmRow>(_all.Count);
        var ownedInScope = 0;
        foreach (var row in _all)
        {
            if ((type is null || row.Type == type) && (group is null || row.Group == group))
            {
                scope.Add(row);
                if (row.Ownership == Ownership.Owned)
                {
                    ownedInScope++;
                }
            }
        }

        SummaryText = _list is null
            ? string.Empty
            : _inventory.Current is null
                ? string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"{scope.Count} {(scope.Count == 1 ? "entry" : "entries")} — {NoInventoryHint}")
                : string.Create(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, $"{ownedInScope} of {scope.Count} owned");

        var shown = owned is null && needle.Length == 0
            ? scope
            : scope
                .Where(row => (owned is null || row.Ownership == owned)
                    && (needle.Length == 0 || row.Name.Contains(needle, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
                .ToList();

        // Identical rows keep the same list instance, so the list does not reset its scroll position.
        if (!Rows.SequenceEqual(shown))
        {
            Rows = shown;
        }

        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ShowNoMatches));
    }

    private static string CreditLine(string? credit)
    {
        const string prefix = "Created by ";
        var name = credit?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
        if (name.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            name = name[prefix.Length..].Trim();
        }

        return name.Length == 0 ? $"Hard Farming list · {LicenseText}" : $"List by {name} · {LicenseText}";
    }

    /// <summary>"void-highlord-class" becomes "Void Highlord Class".</summary>
    public static string Prettify(string slug)
    {
        var words = slug.Split(['-', '_'], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        return string.Join(' ', words.Select(w => char.ToUpperInvariant(w[0]) + w[1..]));
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;
using Serilog;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.HardFarms;

/// <summary>Opens a page of the wiki in the system browser. Only addresses of exactly the shape https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/&lt;valid page name&gt; are ever launched.</summary>
public interface IUrlLauncher
{
    /// <summary>True when the URL was handed to the system; false when it is not a wiki URL or the launch failed.</summary>
    bool Open(string url);
}

/// <summary>Hands the URL to the operating system's default browser (ShellExecute on Windows, `open` on macOS).</summary>
public sealed class ProcessUrlLauncher : IUrlLauncher
{
    public bool Open(string url)
    {
        if (!WikiUrls.IsSafePageUrl(url))
        {
            return false;
        }

        try
        {
            using var process = Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo(url) { UseShellExecute = true });
            return true;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OutOfMemoryException)
        {
            Log.Error("Opening a wiki page failed: {ExceptionType}", ex.GetType().Name);
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/HardFarms/OwnershipMatcher.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Inventory;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.HardFarms;

/// <summary>Whether the character owns a Hard Farming entry.</summary>
public enum Ownership
{
    Owned,
    Missing,
    Unknown,
}

/// <summary>
/// Matches a Hard Farming entry against the inventory by name keys, whole key against whole key (never a part: "void-paladin"
/// is not "cyber-void-paladin"). The wiki name is tried as it is and without its trailing acquisition tags ("(Class)",
/// "(Merge)", "(Quest)", "(Daily Quest)") and AC tags ("(AC)", "(0 AC)", "(Non-AC)"): owning the AC or the non-AC version is
/// owning the item. The inventory side is stripped the same way. Other qualifiers such as "(Rare)" tell items apart and stay.
/// When the wiki name is unknown the page name is used, with its trailing page-type words removed one at a time.
/// </summary>
public static class OwnershipMatcher
{
    private static readonly string[] PageTypeWords = ["classmerge", "class", "quest", "merge"];

    /// <summary><see cref="Ownership.Unknown"/> only when the inventory is not loaded; otherwise Owned or Missing.</summary>
    public static Ownership Match(string slug, string? wikiName, CharacterInventory? inventory)
    {
        if (inventory is null)
        {
            return Ownership.Unknown;
        }

        foreach (var key in KeysTried(slug, wikiName))
        {
            if (inventory.HasCompactKey(key))
            {
                return Ownership.Owned;
            }
        }

        // The item may carry the tags itself ("Test Blade (AC)" in the bag, "Test Blade" on the wiki).
        return !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(wikiName) && inventory.HasBaseKey(wikiName) ? Ownership.Owned : Ownership.Missing;
    }

    /// <summary>The compact keys <see cref="Match"/> looks for, in order and without repeats. Shown in the debug report.</summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> KeysTried(string? slug, string? wikiName)
    {
        var keys = new List<string>();

        void Add(string key)
        {
            if (key.Length > 0 && !keys.Contains(key))
            {
                keys.Add(key);
            }
        }

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(wikiName))
        {
            Add(NameKey.Compact(wikiName));
            Add(NameKey.Base(wikiName));
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(slug))
        {
            return keys;
        }

        Add(NameKey.Compact(slug));

        var words = slug.Split(['-', '_'], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        var count = words.Length;
        while (count > 1 && PageTypeWords.Contains(words[count - 1], StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            count--;
            Add(NameKey.Compact(string.Concat(words[..count])));
        }

        return keys;
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/HardFarms/WikiTypeTable.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.HardFarms;

public sealed record WikiTypeRow(string Slug, string Name, WikiType Type);

/// <summary>The item name and type of every wiki page found in the type indexes; a page in several indexes keeps the highest-priority type.</summary>
public sealed class WikiTypeTable
{
    public static readonly WikiTypeTable Empty = new([]);

    private readonly Dictionary<string, WikiTypeRow> _bySlug;

    /// <summary>Rows are distinct by slug; when the same slug appears twice, the better type (and its name) wins.</summary>
    public WikiTypeTable(IEnumerable<WikiTypeRow> rows)
    {
        _bySlug = new Dictionary<string, WikiTypeRow>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var row in rows)
        {
            if (_bySlug.TryGetValue(row.Slug, out var existing))
            {
                if (row.Type < existing.Type)
                {
                    _bySlug[row.Slug] = row;
                }
            }
            else
            {
                _bySlug[row.Slug] = row;
            }
        }
    }

    public int Count => _bySlug.Count;

    public IReadOnlyCollection<WikiTypeRow> Rows => _bySlug.Values;

    public WikiTypeRow? Find(string slug) => _bySlug.GetValueOrDefault(slug);

    public static WikiTypeTable From(IEnumerable<WikiIndex> indexes) =>
        new(indexes.SelectMany(index => index.Entries.Select(entry => new WikiTypeRow(entry.Slug, entry.Name, index.Type))));
}
```

```cs
public interface IAutoStart

    bool IsSupported { get; }

    bool IsEnabled();

    /// <summary>Registers or removes the start at sign-in; false when it did not work. Never throws.</summary>

/// <summary>Runs a program and returns its exit code, or -1 when it could not run. Never throws.</summary>
public interface IProcessRunner
{
    int Run(string file, IReadOnlyList<string> args);
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Infrastructure/AutoStart/ProcessRunner.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.AutoStart;

/// <summary>Runs a program without a window and waits for it a short while. Tiny on purpose: only the Windows checklist covers it.</summary>
public sealed class ProcessRunner : IProcessRunner
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan Limit = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);

    public int Run(string file, IReadOnlyList<string> args)
    {
        try
        {
            var info = new ProcessStartInfo(file)
            {
                CreateNoWindow = true,
                UseShellExecute = false,
                RedirectStandardOutput = true,
                RedirectStandardError = true,
            };
            foreach (var arg in args)
            {
                info.ArgumentList.Add(arg);
            }

            using var process = Process.Start(info);
            if (process is null)
            {
                return -1;
            }

            // The output is not used, but an unread pipe could fill up and block the program.
            _ = process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync();
            _ = process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync();
            if (process.WaitForExit(Limit))
            {
                return process.ExitCode;
            }

            process.Kill();
            return -1;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return -1;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Infrastructure/AutoStart/ScheduledTaskAutoStart.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Elevation;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.AutoStart;

/// <summary>
/// Starts the app at sign-in through a Windows scheduled task. A Run-key entry cannot work here: the app always asks for
/// administrator rights, and Windows does not start such a program from the Run key. A task with the highest privileges does,
/// and the app (already elevated) can create it without another prompt. The task starts the app with <c>--background</c> so it
/// waits in the notification area instead of opening its window.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ScheduledTaskAutoStart(IProcessRunner runner, string? exePath, string? userName, Func<bool> isWindows) : IAutoStart
{
    public const string TaskName = "Questkeeper";

    private const string Schtasks = "schtasks.exe";

    public bool IsSupported => isWindows() && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(exePath) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(userName);

    public bool IsEnabled() => IsSupported && runner.Run(Schtasks, ["/Query", "/TN", TaskName]) == 0;

    public bool TrySet(bool enabled)
    {
        if (!IsSupported)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (enabled)
        {
            return runner.Run(
                Schtasks,
                [
                    "/Create", "/TN", TaskName, "/TR", "\"" + exePath + "\" " + StartupArguments.BackgroundOption, "/SC", "ONLOGON",
                    "/RL", "HIGHEST", "/RU", userName!, "/IT", "/DELAY", "0000:15", "/F",
                ]) == 0;
        }

        // Nothing to remove is the same as removed.
        return !IsEnabled() || runner.Run(Schtasks, ["/Delete", "/TN", TaskName, "/F"]) == 0;
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Infrastructure/CrashHandler.cs`:

```cs
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Diagnostics;
using Serilog;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure;

public static class CrashHandler
{
    private static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<Exception, object> Reported = new();

    public static void Install(string crashDirectory, string appVersion)
    {
        AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException += (_, e) =>
        {
            if (e.ExceptionObject is Exception ex)
            {
                Report(ex, crashDirectory, appVersion);
            }
        };

        TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException += (_, e) => Report(e.Exception, crashDirectory, appVersion);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Logs and writes one crash report per exception instance. Best effort: never throws,
    /// so it cannot mask the exception being reported.
    /// </summary>
    public static void Report(Exception exception, string crashDirectory, string appVersion)
    {
        if (!Reported.TryAdd(exception, new object()))
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            Log.Fatal(exception, "Unhandled exception");
            CrashReportWriter.Write(exception, crashDirectory, appVersion, DateTimeOffset.Now);
        }
#pragma warning disable CA1031 // Crash path: nothing may escape the reporter.
        catch (Exception writeError)
        {
            try
            {
                Log.Error(writeError, "Could not write crash report");
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // Logging itself failed; there is nowhere left to report to.
            }
        }
#pragma warning restore CA1031
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Infrastructure/Elevation/StartupArguments.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Elevation;

/// <summary>The command line the app understands: the data root an elevated relaunch must keep using, and the background start.</summary>
public static class StartupArguments
{
    public const string DataRootOption = "--data-root=";

    /// <summary>Starts the app in the notification area without opening its window, as the sign-in task does.</summary>
    public const string BackgroundOption = "--background";

    public static bool IsBackground(string[] args) => args.Contains(BackgroundOption, StringComparer.Ordinal);

    /// <summary>The value after the option, without surrounding quotes; null when absent or empty.</summary>
    public static string? TryGetDataRoot(string[] args)
    {
        foreach (var arg in args)
        {
            if (!arg.StartsWith(DataRootOption, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                continue;
            }

            var value = arg[DataRootOption.Length..].Trim();
            if (value.Length >= 2 && value[0] == '"' && value[^1] == '"')
            {
                value = value[1..^1].Replace("\\\"", "\"", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            }
            value = value.Trim('"');
            return value.Length == 0 ? null : value;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>The quoted option for a relaunch, with embedded quotes escaped.</summary>
    public static string ForRelaunch(string dataRoot) =>
        DataRootOption + "\"" + dataRoot.Replace("\"", "\\\"", StringComparison.Ordinal) + "\"";
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Infrastructure/Elevation/WindowsProcessElevation.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Security.Principal;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Elevation;

/// <summary>
/// Elevation through the Windows administrator prompt. The Windows calls cannot be unit-tested on other systems,
/// so this class stays tiny and is covered by the manual Windows checklist.
/// </summary>
public sealed class WindowsProcessElevation : IProcessElevation
{
    public bool IsElevated =>
        OperatingSystem.IsWindows() && new WindowsPrincipal(WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent()).IsInRole(WindowsBuiltInRole.Administrator);

    public bool TryRelaunchElevated(string dataRoot)
    {
        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows() || Environment.ProcessPath is not { } exe)
        {
            return false;
        }

        try
        {
            using var started = Process.Start(new ProcessStartInfo(exe)
            {
                UseShellExecute = true,
                Verb = "runas",
                Arguments = StartupArguments.ForRelaunch(dataRoot),
            });
            return started is not null;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // Win32Exception 1223 means the prompt was declined; any other failure means the same to the caller.
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Infrastructure/Logging/PrivacyLogSink.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Diagnostics;
using Serilog.Core;
using Serilog.Events;
using Serilog.Parsing;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Logging;

/// <summary>
/// Wraps the real sink. Rewrites each log event so it can be written without leaking: the exception becomes a
/// type-and-stack summary, and every dynamic string is masked unless its property is explicitly marked safe.
/// </summary>
public sealed class PrivacyLogSink : ILogEventSink, IDisposable
{
    public const string Mask = "***";
    public const string SafePrefix = "Safe";
    public const string ExceptionSummaryProperty = "ExceptionSummary";

    private const string FailureTemplate = "A log event could not be sanitised";

    private static readonly HashSet<string> PassThroughNames =
        new(StringComparer.Ordinal) { "ExceptionType", ExceptionSummaryProperty, "AppVersion" };

    private readonly ILogEventSink _inner;

    public PrivacyLogSink(ILogEventSink inner)
    {
        _inner = inner;
    }

    public void Emit(LogEvent logEvent)
    {
        LogEvent sanitised;
        try
        {
            sanitised = Sanitise(logEvent);
        }
#pragma warning disable CA1031 // The guard must fail closed and never throw into the caller.
        catch (Exception)
        {
            sanitised = new LogEvent(
                logEvent.Timestamp,
                logEvent.Level,
                null,
                new MessageTemplateParser().Parse(FailureTemplate),
                []);
        }
#pragma warning restore CA1031

        _inner.Emit(sanitised);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        (_inner as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
    }

    private static LogEvent Sanitise(LogEvent logEvent)
    {
        var properties = new List<LogEventProperty>(logEvent.Properties.Count + 1);
        foreach (var property in logEvent.Properties)
        {
            properties.Add(new LogEventProperty(property.Key, SanitiseValue(property.Key, property.Value)));
        }

        if (logEvent.Exception is not null)
        {
            properties.RemoveAll(p => p.Name == ExceptionSummaryProperty);
            properties.Add(new LogEventProperty(
                ExceptionSummaryProperty,
                new ScalarValue(ExceptionSummary.Describe(logEvent.Exception))));
        }

        return new LogEvent(logEvent.Timestamp, logEvent.Level, null, logEvent.MessageTemplate, properties);
    }

    private static bool IsSafeName(string name) =>
        PassThroughNames.Contains(name) || name.StartsWith(SafePrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal);

    private static LogEventPropertyValue SanitiseValue(string name, LogEventPropertyValue value) =>
        value switch
        {
            ScalarValue scalar => SanitiseScalar(IsSafeName(name), scalar),
            SequenceValue sequence => new SequenceValue(sequence.Elements.Select(e => SanitiseValue(string.Empty, e)).ToList()),
            StructureValue structure => new StructureValue(
                structure.Properties.Select(p => new LogEventProperty(p.Name, SanitiseValue(p.Name, p.Value))).ToList(),
                structure.TypeTag),
            DictionaryValue dictionary => SanitiseDictionary(dictionary),
            _ => throw new NotSupportedException("Unknown log value kind."),
        };

    private static ScalarValue SanitiseScalar(bool safe, ScalarValue scalar)
    {
        var raw = scalar.Value;
        if (raw is string or char)
        {
            return safe ? scalar : new ScalarValue(Mask);
        }

        return IsPlainData(raw) ? scalar : new ScalarValue(Mask);
    }

    private static bool IsPlainData(object? raw) =>
        raw is null or bool or byte or sbyte or short or ushort or int or uint or long or ulong
            or float or double or decimal or Enum or DateTime or DateTimeOffset or TimeSpan or Guid
            or DateOnly or TimeOnly;

    private static DictionaryValue SanitiseDictionary(DictionaryValue dictionary)
    {
        var elements = new Dictionary<ScalarValue, LogEventPropertyValue>();
        foreach (var pair in dictionary.Elements)
        {
            var key = SanitiseScalar(safe: false, pair.Key);
            elements.TryAdd(key, SanitiseValue(string.Empty, pair.Value));
        }

        return new DictionaryValue(elements);
    }
}
```

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Logging;
using Serilog;
using Serilog.Core;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure;

/// <summary>The single place that builds the logger. Every event passes the <see cref="PrivacyLogSink"/> before the file.</summary>
public static class LoggingSetup
{
    public const string OutputTemplate =
        "{Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff zzz} [{Level:u3}] {AppVersion} {Message:lj}{NewLine}{ExceptionSummary}{NewLine}";

    public static Logger CreateLogger(AppPaths paths, string appVersion)
    {
        var fileLogger = new LoggerConfiguration()
            .MinimumLevel.Verbose()
            .WriteTo.File(
                Path.Combine(paths.LogDirectory, "log-.txt"),
                outputTemplate: OutputTemplate,
                rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day,
                retainedFileCountLimit: 14,
                shared: true)
            .CreateLogger();

        return new LoggerConfiguration()
            .MinimumLevel.Information()
            .Enrich.WithProperty("AppVersion", appVersion)
            .WriteTo.Sink(new PrivacyLogSink(fileLogger))
            .CreateLogger();
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Infrastructure/Persistence/LiteDbStoredDataStore.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Persistence;
using LiteDB;
using Serilog;
using JsonSerializer = System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Persistence;

/// <summary>
/// Stores JSON payloads in a single LiteDB file. The database is opened per operation in shared mode, so another
/// running copy of the app never blocks this one. A file that is not a valid database is set aside once.
/// </summary>
public sealed class LiteDbStoredDataStore(string filePath) : IStoredDataStore
{
    private const string CollectionName = "records";

    public StoredValue<T>? Load<T>(string key, int version)
    {
        var record = Run(db => db.GetCollection<StoredRecord>(CollectionName).FindById(key));
        if (record is null || record.SchemaVersion != version)
        {
            return null;
        }

        try
        {
            return JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(record.Payload, StoredJson.Options) is { } value
                ? new StoredValue<T>(value, DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(record.ReadAtUnixMs))
                : null;
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is JsonException or ArgumentOutOfRangeException)
        {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public void Save<T>(string key, int version, T value, DateTimeOffset readAtUtc) =>
        Run(db => db.GetCollection<StoredRecord>(CollectionName).Upsert(new StoredRecord
        {
            Id = key,
            SchemaVersion = version,
            ReadAtUnixMs = readAtUtc.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds(),
            Payload = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, StoredJson.Options),
        }));

    public void Remove(string key) =>
        Run(db => db.GetCollection<StoredRecord>(CollectionName).Delete(key));

    public bool Clear()
    {
        var allRemoved = true;
        foreach (var path in new[] { filePath, LogFilePath, CorruptFilePath })
        {
            try
            {
                File.Delete(path);
            }
            catch (DirectoryNotFoundException)
            {
                // The data directory does not exist, so there is nothing to delete.
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OutOfMemoryException)
            {
                allRemoved = false;
                Log.Error("Deleting a stored data file failed: {ExceptionType}", ex.GetType().Name);
            }
        }

        return allRemoved;
    }

    private string LogFilePath =>
        Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(filePath)!, Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(filePath) + "-log" + Path.GetExtension(filePath));

    private string CorruptFilePath => filePath + ".corrupt";

    private T Run<T>(Func<LiteDatabase, T> action)
    {
        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(filePath)!);
        LiteDatabase db;
        try
        {
            db = Open();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (IsCorruptDatabase(ex))
        {
            Quarantine();
            db = Open();
        }

        // The action runs outside the corruption scope, so its own exceptions never move a healthy file aside.
        using (db)
        {
            return action(db);
        }
    }

    // LiteDB reports a bad header either as INVALID_DATABASE or, for garbage bytes that fail date decoding in the header page, as ArgumentOutOfRangeException.
    private static bool IsCorruptDatabase(Exception ex) =>
        ex is LiteException { ErrorCode: LiteException.INVALID_DATABASE } or ArgumentOutOfRangeException;

    /// <summary>Opens the database and forces the header read, so a bad file fails here and not inside the operation.</summary>
    private LiteDatabase Open()
    {
        var db = new LiteDatabase(new ConnectionString { Filename = filePath, Connection = ConnectionType.Shared });
        try
        {
            _ = db.UserVersion;
            return db;
        }
        catch
        {
            db.Dispose();
            throw;
        }
    }

    // A stale log next to the bad file must not be replayed into the fresh one.
    private void Quarantine()
    {
        File.Delete(LogFilePath);
        File.Move(filePath, CorruptFilePath, overwrite: true);
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Infrastructure/Persistence/StoredJson.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization.Metadata;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Persistence;

/// <summary>
/// The one set of JSON options for stored payloads: camelCase, and only settable (constructor/init) properties, so
/// computed members such as groupings and previews are never written.
/// </summary>
public static class StoredJson
{
    public static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Options = Create();

    private static JsonSerializerOptions Create()
    {
        var resolver = new DefaultJsonTypeInfoResolver();
        resolver.Modifiers.Add(info =>
        {
            if (info.Kind != JsonTypeInfoKind.Object)
            {
                return;
            }

            for (var i = info.Properties.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (info.Properties[i].Set is null)
                {
                    info.Properties.RemoveAt(i);
                }
            }
        });

        return new JsonSerializerOptions
        {
            TypeInfoResolver = resolver,
            PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
        };
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Infrastructure/SingleInstance.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure;

/// <summary>
/// Lets one process own the app: a named mutex says who is first, a named event lets a second launch wake the first.
/// Both names live in the "Local\" namespace (this user session). Where named mutexes or events are not supported the guard
/// degrades instead of throwing: without a mutex every process counts as primary, without an event a signal does nothing.
/// </summary>
public sealed class SingleInstance : IDisposable
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan JoinTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);

    private readonly string _mutexName;
    private readonly bool _supported;
    private readonly EventWaitHandle? _signal;
    private readonly ManualResetEventSlim _release = new(false);
    private readonly ManualResetEvent _stopListening = new(false);
    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private Thread? _owner;
    private Thread? _listener;
    private bool _primary;
    private int _disposed;

    /// <param name="name">Names the mutex and the event: "Local\" plus this name.</param>
    /// <param name="supported">False turns the guard off: every process is primary and signals do nothing.</param>
    public SingleInstance(string name, bool supported = true)
    {
        _mutexName = "Local\\" + name;
        _supported = supported;
        if (!supported)
        {
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            _signal = new EventWaitHandle(false, EventResetMode.AutoReset, _mutexName + ".signal");
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // Named events are not available here (for example on Unix): a second launch simply cannot wake the first.
            _signal = null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>True when this process now owns the app. Waits up to <paramref name="wait"/> for the previous owner to exit.</summary>
    public bool TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan wait)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_primary)
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (!_supported)
            {
                _primary = true;
                return true;
            }

            // The mutex belongs to the thread that took it, so a dedicated thread takes it, holds it and releases it.
            var result = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
            _owner = new Thread(() => HoldMutex(wait, result)) { IsBackground = true, Name = "SingleInstance owner" };
            _owner.Start();
            _primary = result.Task.GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            return _primary;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Wakes the primary instance; does nothing when signals are not available.</summary>
    public void SignalPrimary()
    {
        try
        {
            if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) == 0)
            {
                _signal?.Set();
            }
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // A missed wake-up must not stop the second launch from ending.
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Calls <paramref name="onSignal"/> from a background thread each time a second launch signals; stops on Dispose.</summary>
    public void ListenForSignals(Action onSignal)
    {
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_signal is null || _listener is not null || Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            _listener = new Thread(() => Listen(onSignal)) { IsBackground = true, Name = "SingleInstance listener" };
            _listener.Start();
        }
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _disposed, 1) != 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        Thread? listener;
        Thread? owner;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            listener = _listener;
            owner = _owner;
        }

        _stopListening.Set();
        _release.Set();
        if (listener is not null && listener != Thread.CurrentThread)
        {
            listener.Join(JoinTimeout);
        }

        if (owner is not null && owner != Thread.CurrentThread)
        {
            owner.Join(JoinTimeout);
        }

        _signal?.Dispose();
        _stopListening.Dispose();
        _release.Dispose();
    }

    private void HoldMutex(TimeSpan wait, TaskCompletionSource<bool> result)
    {
        Mutex? mutex = null;
        var owned = false;
        try
        {
            mutex = new Mutex(false, _mutexName);
            try
            {
                owned = mutex.WaitOne(wait);
            }
            catch (AbandonedMutexException)
            {
                // The previous owner ended without releasing it; the mutex is ours now.
                owned = true;
            }
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // Named mutexes are not available here: act as the only instance.
            mutex?.Dispose();
            mutex = null;
            owned = true;
        }

        result.TrySetResult(owned);
        if (owned)
        {
            _release.Wait();
        }

        if (mutex is not null)
        {
            if (owned)
            {
                try
                {
                    mutex.ReleaseMutex();
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                    // Nothing else to do while ending.
                }
            }

            mutex.Dispose();
        }
    }

    private void Listen(Action onSignal)
    {
        WaitHandle[] handles = [_stopListening, _signal!];
        while (WaitHandle.WaitAny(handles) == 1)
        {
            if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                onSignal();
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // A failing callback must not end the listener.
            }
        }
    }
}

```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Inventory/ActiveInventory.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.GameData;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Inventory;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Inventory;

/// <summary>
/// The inventory the rest of the app reads: the selected Character's captured inventory, or null while there is no
/// Capture data. Raises <see cref="Changed"/> on the UI thread.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ActiveInventory : IActiveInventory
{
    private readonly GameDataViewModel _gameData;

    // The conversion of the last snapshot seen, so Current stays the same object while the snapshot does.
    private CharacterSnapshot? _convertedFrom;
    private CharacterInventory? _converted;

    public ActiveInventory(GameDataViewModel gameData)
    {
        _gameData = gameData;
        gameData.ActiveSnapshotChanged += (_, _) => Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }

    /// <summary>Raised when the selected Character's snapshot changes.</summary>
    public event EventHandler? Changed;

    /// <summary>The captured inventory of the selected Character, or null when it has no snapshot.</summary>
    public CharacterInventory? Current
    {
        get
        {
            var snapshot = _gameData.ActiveSnapshot;
            if (snapshot is null)
            {
                return null;
            }

            if (!ReferenceEquals(snapshot, _convertedFrom))
            {
                _converted = SnapshotInventory.ToCharacterInventory(snapshot);
                _convertedFrom = snapshot;
            }

            return _converted;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Inventory/SnapshotInventory.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Inventory;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Inventory;

/// <summary>Turns the items a Capture read into the inventory shape the rest of the app uses.</summary>
public static class SnapshotInventory
{
    /// <summary>
    /// One <see cref="InventoryItem"/> per owned item (bag, bank and house together). The count is the quantity, except for
    /// classes: their class points are not captured, so their count is 0. AC is the coins flag, member-only the upgrade flag.
    /// </summary>
    public static CharacterInventory ToCharacterInventory(CharacterSnapshot snapshot) =>
        new([.. snapshot.Items.Concat(snapshot.HouseItems).Select(ToInventoryItem)]);

    private static InventoryItem ToInventoryItem(OwnedItem item) => new(
        item.Name,
        item.Type,
        string.Equals(item.Type, CharacterInventory.ClassTypeName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? 0 : item.Quantity,
        item.Flags.HasFlag(ItemFlags.Coins),
        item.Flags.HasFlag(ItemFlags.Upgrade));
}
```
