`src/AqwCompanion.App/Program.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure;
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Elevation;
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Threading;
using Serilog;

namespace AqwCompanion.App;

internal static class Program
{
    [STAThread]
    public static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        // An elevated relaunch starts while the old process is still ending, so it waits for it; a normal start does not wait.
        var relaunched = StartupArguments.TryGetDataRoot(args) is not null;
        using var instance = new SingleInstance(AppInfo.ExeName);
        if (!instance.TryBecomePrimary(relaunched ? RelaunchWait : TimeSpan.Zero))
        {
            instance.SignalPrimary();
            return;
        }

        instance.ListenForSignals(() => Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(() => (Application.Current as CompanionApp)?.OpenMainWindow()));

        var paths = AppPaths.ForCurrentUser(AppInfo.ExeName, StartupArguments.TryGetDataRoot(args));

        Log.Logger = LoggingSetup.CreateLogger(paths, AppInfo.Version);
        Log.Information("Starting {SafeProduct} {SafeVersion}", AppInfo.ProductName, AppInfo.Version);

        CrashHandler.Install(paths.CrashDirectory, AppInfo.Version);

        try
        {
            BuildAvaloniaApp().StartWithClassicDesktopLifetime(args);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            CrashHandler.Report(ex, paths.CrashDirectory, AppInfo.Version);
            throw;
        }
        finally
        {
            Log.CloseAndFlush();
            StartSafetyNet();
        }
    }

    private static readonly TimeSpan RelaunchWait = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10);

    // Safety net: if something (a stray foreground thread, a driver handle) keeps the process alive after the window loop
    // has ended, exit for real 5 seconds later. It is a background thread, so a normal exit simply discards it.
    private static void StartSafetyNet() =>
        new Thread(() =>
        {
            Thread.Sleep(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            Environment.Exit(0);
        })
        { IsBackground = true, Name = "Exit safety net" }.Start();

    public static AppBuilder BuildAvaloniaApp() =>
        AppBuilder.Configure<CompanionApp>().UsePlatformDetect().LogToTrace();
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Settings/AvaloniaSettingsDialog.cs`:

```cs
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls.ApplicationLifetimes;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Settings;

/// <summary>Shows <see cref="SettingsWindow"/> as a dialog of the main window; a second request brings the open one forward.</summary>
public sealed class AvaloniaSettingsDialog : ISettingsDialog
{
    private SettingsWindow? _open;

    public void Show(SettingsViewModel settings)
    {
        if (_open is { } existing)
        {
            existing.Activate();
            return;
        }

        settings.Refresh();
        var window = new SettingsWindow { DataContext = settings };
        void Close(object? sender, EventArgs e) => window.Close();
        settings.CloseRequested += Close;
        window.Closed += (_, _) =>
        {
            settings.CloseRequested -= Close;
            _open = null;
        };
        _open = window;

        if (Application.Current?.ApplicationLifetime is IClassicDesktopStyleApplicationLifetime { MainWindow: { } owner })
        {
            window.ShowDialog(owner);
        }
        else
        {
            window.Show();
        }
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Settings/JsonAppSettingsStore.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using Serilog;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Settings;

/// <summary>Stores the settings as one small JSON file, written whole and moved into place so a crash never leaves half a file.</summary>
public sealed class JsonAppSettingsStore(string path) : IAppSettingsStore
{
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Options = new(JsonSerializerDefaults.Web) { WriteIndented = true };

    public AppSettings Load()
    {
        try
        {
            return File.Exists(path)
                ? JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AppSettings>(File.ReadAllText(path), Options) ?? new AppSettings()
                : new AppSettings();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException or JsonException)
        {
            return new AppSettings();
        }
    }

    public void Save(AppSettings settings)
    {
        var temp = path + ".tmp";
        try
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)!);
            File.WriteAllText(temp, JsonSerializer.Serialize(settings, Options));
            File.Move(temp, path, overwrite: true);
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
            Log.Error("Settings save failed: {ExceptionType}", ex.GetType().Name);
            try
            {
                File.Delete(temp);
            }
            catch (Exception cleanup) when (cleanup is IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException)
            {
                // The temp file is harmless; the next save overwrites it.
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Settings/SettingsViewModel.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.AutoStart;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Forgetting;
using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.ComponentModel;
using CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.Input;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Settings;

/// <summary>The Settings dialog: debug mode, the privacy text with Forget my data, the credits and the version.</summary>
public partial class SettingsViewModel : ObservableObject
{
    public const string TitleText = "Settings";
    public const string AutoStartTitleText = "Start with Windows";
    public const string AutoStartDescriptionText = "Opens the app in the notification area when you sign in to the PC, so the capture is already listening when you start the game.";
    public const string AutoStartFailedText = "Windows did not accept the change. Run the app as administrator and try again.";
    public const string DebugTitleText = "Debug mode";
    public const string DebugDescriptionText = "Shows the capture and packet details in their own window. It also opens with Ctrl+Shift+D and from the tray icon menu.";
    public const string PrivacyTitleText = "Privacy";
    public const string ForgetText = "Forget my data";
    public const string ForgetPromptText = "Remove everything the app saved on this computer? Your game data and the Hard Farms list are cleared until the next login.";
    public const string ForgetCompleteText = "Everything the app saved was removed from this computer.";
    public const string ForgetFailedText = "Could not remove the stored data. Close other copies of the app and try again.";
    public const string CreditsTitleText = "Credits";

    public const string PrivacyText =
        "Questkeeper reads, on this computer only, the data the game sends your own computer when you log in, and a few of your own events while you play: " +
        "character name and level, gold, experience, AC, class points, days played, membership days, faction reputation, and your items. " +
        "It never reads or keeps your e-mail address, IP address, password, user or character ids, or anything about other players. " +
        "It never sends anything to the game and never acts for you. Nothing leaves this computer; the only network access is to the AQW Wiki, " +
        "when you ask for the Hard Farms list. The data is saved locally so the app opens with it, and Forget my data removes it.";

    public const string CreditsText =
        "Unofficial fan project, not made by, endorsed by or connected to Artix Entertainment. AdventureQuest Worlds belongs to its owners. " +
        "Reputation ranks and the Hard Farms list come from the AQW Wiki (CC BY-SA 3.0). Packet capture uses Npcap and SharpPcap.";

    private readonly IAppSettingsStore _store;
    private readonly ForgetCoordinator _forgetting;
    private readonly IAutoStart _autoStart;
    private bool _debugMode;
    private bool _startWithWindows;

    public SettingsViewModel(IAppSettingsStore store, ForgetCoordinator forgetting, IAutoStart? autoStart = null)
    {
        _store = store;
        _forgetting = forgetting;
        _autoStart = autoStart ?? new NoAutoStart();
        _debugMode = store.Load().DebugMode;
    }

    /// <summary>Whether the switch for starting with Windows is offered at all.</summary>
    public bool CanAutoStart => _autoStart.IsSupported;

    /// <summary>Whether the app starts at sign-in. Setting it registers or removes the Windows task; a failure puts the switch back.</summary>
    public bool StartWithWindows
    {
        get => _startWithWindows;
        set
        {
            if (_startWithWindows == value)
            {
                return;
            }

            if (_autoStart.TrySet(value))
            {
                _startWithWindows = value;
                AutoStartError = string.Empty;
            }
            else
            {
                AutoStartError = AutoStartFailedText;
            }

            // Also tells a switch that already moved to the new value to go back after a failure.
            OnPropertyChanged();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Reads the state the system holds (the task can be deleted in Windows); call when the dialog opens.</summary>
    public void Refresh()
    {
        _startWithWindows = _autoStart.IsEnabled();
        AutoStartError = string.Empty;
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(StartWithWindows));
        OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CanAutoStart));
    }

    [ObservableProperty]
    [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(HasAutoStartError))]
    private string _autoStartError = string.Empty;

    public bool HasAutoStartError => AutoStartError.Length > 0;

    private sealed class NoAutoStart : IAutoStart
    {
        public bool IsSupported => false;

        public bool IsEnabled() => false;

        public bool TrySet(bool enabled) => false;
    }

    /// <summary>Raised after <see cref="DebugMode"/> changed and was saved.</summary>
    public event EventHandler? DebugModeChanged;

    /// <summary>Raised when the dialog should close.</summary>
    public event EventHandler? CloseRequested;

    public string Version { get; } = DisplayVersion(AppInfo.Version);

    /// <summary>The version without the build hash that follows a plus sign.</summary>
    public static string DisplayVersion(string full) => full.Split('+')[0] is { Length: > 0 } version ? version : "0.0.0";

    public bool DebugMode
    {
        get => _debugMode;
        set
        {
            if (_debugMode == value)
            {
                return;
            }

            _debugMode = value;
            _store.Save(new AppSettings(DebugMode: value));
            OnPropertyChanged();
            DebugModeChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
        }
    }

    [ObservableProperty]
    private bool _isForgetPending;

    /// <summary>The result of the last Forgetting; empty before one was asked for.</summary>
    [ObservableProperty]
    [NotifyPropertyChangedFor(nameof(HasForgetStatus))]
    private string _forgetStatusText = string.Empty;

    public bool HasForgetStatus => ForgetStatusText.Length > 0;

    [RelayCommand]
    private void RequestForget() => IsForgetPending = true;

    [RelayCommand]
    private void CancelForget() => IsForgetPending = false;

    /// <summary>Forgets everything the app saved: stops work, removes the stored data, then clears memory.</summary>
    [RelayCommand]
    private void ConfirmForget()
    {
        IsForgetPending = false;
        var result = _forgetting.Forget();
        ForgetStatusText = !result.StoredDataRemoved
            ? ForgetFailedText
            : result.IsComplete
                ? ForgetCompleteText
                : ForgetCompleteText + " Some data could not be removed: " + string.Join(", ", result.NotForgotten) + ".";
    }

    [RelayCommand]
    private void Close() => CloseRequested?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Shell/AvaloniaMainWindowHost.cs`:

```cs
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Threading;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Shell;

/// <summary>The real main window behind <see cref="IMainWindowHost"/>; does nothing until the window is attached. Safe to call from any thread.</summary>
public sealed class AvaloniaMainWindowHost : IMainWindowHost
{
    private Window? _window;

    /// <summary>Tells the host which window it controls.</summary>
    public void Attach(Window window) => _window = window;

    public void Show() => OnUiThread(() =>
    {
        if (_window is not { } window)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (!window.IsVisible)
        {
            window.Show();
        }

        if (window.WindowState == WindowState.Minimized)
        {
            window.WindowState = WindowState.Normal;
        }

        window.Activate();
    });

    public void Hide() => OnUiThread(() => _window?.Hide());

    private static void OnUiThread(Action action)
    {
        if (Dispatcher.UIThread.CheckAccess())
        {
            action();
        }
        else
        {
            Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(action);
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
    /// application or OS shutdown closes it.
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Shell/TrayController.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Debug;
using AqwCompanion.App.GameData;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Shell;

/// <summary>
/// The decisions behind the tray icon: closing the window hides it while the capture keeps running, the menu opens the
/// window, starts or stops the capture and really exits. It knows no Avalonia types.
/// </summary>
public sealed class TrayController
{
    /// <summary>The longest Exit waits for the capture devices to close.</summary>
    public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultStopTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3);

    private const string Name = "Questkeeper";

    private readonly CaptureSession _session;
    private readonly IMainWindowHost _window;
    private readonly IApplicationExit _exit;
    private readonly TimeSpan _stopTimeout;
    private readonly DebugModeController? _debug;
    private int _exiting;

    public TrayController(CaptureSession session, IMainWindowHost window, IApplicationExit exit, TimeSpan? stopTimeout = null, DebugModeController? debug = null)
    {
        _session = session;
        _window = window;
        _exit = exit;
        _stopTimeout = stopTimeout ?? DefaultStopTimeout;
        _debug = debug;
        _session.Changed += (_, _) => Changed?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
    }

    /// <summary>The session state or the characters changed (the session's event, re-raised; may come from any thread).</summary>
    public event EventHandler? Changed;

    /// <summary>True once Exit started; from then on a close is never turned into a hide.</summary>
    public bool IsExiting => Volatile.Read(ref _exiting) != 0;

    /// <summary>
    /// <paramref name="userInitiated"/> is true when the user pressed the close button, false for an OS shutdown, an
    /// application shutdown or an owner closing. Returns true when the close must be cancelled because the window was hidden instead.
    /// </summary>
    public bool ShouldCancelClose(bool userInitiated)
    {
        if (!userInitiated || IsExiting)
        {
            return false;
        }

        _window.Hide();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Shows the window.</summary>
    public void Open() => _window.Show();

    /// <summary>Opens or closes the debug window; does nothing when the app wired no debug mode.</summary>
    public void ToggleDebug() => _debug?.Toggle();

    /// <summary>Stops a listening capture; otherwise starts one without waiting for it to end.</summary>
    public void ToggleCapture()
    {
        if (_session.State == CaptureState.Listening)
        {
            _session.Stop();
        }
        else
        {
            _ = StartAsync();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Stops the capture (waiting at most the timeout for the devices to close), then exits. Safe to call twice.</summary>
    public async Task ExitAsync()
    {
        if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _exiting, 1) != 0)
        {
            return;
        }

        await _session.StopAndWaitAsync(_stopTimeout).ConfigureAwait(false);
        _exit.Exit();
    }

    /// <summary>The tray tooltip: the product name and what the capture is doing.</summary>
    public string ToolTip => Name + " - " + StateText();

    /// <summary>The text of the capture menu item.</summary>
    public string CaptureMenuText => _session.State == CaptureState.Listening ? "Stop capture" : "Start capture";

    private async Task StartAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            await _session.StartAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // The session reports its own failures through its state.
        }
    }

    private string StateText()
    {
        switch (_session.State)
        {
            case CaptureState.Listening:
                var captured = _session.Characters.Count(c => _session.IsCapturedThisSession(c.Profile.Name));
                return captured switch
                {
                    0 => "waiting for a login",
                    1 => "capturing, 1 character",
                    _ => "capturing, " + captured.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " characters",
                };
            case CaptureState.NpcapMissing:
                return "Npcap is not installed";
            case CaptureState.NeedsAdministrator:
                return "needs administrator rights";
            case CaptureState.Failed:
                return "capture failed";
            case CaptureState.NotSupported:
                return "capture not available";
            default:
                return "not capturing";
        }
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.App/Shell/TrayIconSetup.cs`:

```cs
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Platform;
using Avalonia.Threading;

namespace AqwCompanion.App.Shell;

/// <summary>
/// Builds the notification-area icon and its menu (Open, Start or Stop capture, Debug mode, Exit) over a <see cref="TrayController"/>.
/// Deliberately thin and not covered by tests: it needs a real desktop platform. Create and dispose it on the UI thread.
/// </summary>
public sealed class TrayIconSetup : IDisposable
{
    private readonly TrayController _controller;
    private readonly TrayIcon _icon;
    private readonly NativeMenuItem _capture;
    private bool _disposed;

    public TrayIconSetup(TrayController controller)
    {
        _controller = controller;
        _capture = new NativeMenuItem(controller.CaptureMenuText);
        _capture.Click += (_, _) => controller.ToggleCapture();
        var open = new NativeMenuItem("Open");
        open.Click += (_, _) => controller.Open();
        var debug = new NativeMenuItem("Debug mode");
        debug.Click += (_, _) => controller.ToggleDebug();
        var exit = new NativeMenuItem("Exit");
        exit.Click += (_, _) => _ = controller.ExitAsync();

        var menu = new NativeMenu();
        menu.Items.Add(open);
        menu.Items.Add(_capture);
        menu.Items.Add(debug);
        menu.Items.Add(new NativeMenuItemSeparator());
        menu.Items.Add(exit);

        _icon = new TrayIcon
        {
            Icon = new WindowIcon(AssetLoader.Open(new Uri("avares://" + AppInfo.ExeName + "/Assets/app.png"))),
            ToolTipText = controller.ToolTip,
            Menu = menu,
            IsVisible = true,
        };
        _icon.Clicked += (_, _) => controller.Open();
        controller.Changed += OnChanged;
    }

    /// <summary>The icon, for registering it with the application.</summary>
    public TrayIcon Icon => _icon;

    public void Dispose()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _disposed = true;
        _controller.Changed -= OnChanged;
        _icon.IsVisible = false;
        _icon.Dispose();
    }

    private void OnChanged(object? sender, EventArgs e)
    {
        if (Dispatcher.UIThread.CheckAccess())
        {
            Refresh();
        }
        else
        {
            Dispatcher.UIThread.Post(Refresh);
        }
    }

    private void Refresh()
    {
        if (_disposed)
        {
            return;
        }

        _icon.ToolTipText = _controller.ToolTip;
        _capture.Header = _controller.CaptureMenuText;
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Capture/LiveCaptureStats.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

namespace AqwCompanion.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// The thread-safe counters of one live capture run. Holds numbers and exception type names only: a device name, an address
/// or anything from a packet never goes in, so <see cref="Describe"/> is safe to show and to share.
/// </summary>
public sealed class LiveCaptureStats : ICaptureDiagnostics
{
    /// <summary>The most distinct exception type names kept per kind of failure.</summary>
    public const int MaxFailureTypes = 5;

    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private readonly List<string> _openFailures = [];
    private string? _driver;
    private long _found;
    private long _loopback;
    private long _considered;
    private long _opened;
    private long _failed;
    private long _packets;
    private long _parsed;
    private long _gamePort;

    /// <summary>Records how many devices the driver listed.</summary>
    public void DevicesFound(int count) => Interlocked.Add(ref _found, count);

    /// <summary>Records a device skipped because it is a loopback device.</summary>
    public void LoopbackSkipped() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _loopback);

    /// <summary>Records a non-loopback device the source tried to open.</summary>
    public void Considered() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _considered);

    /// <summary>Records a device that opened and started.</summary>
    public void Opened() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _opened);

    /// <summary>Records a device that could not be opened; only the exception type name is kept.</summary>
    public void OpenFailed(Exception exception)
    {
        Interlocked.Increment(ref _failed);
        var name = exception.GetType().Name;
        lock (_gate)
        {
            if (_openFailures.Count < MaxFailureTypes && !_openFailures.Contains(name))
            {
                _openFailures.Add(name);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Records a packet handed over by the driver, before any parsing.</summary>
    public void PacketFromDriver() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _packets);

    /// <summary>Records a packet accepted as IPv4/TCP.</summary>
    public void PacketParsed() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _parsed);

    /// <summary>Records an accepted packet whose ports are game ports.</summary>
    public void PacketOnGamePort() => Interlocked.Increment(ref _gamePort);

    /// <summary>Records that the driver is not available; with an exception only its type name is kept.</summary>
    public void DriverUnavailable(Exception? exception = null)
    {
        var text = exception is null ? "not found" : "not found (" + exception.GetType().Name + ")";
        lock (_gate)
        {
            _driver = text;
        }
    }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public string Describe()
    {
        try
        {
            string? driver;
            string failures;
            lock (_gate)
            {
                driver = _driver;
                failures = _openFailures.Count == 0 ? string.Empty : " (" + string.Join(", ", _openFailures) + ")";
            }

            var text = string.Create(
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                $"Devices: {Read(ref _found)} found, {Read(ref _loopback)} loopback skipped, {Read(ref _considered)} tried, {Read(ref _opened)} opened, {Read(ref _failed)} failed to open{failures}. Packets from the driver: {Read(ref _packets)}, parsed as TCP: {Read(ref _parsed)}, game port: {Read(ref _gamePort)}.");
            return driver is null ? text : "Driver: " + driver + ". " + text;
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }
    }

    private static long Read(ref long field) => Interlocked.Read(ref field);
}

```

`src/AqwCompanion.Capture/LivePacketSource.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;
using SharpPcap;
using SharpPcap.LibPcap;

namespace AqwCompanion.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// The live adapter of the packet source seam: SharpPcap over Npcap, on every non-loopback device that opens, filtered to the
/// game ports. A device that is down or cannot be opened is skipped (an adapter without traffic is harmless). Nothing touches
/// the driver until <see cref="RunAsync"/>, which does nothing when Npcap is not available, and returns at once when no device
/// could be opened so the caller can report it. The callback runs on capture threads (one at a time) and must not throw.
/// </summary>
public sealed class LivePacketSource : IPacketSource, ICaptureDiagnostics
{
    private readonly LiveCaptureStats _stats = new();

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public string Describe() => _stats.Describe();

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async Task RunAsync(Action<TcpSegment> onSegment, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (NpcapAvailability.Check() != NpcapStatus.Available)
        {
            _stats.DriverUnavailable();
            return;
        }

        var gate = new object();
        var opened = new List<ILiveDevice>();
        try
        {
            var devices = CaptureDeviceList.Instance;
            _stats.DevicesFound(devices.Count);
            foreach (var device in devices)
            {
                if (device is LibPcapLiveDevice { Loopback: true })
                {
                    _stats.LoopbackSkipped();
                }

                if (device is not LibPcapLiveDevice { Loopback: false } live)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                _stats.Considered();
                try
                {
                    live.Open(new DeviceConfiguration { Mode = DeviceModes.None, ReadTimeout = 100 });
                    live.Filter = GameTraffic.CaptureFilter;
                    live.OnPacketArrival += (_, packet) =>
                    {
                        _stats.PacketFromDriver();
                        if (!FrameParser.TryParse((int)packet.Device.LinkType, packet.Data, out var segment))
                        {
                            return;
                        }

                        _stats.PacketParsed();
                        if (GameTraffic.IsGamePort(segment.SourcePort) || GameTraffic.IsGamePort(segment.DestinationPort))
                        {
                            _stats.PacketOnGamePort();
                            lock (gate)
                            {
                                onSegment(segment);
                            }
                        }
                    };
                    live.StartCapture();
                    opened.Add(live);
                    _stats.Opened();
                }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is PcapException or InvalidOperationException or DllNotFoundException)
                {
                    _stats.OpenFailed(ex);
                    TryClose(live);
                }
            }

            if (opened.Count == 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            await Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is PcapException or DllNotFoundException or BadImageFormatException)
        {
            _stats.DriverUnavailable(ex);
        }
        finally
        {
            foreach (var device in opened)
            {
                TryClose(device);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void TryClose(ILiveDevice device)
    {
        try
        {
            device.StopCapture();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is PcapException or InvalidOperationException)
        {
        }

        try
        {
            device.Close();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is PcapException or InvalidOperationException)
        {
        }
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Capture/NpcapAvailability.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Capture;

/// <summary>Whether the Npcap driver the live capture needs is installed.</summary>
public enum NpcapStatus
{
    Available,
    Missing,

    /// <summary>Not Windows.</summary>
    NotSupported,
}

/// <summary>Detects Npcap by looking for its library on disk; never loads it.</summary>
public static class NpcapAvailability
{
    public const string DownloadUrl = "https://npcap.com/";

    /// <summary>Reads the file system only.</summary>
    public static NpcapStatus Check() =>
        Check(File.Exists, () => Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.System), OperatingSystem.IsWindows());

    public static NpcapStatus Check(Func<string, bool> fileExists, Func<string> systemDirectory, bool isWindows)
    {
        if (!isWindows)
        {
            return NpcapStatus.NotSupported;
        }

        var system = systemDirectory();
        return fileExists(Path.Combine(system, "Npcap", "wpcap.dll")) || fileExists(Path.Combine(system, "wpcap.dll"))
            ? NpcapStatus.Available
            : NpcapStatus.Missing;
    }
}
```

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// The shape of one unreadable message: sizes, the marker reading, a class of its first bytes and its entropy rounded to 0.1.
/// Never a byte, a value or a string of the message.
/// </summary>
public sealed record UnreadableSample(int EncodedLength, string Reading, int DecodedLength, string FirstBytes, double EntropyBits);

/// <summary>
/// A snapshot of how the connections went, as counts only, plus the shapes of the first few unreadable messages.
/// <see cref="ConnectionsWithSyn"/> counts the connections whose SYN-ACK was seen, so the start of their stream is known.
/// </summary>
public sealed record CaptureConnectionDiagnostics(
    int ConnectionsSeen,
    int ConnectionsWithSyn,
    int ConnectionsWithProfile,
    int ConnectionsWithInventory,
    int ConnectionsCompleted,
    IReadOnlyList<UnreadableSample> UnreadableSamples)
{
    /// <summary>The most samples ever kept: the first ones of the session.</summary>
    public const int MaxSamples = 6;

    /// <summary>Everything zero.</summary>
    public static CaptureConnectionDiagnostics Empty { get; } = new(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, []);
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// A snapshot of how the decoding went, as counts only: why messages could not be read, how many messages of each KNOWN protocol
/// command were read, and what became of the player's own profile. A command outside <see cref="KnownCommands"/> is counted
/// under <see cref="OtherCommand"/>; its name is kept in <see cref="OtherNames"/> only when it is made of letters, digits and
/// <c>_ + . -</c>, is at most <see cref="MaxNameLength"/> characters long, and fewer than <see cref="MaxOtherNames"/> distinct
/// names were kept already. Any other name is never kept.
/// </summary>
public sealed record CaptureDecodeDiagnostics(
    IReadOnlyDictionary<DecodeFailure, int> Failures,
    IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> Commands,
    int InitUserDataAccepted,
    int InitUserDataIgnored,
    int InitUserDataIgnoredNoGold,
    int InitUserDataIgnoredNoName,
    IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, int>> OtherNames)
{
    /// <summary>The key under which every command outside <see cref="KnownCommands"/> is counted.</summary>
    public const string OtherCommand = "other";

    /// <summary>The most distinct unknown command names kept.</summary>
    public const int MaxOtherNames = 40;

    /// <summary>The longest unknown command name that may be kept.</summary>
    public const int MaxNameLength = 40;

    /// <summary>The only command names the diagnostics may keep or show.</summary>
    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> KnownCommands =
    [
        "initUserData", "initUserDatas", "loadInventoryBig", "loadShop", "moveToArea", "sAct", "stu", "ct", "cb", "mtls",
        "uotls", "respawnMon", "equipItem", "wearItem", "unequipItem", "dropItem", "addItems", "getDrop", "addGoldExp",
        "updateClass", "loadPrefs", "loadWarVars", "mailList", "aura+p", "clearAuras", "auSnap", "sar", "sars", "bankToInv",
    ];

    /// <summary>Everything zero.</summary>
    public static CaptureDecodeDiagnostics Empty { get; } = new(
        Enum.GetValues<DecodeFailure>().ToDictionary(f => f, _ => 0),
        KnownCommands.Append(OtherCommand).ToDictionary(c => c, _ => 0),
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        []);

    /// <summary>
    /// True when the name may be listed: 1 to <see cref="MaxNameLength"/> characters out of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, <c>_</c>, <c>+</c>,
    /// <c>.</c> and <c>-</c>, and not one of the <see cref="KnownCommands"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static bool IsListableName(string? name)
    {
        if (name is null || name.Length is 0 or > MaxNameLength || KnownCommands.Contains(name) || name == OtherCommand)
        {
            return false;
        }

        foreach (var c in name)
        {
            var ok = c is >= 'A' and <= 'Z' or >= 'a' and <= 'z' or >= '0' and <= '9' or '_' or '+' or '.' or '-';
            if (!ok)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>How many messages failed for this reason.</summary>
    public int Failure(DecodeFailure reason) => Failures.TryGetValue(reason, out var count) ? count : 0;

    /// <summary>How many messages carried this command: a known name, or <see cref="OtherCommand"/>.</summary>
    public int Command(string name) => Commands.TryGetValue(name, out var count) ? count : 0;
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/CaptureEngine.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>Counts of what the engine did, never any content.</summary>
public readonly record struct CaptureCounters(int SegmentsSeen, int SegmentsDropped, int MessagesDecoded, int CharactersCaptured);

/// <summary>How far the server data got, as counts only: never a command name or any content.</summary>
public readonly record struct CaptureStageCounters(int MessagesUnreadable, int ProfilePartsSeen, int InventoryPartsSeen, int OtherCommandsRead);

/// <summary>
/// Turns the TCP segments of the game traffic into one <see cref="CharacterSnapshot"/> per connection. Only server-to-client
/// segments (source port is a game port) enter the pipeline; everything else is dropped before any buffer. A connection that has
/// produced both the profile and the inventory stays as a LIVE connection, bound to its Character, until its FIN or RST (or a new
/// SYN-ACK on the same address pair). On a live connection encoded blobs, text and XML are never decoded (only counted) and a plain
/// JSON message is parsed only when a bounded scan of its first bytes finds one of the <see cref="LiveUpdates.Commands"/>; every
/// other plain message contributes its command name to the counts and nothing else. Nothing is stored except the Allow-listed parts.
/// </summary>
public sealed class CaptureEngine(TimeProvider clock)
{
    public const int MaxConnections = 16;

    private const int MaxFinishedConnections = 1024;

    private readonly object _gate = new();
    private readonly Dictionary<ConnectionKey, Connection> _connections = [];
    private readonly HashSet<ConnectionKey> _finished = [];
    private readonly Queue<ConnectionKey> _finishedOrder = new();
    private int _segmentsSeen;
    private int _segmentsDropped;
    private int _messagesDecoded;
    private int _charactersCaptured;
    private int _messagesUnreadable;
    private int _profilePartsSeen;
    private int _inventoryPartsSeen;
    private int _otherCommandsRead;
    private readonly int[] _failures = new int[Enum.GetValues<DecodeFailure>().Length];
    private readonly int[] _commands = new int[CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.KnownCommands.Count + 1];
    private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _otherNames = [];
    private readonly List<string> _otherNameOrder = [];
    private int _initUserDataAccepted;
    private int _initUserDataIgnoredNoGold;
    private int _initUserDataIgnoredNoName;
    private int _initUserDataIgnoredOther;
    private int _connectionsSeen;
    private int _connectionsWithSyn;
    private int _connectionsWithProfile;
    private int _connectionsWithInventory;
    private int _connectionsCompleted;
    private readonly List<UnreadableSample> _samples = [];
    private int _liveEventsApplied;
    private int _liveEventsIgnored;
    private int _liveEventsUnmatched;
    private int _liveEncodedSkipped;
    private long _lastGoldGain;
    private long _lastExpGain;
    private long _tick;

    /// <summary>Raised once per connection when its profile and inventory are both known.</summary>
    public event Action<CharacterSnapshot>? CharacterCaptured;

    /// <summary>Raised with the new snapshot of a Character every time a live event changed it.</summary>
    public event Action<CharacterSnapshot>? CharacterUpdated;

    /// <summary>What the engine has seen and done so far.</summary>
    public CaptureCounters Counters
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return new CaptureCounters(_segmentsSeen, _segmentsDropped, _messagesDecoded, _charactersCaptured);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>How far the server data got so far; counts only.</summary>
    public CaptureStageCounters Stages
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return new CaptureStageCounters(_messagesUnreadable, _profilePartsSeen, _inventoryPartsSeen, _otherCommandsRead);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Why messages could not be read and which known commands were read; counts only, never any content; an unknown command name only when it passes <see cref="CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.IsListableName"/>.</summary>
    public CaptureDecodeDiagnostics Decoding
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                var failures = Enum.GetValues<DecodeFailure>().ToDictionary(f => f, f => _failures[(int)f]);
                var commands = new Dictionary<string, int>();
                for (var i = 0; i < CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.KnownCommands.Count; i++)
                {
                    commands[CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.KnownCommands[i]] = _commands[i];
                }

                commands[CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.OtherCommand] = _commands[^1];
                var ignored = _initUserDataIgnoredNoGold + _initUserDataIgnoredNoName + _initUserDataIgnoredOther;
                return new CaptureDecodeDiagnostics(
                    failures, commands, _initUserDataAccepted, ignored, _initUserDataIgnoredNoGold, _initUserDataIgnoredNoName,
                    [.. _otherNameOrder.Select(name => KeyValuePair.Create(name, _otherNames[name]))]);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>How the connections went and the shapes of the first unreadable messages; counts and classes only, never any content.</summary>
    public CaptureConnectionDiagnostics Connections
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return new CaptureConnectionDiagnostics(
                    _connectionsSeen, _connectionsWithSyn, _connectionsWithProfile, _connectionsWithInventory, _connectionsCompleted, [.. _samples]);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The live reading so far; numbers only.</summary>
    public CaptureLiveDiagnostics Live
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                return new CaptureLiveDiagnostics(
                    _connections.Values.Count(c => c.IsLive), _liveEventsApplied, _liveEventsIgnored, _liveEventsUnmatched,
                    _liveEncodedSkipped, _lastGoldGain, _lastExpGain);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>The sink for <see cref="IPacketSource.RunAsync"/>. Never throws.</summary>
    public void Accept(TcpSegment segment)
    {
        List<Notification>? notifications;
        try
        {
            lock (_gate)
            {
                notifications = Route(segment);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // Nothing from inside the pipeline may leave it, not even an exception.
            return;
        }

        if (notifications is null)
        {
            return;
        }

        foreach (var notification in notifications)
        {
            try
            {
                if (notification.Captured)
                {
                    CharacterCaptured?.Invoke(notification.Snapshot);
                }
                else
                {
                    CharacterUpdated?.Invoke(notification.Snapshot);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                // A failing subscriber must not stop the capture.
            }
        }
    }

    private List<Notification>? Route(TcpSegment segment)
    {
        _segmentsSeen++;
        _tick++;

        // Client-to-server segments (where the login travels) end here, before any buffer or decoder. A segment whose destination is
        // also a game port is ambiguous (a client whose own port falls in the game range): it is dropped as well.
        if (!GameTraffic.IsGamePort(segment.SourcePort) || GameTraffic.IsGamePort(segment.DestinationPort))
        {
            _segmentsDropped++;
            return null;
        }

        var key = ConnectionKey.From(segment);
        if (segment.IsSyn)
        {
            // The same address pair reused for a new connection: whatever a live connection knew is replaced.
            _finished.Remove(key);
            if (_connections.TryGetValue(key, out var old) && old.IsLive)
            {
                _connections.Remove(key);
            }
        }
        if (_finished.Contains(key))
        {
            _segmentsDropped++;
            return null;
        }

        if (!_connections.TryGetValue(key, out var connection))
        {
            if (_connections.Count >= MaxConnections && !(segment.IsSyn && EvictIdlestLiveConnection()))
            {
                _segmentsDropped++;
                return null;
            }
            connection = new Connection();
            _connections[key] = connection;
            _connectionsSeen++;
        }

        connection.LastTick = _tick;
        List<Notification>? notifications = null;

        if (segment.IsSyn && !connection.SawSyn)
        {
            connection.SawSyn = true;
            _connectionsWithSyn++;
        }

        foreach (var raw in connection.Reassembler.Feed(segment))
        {
            if (connection.IsLive)
            {
                ReadLive(connection, raw, ref notifications);
                continue;
            }

            using var message = MessageDecoder.TryDecode(raw, out var failure);
            if (message is null)
            {
                if (raw.Length > 0 && raw[0] != (byte)'%' && raw[0] != (byte)'<')
                {
                    _failures[(int)failure]++;
                    if (failure is DecodeFailure.NoCompressionHeader or DecodeFailure.InflateFailed or DecodeFailure.NotBase64
                        && _samples.Count < CaptureConnectionDiagnostics.MaxSamples)
                    {
                        var shape = MessageDecoder.Describe(raw);
                        _samples.Add(new UnreadableSample(raw.Length, shape.Reading, shape.DecodedLength, shape.FirstBytes, shape.EntropyBits));
                    }
                }

                if (raw.Length >= MessageDecoder.MinEncodedBytes && raw[0] != (byte)'%' && raw[0] != (byte)'<')
                {
                    _messagesUnreadable++;
                }

                continue;
            }

            _messagesDecoded++;
            var extracted = GameDataExtractor.Extract(message);
            CountCommand(message, extracted);
            switch (extracted)
            {
                case ProfilePart profile:
                    _profilePartsSeen++;
                    if (connection.Profile is null)
                    {
                        _connectionsWithProfile++;
                    }

                    connection.Profile = profile;
                    break;
                case InventoryPart inventory:
                    _inventoryPartsSeen++;
                    if (connection.Inventory is null)
                    {
                        _connectionsWithInventory++;
                    }

                    connection.Inventory = inventory;
                    break;
                default:
                    _otherCommandsRead++;
                    break;
            }

            if (connection.Profile is { } p && connection.Inventory is { } i)
            {
                var snapshot = new CharacterSnapshot(p.Profile, i.Factions, i.Items, i.HouseItems, clock.GetUtcNow());
                BecomeLive(key, connection, snapshot);
                _connectionsCompleted++;
                _charactersCaptured++;
                (notifications ??= []).Add(new Notification(true, snapshot));
            }
        }

        if (segment.IsFin || segment.IsRst)
        {
            // The server closed the connection (its data, if any, was read above): nothing more will come on it.
            Finish(key);
        }

        return notifications;
    }

    // The connection keeps its reassembler and is bound to its Character; an older live connection of the same Character goes.
    private void BecomeLive(ConnectionKey key, Connection connection, CharacterSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        foreach (var other in _connections.Where(c => c.Value.IsLive && c.Key != key
            && string.Equals(c.Value.Snapshot!.Profile.Name, snapshot.Profile.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList())
        {
            _connections.Remove(other.Key);
        }

        connection.Snapshot = snapshot;
        connection.Profile = null;
        connection.Inventory = null;
    }

    private bool EvictIdlestLiveConnection()
    {
        var idlest = _connections.Where(c => c.Value.IsLive).OrderBy(c => c.Value.LastTick).Select(c => (ConnectionKey?)c.Key).FirstOrDefault();
        if (idlest is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        _connections.Remove(idlest.Value);
        return true;
    }

    // One reassembled message of a live connection. Encoded blobs, text and XML are only counted. A plain JSON message is parsed
    // only when the bounded scan of its first bytes finds a live command; any other one contributes its name to the counts.
    private void ReadLive(Connection connection, byte[] raw, ref List<Notification>? notifications)
    {
        if (raw.Length == 0 || raw[0] != (byte)'{')
        {
            _liveEncodedSkipped++;
            return;
        }

        var name = LiveCommandScan.ReadName(raw);
        if (!LiveUpdates.IsLiveCommand(name))
        {
            CountCommandName(name);
            return;
        }

        CountCommandName(name);
        using var message = MessageDecoder.Decode(raw);
        if (message is null || !string.Equals(message.Command, name, StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            _liveEventsIgnored++;
            return;
        }

        var before = connection.Snapshot!;
        var result = LiveUpdates.Apply(before, message, connection.Cache);
        switch (result.Outcome)
        {
            case LiveUpdates.Applied:
                _liveEventsApplied++;
                break;
            case LiveUpdates.Unmatched:
                _liveEventsUnmatched++;
                break;
            default:
                _liveEventsIgnored++;
                break;
        }

        if (!result.Changed)
        {
            return;
        }

        if (name == "addGoldExp")
        {
            _lastGoldGain = result.Snapshot.Profile.Gold - before.Profile.Gold;
            _lastExpGain = result.Snapshot.Profile.Exp - before.Profile.Exp;
        }

        connection.Snapshot = result.Snapshot;
        (notifications ??= []).Add(new Notification(false, result.Snapshot));
    }

    // Only names from the fixed list are ever used as a command key; anything else is one number under "other", plus a
    // listing under its name when it has the restricted charset and there is room.
    private void CountCommand(GameMessage message, GameDataPart? extracted)
    {
        var index = CountCommandName(message.Command);
        if (index < 0 || message.Command != "initUserData")
        {
            return;
        }

        if (extracted is ProfilePart)
        {
            _initUserDataAccepted++;
        }
        else if (!HasProfileGold(message))
        {
            _initUserDataIgnoredNoGold++;
        }
        else if (!HasProfileName(message))
        {
            _initUserDataIgnoredNoName++;
        }
        else
        {
            _initUserDataIgnoredOther++;
        }
    }

    // Counts one message under its known command name, or under "other" (listing the name when it may be listed). Returns the index
    // of the known command, or -1.
    private int CountCommandName(string? name)
    {
        var index = -1;
        for (var i = 0; i < CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.KnownCommands.Count; i++)
        {
            if (string.Equals(CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.KnownCommands[i], name, StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                index = i;
                break;
            }
        }

        _commands[index < 0 ? ^1 : index]++;
        if (index < 0)
        {
            CountOtherName(name);
        }

        return index;
    }

    private void CountOtherName(string? name)
    {
        if (!CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.IsListableName(name))
        {
            return;
        }

        if (_otherNames.TryGetValue(name!, out var count))
        {
            _otherNames[name!] = count + 1;
        }
        else if (_otherNames.Count < CaptureDecodeDiagnostics.MaxOtherNames)
        {
            _otherNames[name!] = 1;
            _otherNameOrder.Add(name!);
        }
    }

    private static JsonElement? ProfileData(GameMessage message) =>
        message.Document.RootElement.TryGetProperty("b", out var b) && b.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
        && b.TryGetProperty("o", out var o) && o.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
        && o.TryGetProperty("data", out var data) && data.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object
            ? data
            : null;

    private static bool HasProfileGold(GameMessage message) => ProfileData(message)?.ReadLong("intGold") is not null;

    private static bool HasProfileName(GameMessage message) =>
        ProfileData(message)?.ReadCleanText("strUsername", GameDataExtractor.MaxCharacterNameLength) is not null;

    private void Finish(ConnectionKey key)
    {
        _connections.Remove(key);
        if (_finished.Add(key))
        {
            _finishedOrder.Enqueue(key);
        }
        while (_finishedOrder.Count > MaxFinishedConnections)
        {
            _finished.Remove(_finishedOrder.Dequeue());
        }
    }

    private readonly record struct Notification(bool Captured, CharacterSnapshot Snapshot);

    private sealed class Connection
    {
        public StreamReassembler Reassembler { get; } = new();

        /// <summary>The Character's newest snapshot once the login is complete; null before.</summary>
        public CharacterSnapshot? Snapshot { get; set; }

        public bool IsLive => Snapshot is not null;

        public LiveEventCache Cache { get; } = new();

        public long LastTick { get; set; }

        public bool SawSyn { get; set; }

        public ProfilePart? Profile { get; set; }

        public InventoryPart? Inventory { get; set; }
    }
}
```

```cs
/// <summary>Identifies one TCP connection by its endpoints; equality is by value.</summary>
public readonly record struct ConnectionKey(string Source, int SourcePort, string Destination, int DestinationPort)
{
    /// <summary>The key of the connection a segment belongs to, with the addresses as upper-case hex strings.</summary>
    public static ConnectionKey From(TcpSegment segment) =>
        new(
            Convert.ToHexString(segment.SourceAddress),
            segment.SourcePort,
            Convert.ToHexString(segment.DestinationAddress),
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/FrameParser.cs`:

```cs
using System.Buffers.Binary;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>Reads the TCP segment out of a captured link-layer frame.</summary>
public static class FrameParser
{
    private const int EthernetHeaderLength = 14;
    private const int VlanTagLength = 4;
    private const int BsdLoopbackHeaderLength = 4;
    private const ushort EtherTypeIpv4 = 0x0800;
    private const ushort EtherTypeVlan = 0x8100;
    private const int ProtocolTcp = 6;

    /// <summary>
    /// linkType is the pcap link type: 1 Ethernet, 0 BSD loopback (4-byte header), 12 and 101 raw IP.
    /// Handles one 802.1Q VLAN tag. IPv4 and TCP only; anything else, any malformed or truncated frame returns false.
    /// Never throws. The returned segment is NOT filtered by port.
    /// </summary>
    public static bool TryParse(int linkType, ReadOnlySpan<byte> frame, out TcpSegment segment)
    {
        segment = null!;
        int ipStart;
        switch (linkType)
        {
            case 1:
                if (!TryEthernetPayloadStart(frame, out ipStart))
                {
                    return false;
                }
                break;
            case 0:
                ipStart = BsdLoopbackHeaderLength;
                break;
            case 12:
            case 101:
                ipStart = 0;
                break;
            default:
                return false;
        }

        return ipStart <= frame.Length && TryParseIpv4(frame[ipStart..], out segment);
    }

    private static bool TryEthernetPayloadStart(ReadOnlySpan<byte> frame, out int start)
    {
        start = EthernetHeaderLength;
        if (frame.Length < EthernetHeaderLength)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var etherType = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(frame[12..]);
        if (etherType == EtherTypeVlan)
        {
            if (frame.Length < EthernetHeaderLength + VlanTagLength)
            {
                return false;
            }
            start += VlanTagLength;
            etherType = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(frame[16..]);
        }
        return etherType == EtherTypeIpv4;
    }

    private static bool TryParseIpv4(ReadOnlySpan<byte> ip, out TcpSegment segment)
    {
        segment = null!;
        if (ip.Length < 20 || ip[0] >> 4 != 4)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var ipHeaderLength = (ip[0] & 0x0F) * 4;
        if (ipHeaderLength < 20 || ip.Length < ipHeaderLength || ip[9] != ProtocolTcp)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var fragmentOffset = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(ip[6..]) & 0x1FFF;
        if (fragmentOffset != 0)
        {
            return false;
        }

        // The total length drops link-layer padding; a snapped (shorter) capture is read as far as it goes.
        var totalLength = Math.Min(BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(ip[2..]), ip.Length);
        if (totalLength < ipHeaderLength + 20)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var tcp = ip[ipHeaderLength..totalLength];
        var tcpHeaderLength = (tcp[12] >> 4) * 4;
        if (tcpHeaderLength < 20 || tcp.Length < tcpHeaderLength)
        {
            return false;
        }

        segment = new TcpSegment(
            ip.Slice(12, 4).ToArray(),
            BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(tcp),
            ip.Slice(16, 4).ToArray(),
            BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(tcp[2..]),
            BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32BigEndian(tcp[4..]),
            (tcp[13] & 0x02) != 0,
            tcp[tcpHeaderLength..].ToArray(),
            (tcp[13] & 0x01) != 0,
            (tcp[13] & 0x04) != 0);
        return true;
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/GameDataExtractor.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Reputation;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// The Allow list. Reads the few fields the app may keep out of a decoded game message and nothing else: every other field
/// (e-mail, IP, ids, dates, descriptions, other players) is never copied, so it cannot be stored, logged or shown.
/// </summary>
public static class GameDataExtractor
{
    public const int MaxFactions = 500;
    public const int MaxItems = 5000;
    public const int MaxNameLength = 200;
    public const int MaxTypeLength = 40;
    public const int MaxCharacterNameLength = 60;

    private const string InventoryCommand = "loadInventoryBig";
    private const string ProfileCommand = "initUserData";

    /// <summary>
    /// loadInventoryBig gives an InventoryPart; initUserData gives a ProfilePart only when b.o.data has intGold AND a non-empty
    /// strUsername (other players' profiles lack intGold); anything else gives null. Never throws.
    /// </summary>
    public static GameDataPart? Extract(GameMessage message)
    {
        try
        {
            var root = message.Document.RootElement;
            if (!root.TryGetProperty("b", out var b)
                || b.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object
                || !b.TryGetProperty("o", out var o)
                || o.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
            {
                return null;
            }

            return message.Command switch
            {
                InventoryCommand => ExtractInventory(o),
                ProfileCommand => ExtractProfile(o),
                _ => null,
            };
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // No content may leave the extractor, not even in an exception.
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static ProfilePart? ExtractProfile(JsonElement o)
    {
        if (!o.TryGetProperty("data", out var data) || data.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var gold = data.ReadLong("intGold");
        var name = data.ReadCleanText("strUsername", MaxCharacterNameLength);
        if (gold is null || name is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var profile = new CharacterProfile(
            name,
            Int(data, "intLevel"),
            Long(data, "intExp"),
            Long(data, "intExpToLevel"),
            Math.Max(0, gold.Value),
            Int(data, "intCoins"),
            Int(data, "iCP"),
            Int(data, "intDaysPlayed"),
            Int(data, "iBagSlots"),
            Int(data, "iBankSlots"),
            Int(data, "iHouseSlots"),
            Int(data, "iLoadoutSlots"),
            data.ReadFlag("iUpg") ?? false,
            SafeInt.Clamp(data.ReadLong("iUpgDays") ?? 0),
            Int(data, "iBoostXP"),
            Int(data, "iBoostG"),
            Int(data, "iBoostCP"),
            Int(data, "iBoostRep"));
        return new ProfilePart(profile);
    }

    private static int Int(JsonElement data, string property) => SafeInt.Clamp(Math.Max(0, data.ReadLong(property) ?? 0));

    private static long Long(JsonElement data, string property) => Math.Max(0, data.ReadLong(property) ?? 0);

    private static InventoryPart? ExtractInventory(JsonElement o)
    {
        var hasFactions = o.TryGetProperty("factions", out var factions) && factions.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array;
        var hasItems = o.TryGetProperty("items", out var items) && items.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array;
        var hasHouseItems = o.TryGetProperty("hitems", out var houseItems) && houseItems.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array;
        if (!hasFactions && !hasItems && !hasHouseItems)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return new InventoryPart(
            hasFactions ? ReadFactions(factions) : [],
            hasItems ? ReadItems(items, ItemFlags.None) : [],
            hasHouseItems ? ReadItems(houseItems, ItemFlags.House) : []);
    }

    private static List<FactionStanding> ReadFactions(JsonElement array)
    {
        var result = new List<FactionStanding>();
        var seen = new HashSet<int>();
        var visited = 0;
        foreach (var entry in array.EnumerateArray())
        {
            if (++visited > MaxFactions)
            {
                break;
            }

            if (entry.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var id = entry.ReadLong("FactionID");
            var name = entry.ReadCleanText("sName", MaxNameLength);
            var rep = entry.ReadLong("iRep");
            if (id is null or < 0 or > int.MaxValue || name is null || rep is null or < 0 || !seen.Add((int)id.Value))
            {
                continue;
            }

            result.Add(ReputationRank.Standing((int)id.Value, name, rep.Value));
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static List<OwnedItem> ReadItems(JsonElement array, ItemFlags always)
    {
        var result = new List<OwnedItem>();
        var visited = 0;
        foreach (var entry in array.EnumerateArray())
        {
            if (++visited > MaxItems)
            {
                break;
            }

            if (ReadItem(entry, always) is { } item)
            {
                result.Add(item);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>One item entry with its Allow-listed fields; null when it is not an object or has no name.</summary>
    internal static OwnedItem? ReadItem(JsonElement entry, ItemFlags always)
    {
        if (entry.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var name = entry.ReadCleanText("sName", MaxNameLength);
        if (name is null)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var classId = entry.ReadLong("ClassID");
        return new OwnedItem(
            name,
            entry.ReadCleanText("sType", MaxTypeLength) ?? string.Empty,
            Int(entry, "iQty"),
            Int(entry, "iStk"),
            Int(entry, "iLvl"),
            always | ReadFlags(entry),
            Int(entry, "ItemID"),
            classId is > 0 and <= int.MaxValue ? (int)classId.Value : null,
            Int(entry, "CharItemID"));
    }

    private static ItemFlags ReadFlags(JsonElement entry)
    {
        var flags = ItemFlags.None;
        flags |= Flag(entry, "bCoins", ItemFlags.Coins);
        flags |= Flag(entry, "bUpg", ItemFlags.Upgrade);
        flags |= Flag(entry, "bEquip", ItemFlags.Equipped);
        flags |= Flag(entry, "bWear", ItemFlags.Worn);
        flags |= Flag(entry, "bQuest", ItemFlags.Quest);
        flags |= Flag(entry, "bBank", ItemFlags.Bank);
        flags |= Flag(entry, "bHouse", ItemFlags.House);
        flags |= Flag(entry, "bTemp", ItemFlags.Temp);
        return flags;
    }

    private static ItemFlags Flag(JsonElement entry, string property, ItemFlags flag) =>
        entry.ReadFlag(property) == true ? flag : ItemFlags.None;
}
```

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>One decoded game message: its command and the parsed JSON, which lives only in memory until disposed.</summary>
public sealed class GameMessage : IDisposable
{

    {

        Document = document;
    }

    public JsonDocument Document { get; }

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public void Dispose() => Document.Dispose();
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/LenientJson.cs`:

```cs
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>Readers for the game's loose typing: numbers and flags arrive as JSON numbers, numeric strings, 0/1 or true/false.</summary>
internal static class LenientJson
{
    /// <summary>A whole number from a JSON number or a numeric string; null when missing or not a whole number.</summary>
    public static long? ReadLong(this JsonElement entry, string property)
    {
        if (entry.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object || !entry.TryGetProperty(property, out var value))
        {
            return null;
        }

        switch (value.ValueKind)
        {
            case JsonValueKind.Number:
                if (value.TryGetInt64(out var whole))
                {
                    return whole;
                }
                return value.TryGetDouble(out var fraction) && Math.Abs(fraction) < 9e18 ? (long)fraction : null;
            case JsonValueKind.String:
                return long.TryParse(value.GetString()?.Trim(), NumberStyles.Integer, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var parsed)
                    ? parsed
                    : null;
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>A flag from true/false, a number (non-zero is set) or the text "0", "1", "true", "false"; null when missing or unreadable.</summary>
    public static bool? ReadFlag(this JsonElement entry, string property)
    {
        if (entry.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object || !entry.TryGetProperty(property, out var value))
        {
            return null;
        }

        switch (value.ValueKind)
        {
            case JsonValueKind.True:
                return true;
            case JsonValueKind.False:
                return false;
            case JsonValueKind.Number:
                return value.TryGetDouble(out var number) ? number != 0 : null;
            case JsonValueKind.String:
                var text = value.GetString()?.Trim();
                if (text is "1" || string.Equals(text, "true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return true;
                }
                return text is "0" || string.Equals(text, "false", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? false : null;
            default:
                return null;
        }
    }
}

```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/LiveCommandScan.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// Reads the command name of a plain JSON message WITHOUT parsing it: the first <c>"cmd":"name"</c> within the first
/// <see cref="MaxScanBytes"/> bytes, where the name is 1 to <see cref="MaxNameLength"/> characters out of A-Z, a-z, 0-9,
/// <c>_ + . -</c>. Anything else gives null. Used on live connections so a message is only parsed when its command is one the
/// app handles.
/// </summary>
public static class LiveCommandScan
{
    /// <summary>How far into the message the name is looked for.</summary>
    public const int MaxScanBytes = 256;

    /// <summary>The longest name accepted.</summary>
    public const int MaxNameLength = 40;

    private static readonly byte[] Prefix = "\"cmd\":\""u8.ToArray();

    /// <summary>The command name in the first bytes of the message, or null.</summary>
    public static string? ReadName(ReadOnlySpan<byte> message)
    {
        var head = message[..Math.Min(message.Length, MaxScanBytes)];
        var at = head.IndexOf(Prefix);
        if (at < 0)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var start = at + Prefix.Length;
        for (var i = start; i < head.Length; i++)
        {
            var c = head[i];
            if (c == (byte)'"')
            {
                var length = i - start;
                return length is >= 1 and <= MaxNameLength ? Encoding.ASCII.GetString(head.Slice(start, length)) : null;
            }

            var allowed = c is >= (byte)'A' and <= (byte)'Z' or >= (byte)'a' and <= (byte)'z' or >= (byte)'0' and <= (byte)'9'
                or (byte)'_' or (byte)'+' or (byte)'.' or (byte)'-';
            if (!allowed || i - start >= MaxNameLength)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}
```
