`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/LiveEventCache.cs`:

```cs
using System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// The item definitions the game announced with <c>dropItem</c> on ONE connection, kept in memory only so the matching
/// <c>getDrop</c> can build the item. Holds at most <see cref="MaxDefinitions"/> of them; the newest wins and the oldest goes
/// first. Not thread safe: the engine uses it under its own lock.
/// </summary>
public sealed class LiveEventCache
{
    /// <summary>The most definitions kept per connection.</summary>
    public const int MaxDefinitions = 64;

    private readonly Dictionary<int, OwnedItem> _definitions = [];
    private readonly List<int> _order = [];

    /// <summary>How many definitions are kept.</summary>
    public int Count => _definitions.Count;

    /// <summary>Keeps the definition under its <see cref="OwnedItem.ItemId"/>, replacing an older one and dropping the oldest when full.</summary>
    public void Store(OwnedItem definition)
    {
        if (_definitions.ContainsKey(definition.ItemId))
        {
            _order.Remove(definition.ItemId);
        }
        else if (_definitions.Count >= MaxDefinitions)
        {
            _definitions.Remove(_order[0]);
            _order.RemoveAt(0);
        }

        _definitions[definition.ItemId] = definition;
        _order.Add(definition.ItemId);
    }

    /// <summary>The definition kept for this item id, if any.</summary>
    public bool TryGet(int itemId, [MaybeNullWhen(false)] out OwnedItem definition) =>
        _definitions.TryGetValue(itemId, out definition);
}

```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/LiveUpdates.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// What applying one event did. <see cref="Outcome"/> is one of the fixed words <see cref="LiveUpdates.Applied"/>,
/// <see cref="LiveUpdates.Ignored"/>, <see cref="LiveUpdates.Unmatched"/> or <see cref="LiveUpdates.Cached"/>, never any content.
/// <see cref="Snapshot"/> is the given snapshot itself when nothing changed.
/// </summary>
public sealed record LiveUpdateResult(CharacterSnapshot Snapshot, bool Changed, string Outcome);

/// <summary>
/// Applies the game's own events (gold and exp gained, items picked up, sold or changed, class points) to a snapshot. Pure: the
/// snapshot records are never mutated, a changed copy comes back. Only the fields named here are read from the message; every
/// other field of the event is never looked at, so nothing else can reach the result. Buying, quest rewards, reputation, level-ups,
/// trades and bank moves are not handled yet, so the snapshot can drift until the next login.
/// </summary>
public static class LiveUpdates
{
    /// <summary>
    /// ASSUMPTION, not yet confirmed against the game: <c>addGoldExp</c> carries the amounts GAINED by the event (deltas), not the
    /// new totals. The profile gold and exp are increased by them. The Game data tab shows the last amounts so the player can compare
    /// them with the game; if they turn out to be totals, this is the single place to change.
    /// </summary>
    public const bool GoldExpEventsCarryGains = true;

    /// <summary>The event changed (or confirmed) the snapshot.</summary>
    public const string Applied = "applied";

    /// <summary>The event is not one this module handles, lacks the fields it needs, or does not apply.</summary>
    public const string Ignored = "ignored";

    /// <summary>The event names an item the snapshot does not hold and no cached definition explains.</summary>
    public const string Unmatched = "unmatched";

    /// <summary>The event only taught the cache a dropped item definition.</summary>
    public const string Cached = "cached";

    /// <summary>The most entries of one event that are read.</summary>
    public const int MaxEntriesPerEvent = 64;

    private const ItemFlags DropFlags = ItemFlags.Coins | ItemFlags.Upgrade | ItemFlags.Quest | ItemFlags.Temp;

    /// <summary>The only commands the live reading opens.</summary>
    public static IReadOnlyList<string> Commands { get; } = ["addGoldExp", "addItems", "dropItem", "getDrop", "sellItem", "updateClass"];

    /// <summary>True when the command is one of <see cref="Commands"/>.</summary>
    public static bool IsLiveCommand(string? name) => name is not null && Commands.Contains(name);

    /// <summary>Applies one event. Never throws; an event that cannot be applied gives <see cref="Ignored"/> or <see cref="Unmatched"/> and the same snapshot.</summary>
    public static LiveUpdateResult Apply(CharacterSnapshot snapshot, GameMessage message, LiveEventCache cache)
    {
        try
        {
            if (!message.Document.RootElement.TryGetProperty("b", out var b)
                || b.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object
                || !b.TryGetProperty("o", out var o)
                || o.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
            {
                return Same(snapshot, Ignored);
            }

            return message.Command switch
            {
                "addGoldExp" => GoldExp(snapshot, o),
                "addItems" => AddItems(snapshot, o),
                "dropItem" => DropItem(snapshot, o, cache),
                "getDrop" => GetDrop(snapshot, o, cache),
                "sellItem" => SellItem(snapshot, o),
                "updateClass" => UpdateClass(snapshot, o),
                _ => Same(snapshot, Ignored),
            };
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // No content may leave this module, not even in an exception.
            return Same(snapshot, Ignored);
        }
    }

    private static LiveUpdateResult GoldExp(CharacterSnapshot snapshot, JsonElement o)
    {
        var gold = o.ReadLong("intGold");
        var exp = o.ReadLong("intExp");
        if (gold is null && exp is null)
        {
            return Same(snapshot, Ignored);
        }

        var profile = snapshot.Profile with
        {
            Gold = Add(snapshot.Profile.Gold, gold ?? 0),
            Exp = Add(snapshot.Profile.Exp, exp ?? 0),
        };
        return Result(snapshot, snapshot with { Profile = profile });
    }

    private static LiveUpdateResult AddItems(CharacterSnapshot snapshot, JsonElement o)
    {
        if (!o.TryGetProperty("items", out var items) || items.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
        {
            return Same(snapshot, Ignored);
        }

        List<OwnedItem>? edited = null;
        var matched = false;
        var visited = 0;
        foreach (var property in items.EnumerateObject())
        {
            if (++visited > MaxEntriesPerEvent)
            {
                break;
            }

            var id = property.Value.ReadLong("CharItemID") ?? (long.TryParse(property.Name, out var keyed) ? keyed : 0);
            var quantity = property.Value.ReadLong("iQtyNow");
            var index = IndexOf(edited ?? snapshot.Items, id);
            if (quantity is null || index < 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            edited ??= [.. snapshot.Items];
            edited[index] = edited[index] with { Quantity = Quantity(quantity.Value) };
            matched = true;
        }

        return matched ? Result(snapshot, snapshot with { Items = edited! }) : Same(snapshot, Unmatched);
    }

    private static LiveUpdateResult DropItem(CharacterSnapshot snapshot, JsonElement o, LiveEventCache cache)
    {
        if (!o.TryGetProperty("items", out var items) || items.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
        {
            return Same(snapshot, Ignored);
        }

        var cached = false;
        var visited = 0;
        foreach (var property in items.EnumerateObject())
        {
            if (++visited > MaxEntriesPerEvent)
            {
                break;
            }

            if (GameDataExtractor.ReadItem(property.Value, ItemFlags.None) is not { } definition)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var itemId = definition.ItemId > 0 ? definition.ItemId : int.TryParse(property.Name, out var keyed) && keyed > 0 ? keyed : 0;
            if (itemId == 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            cache.Store(definition with { ItemId = itemId, CharItemId = 0, Flags = definition.Flags & DropFlags });
            cached = true;
        }

        return Same(snapshot, cached ? Cached : Ignored);
    }

    private static LiveUpdateResult GetDrop(CharacterSnapshot snapshot, JsonElement o, LiveEventCache cache)
    {
        var quantity = o.ReadLong("iQtyNow") ?? o.ReadLong("iQty");
        if (o.ReadFlag("bSuccess") != true || quantity is null)
        {
            return Same(snapshot, Ignored);
        }

        var charItemId = o.ReadLong("CharItemID") ?? 0;
        var index = IndexOf(snapshot.Items, charItemId);
        if (index >= 0)
        {
            var edited = new List<OwnedItem>(snapshot.Items);
            edited[index] = edited[index] with { Quantity = Quantity(quantity.Value) };
            return Result(snapshot, snapshot with { Items = edited });
        }

        var itemId = o.ReadLong("ItemID") ?? 0;
        if (itemId <= 0 || itemId > int.MaxValue || !cache.TryGet((int)itemId, out var definition))
        {
            return Same(snapshot, Unmatched);
        }

        if (snapshot.Items.Count >= GameDataExtractor.MaxItems)
        {
            return Same(snapshot, Ignored);
        }

        var created = definition with
        {
            Quantity = Quantity(quantity.Value),
            CharItemId = charItemId is > 0 and <= int.MaxValue ? (int)charItemId : 0,
            Flags = definition.Flags | (o.ReadFlag("bBank") == true ? ItemFlags.Bank : ItemFlags.None),
        };
        return Result(snapshot, snapshot with { Items = [.. snapshot.Items, created] });
    }

    private static LiveUpdateResult SellItem(CharacterSnapshot snapshot, JsonElement o)
    {
        var amount = Math.Max(0, o.ReadLong("intAmount") ?? 0);
        var coins = o.ReadFlag("bCoins") == true;
        var index = IndexOf(snapshot.Items, o.ReadLong("CharItemID") ?? 0);
        if (index < 0 && amount == 0)
        {
            return Same(snapshot, Unmatched);
        }

        var items = snapshot.Items;
        if (index >= 0 && o.ReadLong("iQtyNow") is { } quantityNow)
        {
            var edited = new List<OwnedItem>(snapshot.Items);
            if (quantityNow <= 0)
            {
                edited.RemoveAt(index);
            }
            else
            {
                edited[index] = edited[index] with { Quantity = Quantity(quantityNow) };
            }

            items = edited;
        }

        var profile = coins
            ? snapshot.Profile with { Coins = SafeInt.Clamp(Add(snapshot.Profile.Coins, amount)) }
            : snapshot.Profile with { Gold = Add(snapshot.Profile.Gold, amount) };
        return Result(snapshot, snapshot with { Profile = profile, Items = items });
    }

    private static LiveUpdateResult UpdateClass(CharacterSnapshot snapshot, JsonElement o)
    {
        if (o.ReadLong("iCP") is not { } points)
        {
            return Same(snapshot, Ignored);
        }

        return Result(snapshot, snapshot with { Profile = snapshot.Profile with { ClassPoints = Quantity(points) } });
    }

    private static int IndexOf(IReadOnlyList<OwnedItem> items, long charItemId)
    {
        if (charItemId <= 0)
        {
            return -1;
        }

        for (var i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
        {
            if (items[i].CharItemId == charItemId)
            {
                return i;
            }
        }

        return -1;
    }

    private static int Quantity(long value) => SafeInt.Clamp(Math.Max(0, value));

    // Adds a gain to a total without overflow; the result is never below zero.
    private static long Add(long total, long delta)
    {
        if (delta > 0 && total > long.MaxValue - delta)
        {
            return long.MaxValue;
        }

        return Math.Max(0, total + delta);
    }

    private static LiveUpdateResult Result(CharacterSnapshot before, CharacterSnapshot after)
    {
        var changed = after.Profile != before.Profile || !ReferenceEquals(after.Items, before.Items);
        return new LiveUpdateResult(changed ? after : before, changed, Applied);
    }

    private static LiveUpdateResult Same(CharacterSnapshot snapshot, string outcome) => new(snapshot, false, outcome);
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/MessageDecoder.cs`:

```cs
using System.Buffers.Text;
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Text.Json;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// Turns one NUL-free message of the game stream into its command and parsed JSON, in memory only. A message is plain JSON
/// (starts with <c>{</c>) or an encoded blob: 0-8 marker characters, base64 (padding may be missing), then zlib or gzip whose
/// content is JSON. When no reading starts with a compression header, two fallbacks of the validated probe follow: a zlib or raw
/// deflate stream behind a binary header of up to 32 bytes (accepted only when the inflated data is mostly printable), and base64
/// inside base64 (one nested level). Text messages (<c>%xt%</c>), XML and anything else carry no allowed data and give nothing.
/// </summary>
public static class MessageDecoder
{
    public const int MaxEncodedBytes = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
    public const int MaxInflatedBytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
    public const int MaxJsonDepth = 16;
    public const int MinEncodedBytes = 40;

    private const int MaxCommandLength = 64;
    private const int MaxMarkerChars = 8;
    private const int MaxDroppedSuffixChars = 3;
    private const int MinBase64Chars = 8;
    private const int MaxHeaderOffset = 32;
    private const int PrintableProbeBytes = 200;

    /// <summary>
    /// null when: not JSON and not an encoded blob, a bound is exceeded, the JSON is invalid or has no b.o.cmd string. Never throws.
    /// </summary>
    public static GameMessage? Decode(ReadOnlySpan<byte> message) => TryDecode(message, out _);

    /// <summary>
    /// Like <see cref="Decode"/>, and when the result is null says how far the decoding got: the most advanced stage reached over
    /// all marker and padding readings. <paramref name="failure"/> is <see cref="DecodeFailure.None"/> when a message is returned.
    /// Never throws and never exposes any content.
    /// </summary>
    public static GameMessage? TryDecode(ReadOnlySpan<byte> message, out DecodeFailure failure)
    {
        failure = DecodeFailure.None;
        try
        {
            if (message.IsEmpty || message[0] == (byte)'%' || message[0] == (byte)'<')
            {
                failure = DecodeFailure.NotBlob;
                return null;
            }

            if (message.Length > MaxEncodedBytes)
            {
                failure = DecodeFailure.TooLarge;
                return null;
            }

            if (message[0] == (byte)'{')
            {
                return Parse(message.ToArray(), out failure);
            }

            if (message.Length < MinEncodedBytes)
            {
                failure = DecodeFailure.NotBlob;
                return null;
            }

            var inflated = InflateBlob(message, 0, out failure);
            return inflated is null ? null : Parse(inflated, out failure);
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            // No content may leave the decoder, not even in an exception.
            failure = DecodeFailure.InflateFailed;
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static GameMessage? Parse(byte[] json, out DecodeFailure failure)
    {
        failure = DecodeFailure.None;
        JsonDocument? document = null;
        try
        {
            document = JsonDocument.Parse(json, new JsonDocumentOptions { MaxDepth = MaxJsonDepth });
            var command = ReadCommand(document.RootElement);
            if (command is null)
            {
                document.Dispose();
                failure = DecodeFailure.NoCommand;
                return null;
            }

            return new GameMessage(command, document);
        }
        catch (JsonException)
        {
            document?.Dispose();
            failure = DecodeFailure.InvalidJson;
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static string? ReadCommand(JsonElement root)
    {
        if (root.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object
            || !root.TryGetProperty("b", out var b) || b.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object
            || !b.TryGetProperty("o", out var o) || o.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return o.ReadCleanText("cmd", MaxCommandLength);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Tries the marker and padding readings in the order of the validated probe; the first that inflates to JSON wins. When none
    /// does, the header offset and nested base64 fallbacks run on the first valid base64 reading. <paramref name="failure"/> is
    /// the most advanced stage any reading reached. <paramref name="depth"/> is the number of base64 levels already unwrapped.
    /// </summary>
    private static byte[]? InflateBlob(ReadOnlySpan<byte> raw, int depth, out DecodeFailure failure)
    {
        failure = DecodeFailure.NotBase64;
        byte[]? fallback = null;
        for (var dropLast = 0; dropLast <= MaxDroppedSuffixChars; dropLast++)
        {
            for (var dropFirst = 0; dropFirst <= MaxMarkerChars; dropFirst++)
            {
                var length = raw.Length - dropFirst - dropLast;
                if (length < MinBase64Chars)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var blob = DecodeBase64(raw.Slice(dropFirst, length));
                if (blob is null)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                fallback ??= blob;
                failure = Advance(failure, DecodeFailure.NoCompressionHeader);
                var result = TryInflate(blob);
                if (result.Overflow)
                {
                    failure = DecodeFailure.TooBigWhenInflated;
                    return null;
                }

                if (result.HasHeader)
                {
                    failure = Advance(failure, DecodeFailure.InflateFailed);
                }

                if (result.Data is { Length: > 0 } data)
                {
                    if (data[0] == (byte)'{')
                    {
                        failure = DecodeFailure.None;
                        return data;
                    }

                    failure = Advance(failure, DecodeFailure.InflatedNotJson);
                }
            }
        }

        return fallback is null ? null : TryFallbacks(fallback, depth, ref failure);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The two fallbacks of the probe on one decoded reading: a stream behind a binary header of 0-32 bytes (zlib, then raw deflate
    /// at each offset; at most 66 bounded inflates), then base64 inside base64 when the bytes are more than 95% printable.
    /// </summary>
    private static byte[]? TryFallbacks(byte[] blob, int depth, ref DecodeFailure failure)
    {
        for (var offset = 0; offset <= MaxHeaderOffset && offset < blob.Length; offset++)
        {
            foreach (var kind in new[] { StreamKind.Raw, StreamKind.ZLib })
            {
                var result = Inflate(blob, offset, kind);
                if (result.Overflow)
                {
                    failure = DecodeFailure.TooBigWhenInflated;
                    return null;
                }

                if (result.Data is not { Length: > 0 } data || !MostlyPrintable(data.AsSpan(0, Math.Min(data.Length, PrintableProbeBytes)), 0.9))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (data[0] == (byte)'{')
                {
                    failure = DecodeFailure.None;
                    return data;
                }

                failure = Advance(failure, DecodeFailure.InflatedNotJson);
            }
        }

        if (depth == 0 && MostlyPrintable(blob, 0.95, strictlyMore: true))
        {
            var inner = InflateBlob(blob, depth + 1, out var innerFailure);
            if (inner is not null)
            {
                failure = DecodeFailure.None;
                return inner;
            }

            failure = Advance(failure, innerFailure);
        }

        return null;
    }

    private static bool MostlyPrintable(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, double share, bool strictlyMore = false)
    {
        var printable = 0;
        foreach (var b in data)
        {
            if (b is >= 32 and < 127 or 9 or 10 or 13)
            {
                printable++;
            }
        }

        var ratio = printable / (double)Math.Max(1, data.Length);
        return strictlyMore ? ratio > share : printable >= share * data.Length;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Describes the shape of an unreadable message as classes and numbers only: which marker reading gave valid base64 (the
    /// first with a zlib or gzip header, else the first valid one), the decoded size, the class of its first bytes and its entropy.
    /// Never throws and exposes no content.
    /// </summary>
    public static BlobShape Describe(ReadOnlySpan<byte> raw)
    {
        try
        {
            if (raw.Length > MaxEncodedBytes)
            {
                return BlobShape.NotDecoded;
            }

            (byte[] Blob, int DropFirst)? first = null;
            (byte[] Blob, int DropFirst)? headed = null;
            for (var dropLast = 0; dropLast <= MaxDroppedSuffixChars && headed is null; dropLast++)
            {
                for (var dropFirst = 0; dropFirst <= MaxMarkerChars && headed is null; dropFirst++)
                {
                    var length = raw.Length - dropFirst - dropLast;
                    var blob = length < MinBase64Chars ? null : DecodeBase64(raw.Slice(dropFirst, length));
                    if (blob is null)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    first ??= (blob, dropFirst);
                    if (HeaderClass(blob) is "zlib header" or "gzip header")
                    {
                        headed = (blob, dropFirst);
                    }
                }
            }

            if ((headed ?? first) is not { } chosen)
            {
                return BlobShape.NotDecoded;
            }

            return new BlobShape(
                $"drop-first-{chosen.DropFirst}",
                chosen.Blob.Length,
                chosen.Blob.Length == 0 ? "empty" : HeaderClass(chosen.Blob),
                Math.Round(Entropy(chosen.Blob), 1));
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return BlobShape.NotDecoded;
        }
    }

    private static string HeaderClass(byte[] blob)
    {
        if (blob.Length >= 2 && blob[0] == 0x78 && blob[1] is 0x01 or 0x5E or 0x9C or 0xDA)
        {
            return "zlib header";
        }

        if (blob.Length >= 2 && blob[0] == 0x1F && blob[1] == 0x8B)
        {
            return "gzip header";
        }

        return MostlyPrintable(blob.AsSpan(0, Math.Min(blob.Length, PrintableProbeBytes)), 0.95) ? "printable text" : "binary";
    }

    private static double Entropy(byte[] data)
    {
        if (data.Length == 0)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        var counts = new int[256];
        foreach (var b in data)
        {
            counts[b]++;
        }

        var entropy = 0.0;
        foreach (var count in counts)
        {
            if (count > 0)
            {
                var p = count / (double)data.Length;
                entropy -= p * Math.Log2(p);
            }
        }

        return entropy;
    }

    // The enum lists the stages in the order a message passes through them.
    private static DecodeFailure Advance(DecodeFailure current, DecodeFailure reached) => reached > current ? reached : current;

    private static byte[]? DecodeBase64(ReadOnlySpan<byte> text)
    {
        var missing = -text.Length & 3;
        if (missing == 3)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var padded = new byte[text.Length + missing];
        text.CopyTo(padded);
        padded.AsSpan(text.Length).Fill((byte)'=');

        var decoded = new byte[Base64.GetMaxDecodedFromUtf8Length(padded.Length)];
        return Base64.DecodeFromUtf8(padded, decoded, out _, out var written) == System.Buffers.OperationStatus.Done
            ? decoded.AsSpan(0, written).ToArray()
            : null;
    }

    private readonly record struct InflateResult(byte[]? Data, bool Overflow, bool HasHeader);

    private enum StreamKind
    {
        ZLib,
        GZip,
        Raw,
    }

    private static InflateResult TryInflate(byte[] blob)
    {
        if (blob.Length >= 2 && blob[0] == 0x78 && blob[1] is 0x01 or 0x5E or 0x9C or 0xDA)
        {
            return Inflate(blob, 0, StreamKind.ZLib) with { HasHeader = true };
        }

        if (blob.Length >= 2 && blob[0] == 0x1F && blob[1] == 0x8B)
        {
            return Inflate(blob, 0, StreamKind.GZip) with { HasHeader = true };
        }

        return default;
    }

    /// <summary>Inflates the bytes from <paramref name="offset"/> on through the bounded reader; a failure gives no data.</summary>
    private static InflateResult Inflate(byte[] blob, int offset, StreamKind kind)
    {
        Stream? decompressor = null;
        try
        {
            var input = new MemoryStream(blob, offset, blob.Length - offset, writable: false);
            decompressor = kind switch
            {
                StreamKind.ZLib => new ZLibStream(input, CompressionMode.Decompress),
                StreamKind.GZip => new GZipStream(input, CompressionMode.Decompress),
                _ => new DeflateStream(input, CompressionMode.Decompress),
            };
            return ReadBounded(decompressor);
        }
        catch (InvalidDataException)
        {
            return new InflateResult(null, false, true);
        }
        catch (IOException)
        {
            return new InflateResult(null, false, true);
        }
        finally
        {
            decompressor?.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Reads at most <see cref="MaxInflatedBytes"/> bytes; one more byte means the stream is too big.</summary>
    private static InflateResult ReadBounded(Stream stream)
    {
        using var output = new MemoryStream();
        var buffer = new byte[16 * 1024];
        while (true)
        {
            var room = MaxInflatedBytes + 1 - (int)output.Length;
            var read = stream.Read(buffer, 0, Math.Min(buffer.Length, room));
            if (read == 0)
            {
                return new InflateResult(output.ToArray(), false, true);
            }

            output.Write(buffer, 0, read);
            if (output.Length > MaxInflatedBytes)
            {
                return new InflateResult(null, true, true);
            }
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// The shape of an unreadable message, never its content: <see cref="Reading"/> is <c>none</c> or <c>drop-first-N</c>,
/// <see cref="FirstBytes"/> one of <c>zlib header</c>, <c>gzip header</c>, <c>printable text</c>, <c>binary</c>, <c>empty</c>.
/// </summary>
public readonly record struct BlobShape(string Reading, int DecodedLength, string FirstBytes, double EntropyBits)
{
    /// <summary>No marker and padding reading gave valid base64.</summary>
    public static BlobShape NotDecoded { get; } = new("none", 0, "empty", 0);
}

/// <summary>Why <see cref="MessageDecoder.TryDecode"/> gave nothing: the most advanced stage reached, in the order of the stages.</summary>
public enum DecodeFailure
{
    /// <summary>A message was decoded.</summary>
    None,

    /// <summary>Starts with <c>%</c> or <c>&lt;</c> (text and XML), is empty or is shorter than the minimum encoded size.</summary>
    NotBlob,

    /// <summary>Longer than the encoded size cap.</summary>
    TooLarge,

    /// <summary>No marker and padding reading produced valid base64.</summary>
    NotBase64,

    /// <summary>Valid base64 under some reading, but none began with a zlib or gzip header.</summary>
    NoCompressionHeader,

    /// <summary>A compression header was found but inflating failed under every reading.</summary>
    InflateFailed,

    /// <summary>The inflated size cap was hit.</summary>
    TooBigWhenInflated,

    /// <summary>Inflated, but the content does not start with <c>{</c>.</summary>
    InflatedNotJson,

    /// <summary>A JSON parse error, or deeper than the depth cap.</summary>
    InvalidJson,

    /// <summary>Valid JSON without a <c>b.o.cmd</c> string.</summary>
    NoCommand,
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/PcapStreamSource.cs`:

```cs
using System.Buffers.Binary;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// The pcap file adapter of the packet source seam: reads a classic pcap stream (microsecond or nanosecond,
/// either byte order) one record at a time and delivers the game-port TCP segments.
/// </summary>
public sealed class PcapStreamSource(Stream pcap) : IPacketSource
{
    private const int GlobalHeaderLength = 24;
    private const int RecordHeaderLength = 16;
    private const int MaxRecordLength = 1 << 18;

    /// <inheritdoc />
    public async Task RunAsync(Action<TcpSegment> onSegment, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            var header = new byte[GlobalHeaderLength];
            if (!await ReadExactAsync(header, cancellationToken))
            {
                return;
            }

            var magic = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32LittleEndian(header);
            bool bigEndian;
            switch (magic)
            {
                case 0xA1B2C3D4 or 0xA1B23C4D:
                    bigEndian = false;
                    break;
                case 0xD4C3B2A1 or 0x4D3CB2A1:
                    bigEndian = true;
                    break;
                default:
                    return;
            }

            var linkType = (int)ReadUInt32(header.AsSpan(20), bigEndian);
            var recordHeader = new byte[RecordHeaderLength];
            var data = new byte[4096];

            while (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                if (!await ReadExactAsync(recordHeader, cancellationToken))
                {
                    return;
                }

                var length = ReadUInt32(recordHeader.AsSpan(8), bigEndian);
                if (length > MaxRecordLength)
                {
                    return;
                }
                if (data.Length < length)
                {
                    data = new byte[(int)length];
                }
                if (!await ReadExactAsync(data.AsMemory(0, (int)length), cancellationToken))
                {
                    return;
                }

                if (FrameParser.TryParse(linkType, data.AsSpan(0, (int)length), out var segment)
                    && (GameTraffic.IsGamePort(segment.SourcePort) || GameTraffic.IsGamePort(segment.DestinationPort)))
                {
                    onSegment(segment);
                }
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
        }
        catch (IOException)
        {
        }
        catch (ObjectDisposedException)
        {
        }
    }

    private static uint ReadUInt32(ReadOnlySpan<byte> bytes, bool bigEndian) =>
        bigEndian ? BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32BigEndian(bytes) : BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32LittleEndian(bytes);

    private async ValueTask<bool> ReadExactAsync(Memory<byte> buffer, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var read = 0;
        while (read < buffer.Length)
        {
            var n = await pcap.ReadAsync(buffer[read..], cancellationToken);
            if (n == 0)
            {
                return false;
            }
            read += n;
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/ReputationRank.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Reputation;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>The Wiki's reputation rank table: the rank and the progress inside it, from the total reputation of a faction.</summary>
public static class ReputationRank
{
    // Combined totals at which ranks 2-10 start.
    private static readonly long[] RankStarts = [900, 3600, 10000, 22500, 44100, 78400, 129600, 202500, 302500];

    // The increment each of ranks 1-9 needs to reach the next one.
    private static readonly int[] Increments = [900, 2700, 6400, 12500, 21600, 34300, 51200, 72900, 100000];

    /// <summary>
    /// Rank 1-10 from the total. Rep is the total (clamped to int, never negative); SpillRep is the total minus the combined
    /// total of the current rank; RepToRank is the increment the current rank needs, 0 at rank 10 (SpillRep 0 there too).
    /// </summary>
    public static FactionStanding Standing(int factionId, string name, long totalRep)
    {
        var total = Math.Max(0, totalRep);
        var index = 0;
        while (index < RankStarts.Length && total >= RankStarts[index])
        {
            index++;
        }

        var rank = index + 1;
        if (rank == RankStarts.Length + 1)
        {
            return new FactionStanding(factionId, name, rank, SafeInt.Clamp(total), 0, 0);
        }

        var rankStart = index == 0 ? 0 : RankStarts[index - 1];
        return new FactionStanding(factionId, name, rank, SafeInt.Clamp(total), Increments[index], SafeInt.Clamp(total - rankStart));
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Capture/StreamReassembler.cs`:

```cs
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

/// <summary>
/// Rebuilds the byte stream of ONE direction (server to client) of ONE connection from its TCP segments and cuts it into
/// NUL-terminated messages. Tolerates retransmitted and out-of-order segments; all sequence arithmetic is modular 32-bit.
/// Keeps no more than <see cref="MaxBufferBytes"/> and never throws for any input.
/// </summary>
public sealed class StreamReassembler
{
    public const int MaxBufferBytes = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
    public const int MaxMessageBytes = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
    public const int MaxPendingSegments = 200;

    private const uint HalfRange = 0x80000000;

    private readonly List<byte> _buffer = [];
    private readonly Dictionary<uint, byte[]> _pending = [];
    private long _pendingBytes;
    private uint _next;
    private bool _started;
    private bool _discarding;

    /// <summary>Feeds a segment; returns the complete NUL-terminated messages it finished (without the NUL, empty ones skipped).</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<byte[]> Feed(TcpSegment segment)
    {
        var messages = new List<byte[]>();
        if (segment.IsSyn)
        {
            Reset();
            _next = unchecked(segment.Sequence + 1);
            _started = true;
            return messages;
        }

        var payload = segment.Payload;
        if (payload.Length == 0)
        {
            return messages;
        }

        var sequence = segment.Sequence;
        if (!_started)
        {
            _next = sequence;
            _started = true;
        }

        var diff = unchecked(sequence - _next);
        if (diff != 0 && diff >= HalfRange)
        {
            // Behind the expected position: a retransmission, possibly with new bytes at its end.
            var overlap = unchecked(_next - sequence);
            if (overlap >= payload.Length)
            {
                return messages;
            }
            payload = payload[(int)overlap..];
            sequence = _next;
            diff = 0;
        }

        if (diff != 0)
        {
            Hold(sequence, payload);
            if (_pending.Count <= MaxPendingSegments && _pendingBytes <= MaxBufferBytes)
            {
                return messages;
            }

            // A real gap: resume at the closest held segment and drop the partial message in the buffer.
            var closest = _pending.Keys.MinBy(k => unchecked(k - _next));
            payload = Take(closest);
            sequence = closest;
            _buffer.Clear();
            _discarding = false;
            _next = sequence;
        }

        Append(payload, messages);
        DrainPending(messages);
        return messages;
    }

    private void Reset()
    {
        _buffer.Clear();
        _pending.Clear();
        _pendingBytes = 0;
        _discarding = false;
    }

    private void Hold(uint sequence, byte[] payload)
    {
        if (_pending.TryGetValue(sequence, out var existing))
        {
            if (existing.Length >= payload.Length)
            {
                return;
            }
            _pendingBytes -= existing.Length;
        }
        _pending[sequence] = payload;
        _pendingBytes += payload.Length;
    }

    private byte[] Take(uint sequence)
    {
        var payload = _pending[sequence];
        _pending.Remove(sequence);
        _pendingBytes -= payload.Length;
        return payload;
    }

    private void DrainPending(List<byte[]> messages)
    {
        while (_pending.Count > 0)
        {
            uint? ready = null;
            foreach (var key in _pending.Keys)
            {
                var diff = unchecked(key - _next);
                if (diff == 0 || diff >= HalfRange)
                {
                    ready = key;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (ready is not { } sequence)
            {
                return;
            }

            var piece = Take(sequence);
            var overlap = unchecked(_next - sequence);
            if (overlap < piece.Length)
            {
                Append(piece.AsSpan((int)overlap), messages);
            }
        }
    }

    private void Append(ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, List<byte[]> messages)
    {
        _next = unchecked(_next + (uint)data.Length);
        while (!data.IsEmpty)
        {
            var nul = data.IndexOf((byte)0);
            if (nul < 0)
            {
                if (!_discarding)
                {
                    if (_buffer.Count + data.Length > MaxMessageBytes)
                    {
                        // No NUL within the largest message allowed: drop it and skip to the next NUL.
                        _buffer.Clear();
                        _discarding = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _buffer.AddRange(data);
                    }
                }
                return;
            }

            var piece = data[..nul];
            data = data[(nul + 1)..];
            if (_discarding)
            {
                _discarding = false;
                continue;
            }

            if (_buffer.Count + piece.Length <= MaxMessageBytes && _buffer.Count + piece.Length > 0)
            {
                var message = new byte[_buffer.Count + piece.Length];
                CollectionsMarshal.AsSpan(_buffer).CopyTo(message);
                piece.CopyTo(message.AsSpan(_buffer.Count));
                messages.Add(message);
            }
            _buffer.Clear();
        }
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Common/JsonElementReader.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Common;

/// <summary>Tolerant readers for the properties of a JSON object: a wrong shape gives null instead of an exception.</summary>
public static class JsonElementReader
{
    /// <summary>The cleaned string value, or null when the property is missing, not a string or blank after cleaning.</summary>
    public static string? ReadCleanText(this JsonElement entry, string property, int maxLength)
    {
        if (!entry.TryGetProperty(property, out var value) || value.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String)
        {
            return null;
        }

        var text = TextCleaner.Clean(value.GetString(), maxLength);
        return text.Length == 0 ? null : text;
    }

    /// <summary>A whole, non-negative number that fits an int; anything else (missing, text, fraction, too big) is null.</summary>
    public static int? ReadNonNegativeInt32(this JsonElement entry, string property) =>
        entry.TryGetProperty(property, out var value)
        && value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Number
        && value.TryGetInt32(out var number)
        && NumberParsing.IsNonNegative(number)
            ? number
            : null;
}
```

```cs
using System.Globalization;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Common;

/// <summary>Number checks and parsing shared by the page parsers.</summary>
public static class NumberParsing
{
    /// <summary>True for zero and every positive number.</summary>
    public static bool IsNonNegative(int value) => value >= 0;

    /// <summary>Parses trimmed text as a whole, non-negative int, ignoring the current culture; false for null, junk or a negative number.</summary>
    public static bool TryParseNonNegativeInt(string? text, NumberStyles styles, out int value) =>
        int.TryParse(text?.Trim(), styles, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out value) && IsNonNegative(value);
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Common/TextCleaner.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Common;

/// <summary>Cleans text read from a page so it is safe to keep: no control characters, trimmed and capped.</summary>
public static class TextCleaner
{
    /// <summary>
    /// The text without control characters, trimmed and capped to <paramref name="maxLength"/>; empty when nothing visible is left.
    /// The cap never leaves half of a surrogate pair behind, which is not valid UTF-16 and cannot be stored as JSON.
    /// </summary>
    public static string Clean(string? value, int maxLength)
    {
        var text = new string((value ?? string.Empty).Where(c => !char.IsControl(c)).ToArray()).Trim();
        if (text.Length <= maxLength)
        {
            return text;
        }

        if (maxLength <= 0)
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var cut = char.IsHighSurrogate(text[maxLength - 1]) ? maxLength - 1 : maxLength;
        return text[..cut];
    }

    /// <summary>The trimmed text, or null when it is null or only white space.</summary>
    public static string? NonBlank(string? value) =>
        string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) ? null : value.Trim();
}
```

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Diagnostics;

public static class CrashReportWriter
{
    public static string Write(
        Exception exception,
        string directory,
        string appVersion,
        DateTimeOffset now,
        SnapshotRedactor? redactor = null)
    {
        redactor ??= new SnapshotRedactor();
        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        var path = Path.Combine(directory, $"crash-{now:yyyyMMdd-HHmmssfff}.txt");
        var text = $"AppVersion: {appVersion}{Environment.NewLine}Time: {now:O}{Environment.NewLine}{Environment.NewLine}{redactor.Redact(ExceptionSummary.Describe(exception))}";
        File.WriteAllText(path, text);
        return path;
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Diagnostics/DiagnosticsExporter.cs`:

```cs
using System.IO.Compression;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Text;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Diagnostics;

public sealed record DiagnosticsRequest(
    string LogDirectory,
    string AppVersion,
    string OutputPath);

public sealed class DiagnosticsExporter(SnapshotRedactor redactor)
{
    private const int MaxLogFiles = 3;

    public string Export(DiagnosticsRequest request)
    {
        var outputPath = Path.GetFullPath(request.OutputPath);
        var tempPath = outputPath + ".tmp";
        var logs = RecentLogs(request.LogDirectory).ToList();
        RejectOutputThatIsALog(logs, outputPath, tempPath);

        Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(outputPath)!);

        try
        {
            using (var file = new FileStream(tempPath, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write))
            using (var zip = new ZipArchive(file, ZipArchiveMode.Create))
            {
                WriteText(zip, "info.txt", BuildInfo(request));

                foreach (var logFile in logs)
                {
                    WriteText(zip, $"logs/{Path.GetFileName(logFile)}", redactor.Redact(ReadShared(logFile)));
                }
            }

            File.Move(tempPath, outputPath, overwrite: true);
        }
        catch
        {
            TryDelete(tempPath);
            throw;
        }

        return request.OutputPath;
    }

    private static void RejectOutputThatIsALog(IEnumerable<string> logs, string outputPath, string tempPath)
    {
        var comparison = OperatingSystem.IsWindows() || OperatingSystem.IsMacOS()
            ? StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase
            : StringComparison.Ordinal;

        foreach (var log in logs.Select(Path.GetFullPath))
        {
            if (string.Equals(log, outputPath, comparison) || string.Equals(log, tempPath, comparison))
            {
                throw new ArgumentException("The output path must not be one of the log files being exported.", nameof(outputPath));
            }
        }
    }

    private static void TryDelete(string path)
    {
        try
        {
            File.Delete(path);
        }
        catch (IOException)
        {
        }
        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)
        {
        }
    }

    private static string BuildInfo(DiagnosticsRequest request)
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        sb.AppendLine($"AppVersion: {request.AppVersion}");
        sb.AppendLine($"GeneratedAt: {DateTimeOffset.UtcNow:O}");
        sb.AppendLine($"OS: {RuntimeInformation.OSDescription}");
        sb.AppendLine($"Runtime: {RuntimeInformation.FrameworkDescription}");
        return sb.ToString();
    }

    private static IEnumerable<string> RecentLogs(string directory) =>
        Directory.Exists(directory)
            ? Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "*.txt")
                .OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc)
                .Take(MaxLogFiles)
            : [];

    private static string ReadShared(string path)
    {
        using var stream = new FileStream(path, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite | FileShare.Delete);
        using var reader = new StreamReader(stream);
        return reader.ReadToEnd();
    }

    private static void WriteText(ZipArchive zip, string name, string text)
    {
        var entry = zip.CreateEntry(name);
        using var writer = new StreamWriter(entry.Open(), new UTF8Encoding(false));
        writer.Write(text);
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Diagnostics/ExceptionSummary.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Diagnostics;

/// <summary>
/// Describes an exception without any text the program may have put in it: the type and the call stack only.
/// Never includes the message, the data bag, the help link or any property value.
/// </summary>
public static class ExceptionSummary
{
    private const int MaxInner = 5;
    private const string UnknownType = "(unknown exception type)";

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the type full name, then one line per stack frame exactly as <see cref="Exception.StackTrace"/> gives them,
    /// then for each inner exception (depth first, at most five) a line "--- inner: type" and its frames.
    /// Aggregate exceptions summarise each inner exception. Never throws.
    /// </summary>
    public static string Describe(Exception exception)
    {
        var builder = new StringBuilder();
        try
        {
            AppendHeaderAndFrames(builder, exception, inner: false);
            var remaining = MaxInner;
            AppendInner(builder, exception, ref remaining);
        }
#pragma warning disable CA1031 // The summary is used on failure paths: it must never throw.
        catch (Exception)
        {
            if (builder.Length == 0)
            {
                builder.Append(UnknownType);
            }
        }
#pragma warning restore CA1031

        return builder.ToString();
    }

    private static void AppendInner(StringBuilder builder, Exception exception, ref int remaining)
    {
        foreach (var inner in InnerOf(exception))
        {
            if (remaining <= 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            remaining--;
            builder.AppendLine();
            AppendHeaderAndFrames(builder, inner, inner: true);
            AppendInner(builder, inner, ref remaining);
        }
    }

    private static IEnumerable<Exception> InnerOf(Exception exception)
    {
        if (exception is AggregateException aggregate)
        {
            return aggregate.InnerExceptions;
        }

        return exception.InnerException is null ? [] : [exception.InnerException];
    }

    private static void AppendHeaderAndFrames(StringBuilder builder, Exception exception, bool inner)
    {
        if (inner)
        {
            builder.Append("--- inner: ");
        }

        builder.Append(TypeName(exception));

        var stack = StackOf(exception);
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(stack))
        {
            builder.AppendLine().Append(stack);
        }
    }

    private static string TypeName(Exception exception)
    {
        try
        {
            var type = exception.GetType();
            return type.FullName ?? type.Name;
        }
#pragma warning disable CA1031
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return UnknownType;
        }
#pragma warning restore CA1031
    }

    private static string? StackOf(Exception exception)
    {
        try
        {
            return exception.StackTrace;
        }
#pragma warning disable CA1031
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return null;
        }
#pragma warning restore CA1031
    }
}

```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Diagnostics/SnapshotRedactor.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Diagnostics;

/// <summary>
/// Masks credentials and personal data in text destined for diagnostics. Every pass is linear in the input
/// size: regexes are either anchored to rare literal prefixes or guarded by lookbehinds, and the keyed-value
/// scan advances monotonically (each value is consumed once, failures consume to end of line or end of input).
/// </summary>
public sealed partial class SnapshotRedactor
{
    public const string Mask = "[REDACTED]";

    /// <summary>Mask for the second-line rules (addresses and long encoded runs), the same text the log guard writes.</summary>
    public const string NetworkMask = "***";

    private const string EscapedQuote = "\\\"";

    private readonly Regex[] _termPatterns;

    public SnapshotRedactor(IEnumerable<string>? sensitiveTerms = null)
    {
        _termPatterns = (sensitiveTerms ?? [])
            .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t))
            .Select(t => new Regex(Regex.Escape(t), RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant))
            .ToArray();
    }

    public string Redact(string input)
    {
        var output = CookieHeader().Replace(input, "$1 " + Mask);
        output = AuthorizationHeader().Replace(output, "$1" + Mask);
        output = BearerToken().Replace(output, "$1" + Mask);
        output = HtmlTag().Replace(output, RedactHtmlTag);
        output = RedactKeyedValues(output);
        output = Email().Replace(output, Mask);
        output = IPv4().Replace(output, NetworkMask);
        output = IPv6().Replace(output, NetworkMask);
        output = LongBase64Run().Replace(output, NetworkMask);

        foreach (var pattern in _termPatterns)
        {
            output = pattern.Replace(output, Mask);
        }

        return output;
    }

    private static string RedactHtmlTag(Match tagMatch)
    {
        var tag = tagMatch.Value;
        var sensitive = false;

        foreach (Match attribute in NameAttribute().Matches(tag))
        {
            if (SensitiveWord().IsMatch(attribute.Groups["v"].Value))
            {
                sensitive = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        return sensitive ? ValueAttribute().Replace(tag, "$1\"" + Mask + "\"") : tag;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Finds sensitive keys (JSON, escaped JSON, single-quoted, query or assignment form) and masks the value
    /// that follows: quoted strings (with escapes), balanced objects/arrays, or bare tokens.
    /// </summary>
    private static string RedactKeyedValues(string text)
    {
        StringBuilder? builder = null;
        var copied = 0;
        var position = 0;

        while (position < text.Length)
        {
            var key = SensitiveKey().Match(text, position);
            if (!key.Success)
            {
                break;
            }

            var valueStart = key.Index + key.Length;
            position = valueStart;
            if (valueStart >= text.Length)
            {
                break;
            }

            var keyName = key.Groups["key"].Value;
            var keyQuoted = key.Groups["quote"].Success;

            // "Authorization: <scheme> <credentials>" is owned by the header rule, which keeps the scheme visible.
            if (!keyQuoted && keyName.StartsWith("authorization", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                continue;
            }

            var escapedContext = keyQuoted && key.Groups["quote"].Value[0] == '\\';
            var cookieToEndOfLine = !keyQuoted
                && keyName.StartsWith("cookie", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                && key.Groups["sep"].Value == ":";

            if (!TryScanValue(text, valueStart, escapedContext, cookieToEndOfLine, out var valueEnd, out var quote, out var alreadyMasked))
            {
                continue;
            }

            position = valueEnd;
            if (alreadyMasked)
            {
                continue;
            }

            builder ??= new StringBuilder(text.Length);
            builder.Append(text, copied, valueStart - copied).Append(quote).Append(Mask).Append(quote);
            copied = valueEnd;
        }

        if (builder is null)
        {
            return text;
        }

        builder.Append(text, copied, text.Length - copied);
        return builder.ToString();
    }

    private static bool TryScanValue(
        string text, int start, bool escapedContext, bool toEndOfLine, out int end, out string quote, out bool alreadyMasked)
    {
        var bareQuote = escapedContext ? EscapedQuote : "\"";
        alreadyMasked = false;
        quote = bareQuote;
        end = start;

        var c = text[start];

        if (c == '\\' && start + 1 < text.Length && text[start + 1] == '"')
        {
            var close = text.IndexOf(EscapedQuote, start + 2, StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (close < 0)
            {
                end = EndOfLine(text, start);
            }
            else
            {
                end = close + 2;
                alreadyMasked = text.AsSpan(start + 2, close - start - 2).SequenceEqual(Mask);
            }

            quote = EscapedQuote;
            return true;
        }

        if (c is '"' or '\'')
        {
            var close = FindClosingQuote(text, start + 1, c);
            if (close < 0)
            {
                end = EndOfLine(text, start);
            }
            else
            {
                end = close + 1;
                alreadyMasked = text.AsSpan(start + 1, close - start - 1).SequenceEqual(Mask);
            }

            quote = c.ToString();
            return true;
        }

        if (c is '{' or '[')
        {
            end = FindEndOfStructure(text, start);
            return true;
        }

        var index = start;
        while (index < text.Length && !IsBareTerminator(text[index], toEndOfLine))
        {
            index++;
        }

        if (index == start)
        {
            return false;
        }

        end = index;
        alreadyMasked = text.AsSpan(start, index - start).SequenceEqual(Mask);
        return true;
    }

    private static bool IsBareTerminator(char c, bool toEndOfLine) =>
        toEndOfLine
            ? c is '\r' or '\n'
            : char.IsWhiteSpace(c) || c is '&' or ';' or ',' or '<' or '>' or '"' or '\'' or '}' or ']';

    private static int EndOfLine(string text, int from)
    {
        var index = text.AsSpan(from).IndexOfAny('\r', '\n');
        return index < 0 ? text.Length : from + index;
    }

    /// <summary>Returns the index of the unescaped closing quote, or -1 when the string is unterminated.</summary>
    private static int FindClosingQuote(string text, int from, char quote)
    {
        var index = from;
        while (index < text.Length)
        {
            var found = text.AsSpan(index).IndexOfAny(quote, '\\');
            if (found < 0)
            {
                return -1;
            }

            index += found;
            if (text[index] == quote)
            {
                return index;
            }

            index += 2;
        }

        return -1;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Returns the exclusive end of the balanced {...} or [...] starting at <paramref name="start"/>. Strings
    /// (plain or backslash-escaped quotes) are skipped. An unbalanced structure is masked to the end of input,
    /// which keeps the scan linear and errs on the side of privacy.
    /// </summary>
    private static int FindEndOfStructure(string text, int start)
    {
        var depth = 0;
        var index = start;

        while (index < text.Length)
        {
            var c = text[index];

            if (c is '{' or '[')
            {
                depth++;
            }
            else if (c is '}' or ']')
            {
                depth--;
                if (depth == 0)
                {
                    return index + 1;
                }
            }
            else if (c == '"')
            {
                var close = FindClosingQuote(text, index + 1, '"');
                if (close < 0)
                {
                    return text.Length;
                }

                index = close;
            }
            else if (c == '\\' && index + 1 < text.Length && text[index + 1] == '"')
            {
                var close = text.IndexOf(EscapedQuote, index + 2, StringComparison.Ordinal);
                if (close >= 0)
                {
                    index = close + 1;
                }
                else
                {
                    index++;
                }
            }

            index++;
        }

        return text.Length;
    }

    [GeneratedRegex("""^([ \t]*(?:set-)?cookie[ \t]*:)[^\r\n]*""", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Multiline)]
    private static partial Regex CookieHeader();

    // Atomic prefix: once the scheme is consumed it can never be given back, so an already-masked line stays put.
    [GeneratedRegex(
        """((?>authorization[ \t]*[:=][ \t]*(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_\-]*[ \t]+)?))(?!\[REDACTED\][ \t]*(?:\r|\n|$))[^\r\n]+""",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Multiline)]
    private static partial Regex AuthorizationHeader();

    [GeneratedRegex("""(bearer\s+)[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=\-]+""", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
    private static partial Regex BearerToken();

    [GeneratedRegex("""<[A-Za-z][^<>]*>""")]
    private static partial Regex HtmlTag();

    [GeneratedRegex(
        """(?<![A-Za-z0-9_\-])(?:name|id|property|http-equiv|itemprop)\s*=\s*(?:"(?<v>[^"]*)"|'(?<v>[^']*)'|(?<v>[^\s"'>]+))""",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
    private static partial Regex NameAttribute();

    [GeneratedRegex("""(?<![A-Za-z0-9_\-])((?:value|content)\s*=\s*)(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s"'>]+)""", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
    private static partial Regex ValueAttribute();

    [GeneratedRegex("""token|session|csrf|xsrf|password|passwd|pwd|secret|api[-_]?key|authorization|cookie|credential""", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
    private static partial Regex SensitiveWord();

    // The bounded tail keeps a failed attempt O(1), so long runs of word characters cannot go quadratic.
    [GeneratedRegex(
        """(?<key>token|session|csrf|xsrf|password|passwd|pwd|secret|api[-_]?key|authorization|cookie|credential)[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{0,40}(?<quote>\\?["'])?\s*(?<sep>[:=])\s*""",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)]
    private static partial Regex SensitiveKey();

    // The lookbehind lets a match start only at the beginning of a run of address characters.
    [GeneratedRegex("""(?<![A-Z0-9._%+\-])[A-Z0-9._%+\-]+(?:@|%(?:25)*40)[A-Z0-9.\-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}""", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)]
    private static partial Regex Email();

    // Four dotted decimal octets that are not part of a longer dotted/digit run (so 1.2.3 and dates stay).
    [GeneratedRegex("""(?<![0-9.])(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])(?![0-9]|\.[0-9])""")]
    private static partial Regex IPv4();

    // Full, compressed (::) and leading-:: forms. Needing either 8 groups or "::" keeps clock times and MAC addresses.
    [GeneratedRegex(
        """(?<![0-9A-Z:])(?:(?:[0-9A-F]{1,4}:){7}[0-9A-F]{1,4}|(?:[0-9A-F]{1,4}:){1,6}:[0-9A-F]{1,4}(?::[0-9A-F]{1,4}){0,5}|(?:[0-9A-F]{1,4}:){1,7}:|::[0-9A-F]{1,4}(?::[0-9A-F]{1,4}){0,6})(?![0-9A-Z:])""",
        RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant)]
    private static partial Regex IPv6();

    // 40 or more base64 characters starting at the beginning of a run. The digit/+/= requirement spares long
    // letters-and-slash file paths; random base64 of that length almost surely contains one.
    [GeneratedRegex("""(?<![A-Za-z0-9+/=])(?=[A-Za-z/]*[0-9+=])[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{40,}""")]
    private static partial Regex LongBase64Run();
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Forgetting/ForgetCoordinator.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Forgetting;

/// <summary>
/// Orders Forgetting: quiesce every participant, remove the stored data (the gate), then forget memory and side files,
/// or resume when the removal failed. Never throws.
/// </summary>
public sealed class ForgetCoordinator(Func<bool> removeStoredData, Func<IEnumerable<IForgettable>> participants)
{
    /// <summary>Runs the three phases and reports what could not be forgotten.</summary>
    public ForgetResult Forget()
    {
        var list = participants().ToList();
        var failures = new List<string>();
        var failedToStop = new HashSet<IForgettable>();

        foreach (var participant in list)
        {
            try
            {
                participant.Quiesce();
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                failedToStop.Add(participant);
                failures.Add($"{participant.Name} (could not be stopped)");
            }
        }

        var removed = RemoveStoredData();
        if (!removed)
        {
            foreach (var participant in list)
            {
                try
                {
                    participant.Resume();
                }
                catch (Exception)
                {
                    // Resuming is best effort; the removal failure is what the caller reports.
                }
            }

            return new ForgetResult(false, []);
        }

        foreach (var participant in list)
        {
            try
            {
                participant.Forget();
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                if (!failedToStop.Contains(participant))
                {
                    failures.Add(participant.Name);
                }
            }
        }

        return new ForgetResult(true, failures);
    }

    private bool RemoveStoredData()
    {
        try
        {
            return removeStoredData();
        }
        catch (Exception)
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
}
```

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Forgetting;

/// <summary>The outcome of Forgetting: whether the stored data is gone and which features could not be forgotten.</summary>
public sealed record ForgetResult(bool StoredDataRemoved, IReadOnlyList<string> NotForgotten)
{
    /// <summary>True when the stored data was removed and every feature was forgotten.</summary>
    public bool IsComplete => StoredDataRemoved && NotForgotten.Count == 0;
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Forgetting/IForgettable.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Forgetting;

/// <summary>A feature that holds character data in memory, in side files, or as running work.</summary>
public interface IForgettable
{
    /// <summary>The name shown when this feature could not be forgotten.</summary>
    string Name { get; }

    /// <summary>Stops in-flight work and makes late answers and writes have no effect. Reversible with <see cref="Resume"/>. Must not remove data.</summary>
    void Quiesce();

    /// <summary>Undoes <see cref="Quiesce"/>; called only when the stored-data removal failed.</summary>
    void Resume();

    /// <summary>Clears memory and side files. Called only after the stored data was removed.</summary>
    void Forget();
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Ingestion/IPageParser.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;

/// <summary>Pure function from a captured page to a typed result. Layout drift must yield Suspicious/Failed, not exceptions.</summary>
public interface IPageParser<T>
{
    string Name { get; }
    string Version { get; }
```

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;

/// <summary>Why a fetch failed; <see cref="None"/> for a success.</summary>
public enum PageFailureKind
{
    None,

    /// <summary>The deadline passed while the caller had not cancelled.</summary>
    Timeout,

    /// <summary>The connection failed, or a redirect loop ended the request.</summary>
    Network,

    /// <summary>The server answered with a non-success status; see <see cref="PageFetchResult.HttpStatus"/>.</summary>
    Http,

    /// <summary>The address (or a redirect target) is not one the companion may read.</summary>
    Blocked,

    TooLarge,

    NotHtml,
}

/// <summary>
/// Outcome of fetching one page. <see cref="Error"/> is a short message that never contains the URL query.
/// <see cref="Kind"/> and <see cref="HttpStatus"/> are optional extras: a plain <see cref="Failure(string)"/> counts as <see cref="PageFailureKind.Network"/>.
/// </summary>
public sealed record PageFetchResult(PageSnapshot? Snapshot, string? Error, PageFailureKind Kind = PageFailureKind.None, int? HttpStatus = null)
{
    public bool IsSuccess => Snapshot is not null;

    public static PageFetchResult Success(PageSnapshot snapshot) => new(snapshot, null);

    public static PageFetchResult Failure(string error) => new(null, error, PageFailureKind.Network);

    public static PageFetchResult Failure(string error, PageFailureKind kind, int? httpStatus = null) =>
        new(null, error, kind, httpStatus);
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Ingestion/PageSnapshot.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;

public sealed record PageSnapshot
{
    public required string Url { get; init; }
    public required DateTimeOffset CapturedAt { get; init; }
    public required string Payload { get; init; }
    public required string AppVersion { get; init; }

    public static PageSnapshot Create(string rawUrl, string payload, string appVersion, DateTimeOffset capturedAt)
    {
        var uri = new Uri(rawUrl, UriKind.Absolute);
        // On Unix, "/path" parses as an absolute file:// URI, so require a web scheme explicitly.
        if (uri.Scheme != Uri.UriSchemeHttp && uri.Scheme != Uri.UriSchemeHttps)
        {
            throw new UriFormatException($"Expected an absolute http(s) URL but got scheme '{uri.Scheme}'.");
        }

        return new PageSnapshot
        {
            Url = uri.GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Path),
            CapturedAt = capturedAt,
            Payload = payload,
            AppVersion = appVersion,
        };
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Inventory/CharacterInventory.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Inventory;

/// <summary>One entry of the public inventory. For a class, <paramref name="Count"/> is its class points.</summary>
public sealed record InventoryItem(string Name, string Type, int Count, bool IsAc, bool IsMemberOnly);

/// <summary>How many distinct items of one type the inventory holds.</summary>
public sealed record InventoryTypeCount(string Type, int Count);

/// <summary>What the public inventory list shows for a character.</summary>
public sealed record CharacterInventory(IReadOnlyList<InventoryItem> Items)
{
    public const string OtherTypeName = "Other";
    public const string ClassTypeName = "Class";
    public const int PreviewTypeCount = 5;

    public int Count => Items.Count;

    /// <summary>Distinct items per type, most items first, then by type name; types are compared ignoring case.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<InventoryTypeCount> TypeCounts =>
        Items
            .GroupBy(item => item.Type, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .Select(group => new InventoryTypeCount(group.First().Type, group.Count()))
            .OrderByDescending(entry => entry.Count)
            .ThenBy(entry => entry.Type, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            .ToList();

    // Kept outside the record so equality, copies and serialization never see it. Built once per instance, on first lookup.
    private static readonly System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ConditionalWeakTable<CharacterInventory, Dictionary<string, NameEntry>> Indexes = new();

    private static readonly System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ConditionalWeakTable<CharacterInventory, HashSet<string>> CompactKeys = new();

    private static readonly System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ConditionalWeakTable<CharacterInventory, HashSet<string>> BaseKeys = new();

    private readonly record struct NameEntry(InventoryItem First, long Total);

    private Dictionary<string, NameEntry> Index => Indexes.GetValue(this, static inventory =>
    {
        var index = new Dictionary<string, NameEntry>(inventory.Items.Count, StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var item in inventory.Items)
        {
            var key = NameKey.Normalize(item.Name);
            if (key.Length == 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            index[key] = index.TryGetValue(key, out var entry)
                ? entry with { Total = entry.Total + item.Count }
                : new NameEntry(item, item.Count);
        }

        return index;
    });

    private HashSet<string> CompactIndex => CompactKeys.GetValue(this, static inventory =>
    {
        var keys = new HashSet<string>(inventory.Items.Count, StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var item in inventory.Items)
        {
            var key = NameKey.Compact(item.Name);
            if (key.Length > 0)
            {
                keys.Add(key);
            }
        }

        return keys;
    });

    private HashSet<string> BaseIndex => BaseKeys.GetValue(this, static inventory =>
    {
        var keys = new HashSet<string>(inventory.Items.Count, StringComparer.Ordinal);
        foreach (var item in inventory.Items)
        {
            var key = NameKey.Base(item.Name);
            if (key.Length > 0)
            {
                keys.Add(key);
            }
        }

        return keys;
    });

    /// <summary>
    /// True when an item has the same <see cref="NameKey.Base"/> key as this name, so "Cryomancer" is found by "Cryomancer (Merge)"
    /// and an AC item by its non-AC name. Whole keys only; a name with nothing but qualifiers is never found.
    /// </summary>
    public bool HasBaseKey(string name)
    {
        var key = NameKey.Base(name);
        return key.Length > 0 && BaseIndex.Contains(key);
    }

    /// <summary>True when an item's name has exactly this <see cref="NameKey.Compact"/> key (the argument is compacted too, so a name works as well). Whole keys only.</summary>
    public bool HasCompactKey(string key)
    {
        var compact = NameKey.Compact(key);
        return compact.Length > 0 && CompactIndex.Contains(compact);
    }

    /// <summary>The summed counts of the items with this name (trimmed, case-insensitive); 0 when there is none.</summary>
    public int CountOf(string name) =>
        Index.TryGetValue(NameKey.Normalize(name), out var entry) ? SafeInt.Clamp(entry.Total) : 0;

    public bool Has(string name) => Find(name) is not null;

    /// <summary>The first item with this name (trimmed, case-insensitive), or null.</summary>
    public InventoryItem? Find(string name) =>
        Index.TryGetValue(NameKey.Normalize(name), out var entry) ? entry.First : null;
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Inventory/NameKey.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Inventory;

/// <summary>
/// The key two item names are compared by: trimmed, runs of whitespace collapsed to one space, case ignored.
/// Nothing smarter on purpose; the rules for matching wiki names are decided where they are needed.
/// </summary>
public static class NameKey
{
    public static string Normalize(string? name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var builder = new StringBuilder(name.Length);
        var pendingSpace = false;
        foreach (var c in name)
        {
            if (char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
            {
                pendingSpace = builder.Length > 0;
                continue;
            }

            if (pendingSpace)
            {
                builder.Append(' ');
                pendingSpace = false;
            }

            builder.Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(c));
        }

        return builder.ToString();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// The looser key used to match wiki names and page names: only lower-case letters and digits (Unicode letters are kept),
    /// everything else dropped. "Evolved Shadow of Nulgath" and "evolved-shadow-of-nulgath" give the same key.
    /// </summary>
    public static string Compact(string? name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var builder = new StringBuilder(name.Length);
        foreach (var c in name)
        {
            if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c))
            {
                builder.Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(c));
            }
        }

        return builder.ToString();
    }

    // The tags a trailing "(...)" may carry that say how an item is obtained or in which edition, not which item it is.
    private static readonly HashSet<string> Qualifiers = new(StringComparer.Ordinal)
    {
        "class", "merge", "quest", "daily quest", "ac", "0 ac", "non-ac", "non ac",
    };

    /// <summary>
    /// The key two names of the same item share: <see cref="Compact"/> after every trailing "(Class)", "(Merge)", "(Quest)",
    /// "(Daily Quest)", "(AC)", "(0 AC)" and "(Non-AC)" is dropped, however many there are. Any other qualifier, and any in the
    /// middle of the name, is kept because it tells different items apart. Empty when nothing but qualifiers is left.
    /// </summary>
    public static string Base(string? name)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        var rest = name.AsSpan().Trim();
        while (rest.Length > 0 && rest[^1] == ')')
        {
            var open = rest.LastIndexOf('(');
            if (open < 0)
            {
                break;
            }

            var tag = Normalize(rest[(open + 1)..^1].ToString());
            if (!Qualifiers.Contains(tag))
            {
                break;
            }

            rest = rest[..open].TrimEnd();
        }

        return Compact(rest.ToString());
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Persistence/StoredData.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Persistence;

/// <summary>
/// Typed, failure-proof access to the stored data. Never throws (except for <see cref="OutOfMemoryException"/>): a failure
/// is reported to the callback by operation and exception type name only, never by message. Keys that are no longer used
/// are removed after the first successful save.
/// </summary>
public sealed class StoredData(IStoredDataStore store, IReadOnlyList<string> obsoleteKeys, Action<string, string>? onFailure = null)
{
    private bool _obsoleteRemoved;

    /// <summary>The stored value, or null on any failure (absent, unreadable, another version, database error).</summary>
    public StoredValue<T>? Load<T>(StoredKey<T> key) =>
        Guard("Load", () => store.Load<T>(key.Name, key.Version), default);

    /// <summary>Stores the value; false on failure. The first success also removes the obsolete keys, once and best effort.</summary>
    public bool Save<T>(StoredKey<T> key, T value, DateTimeOffset readAtUtc)
    {
        if (!Guard("Save", () => { store.Save(key.Name, key.Version, value, readAtUtc); return true; }, false))
        {
            return false;
        }

        RemoveObsoleteOnce();
        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>Deletes the value of the key; false on failure.</summary>
    public bool Remove<T>(StoredKey<T> key) =>
        Guard("Remove", () => { store.Remove(key.Name); return true; }, false);

    /// <summary>Deletes everything stored; false on failure or when something could not be deleted.</summary>
    public bool Clear() => Guard("Clear", store.Clear, false);

    private void RemoveObsoleteOnce()
    {
        if (_obsoleteRemoved)
        {
            return;
        }

        _obsoleteRemoved = true;
        foreach (var name in obsoleteKeys)
        {
            Guard("RemoveObsolete", () => { store.Remove(name); return true; }, false);
        }
    }

    private TResult Guard<TResult>(string operation, Func<TResult> action, TResult fallback)
    {
        try
        {
            return action();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OutOfMemoryException)
        {
            try
            {
                onFailure?.Invoke(operation, ex.GetType().Name);
            }
            catch (Exception callbackEx) when (callbackEx is not OutOfMemoryException)
            {
                // A failing report must not turn a handled failure into a thrown one.
            }

            return fallback;
        }
    }
}
```
