`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Wiki/HardFarmListParser.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using AngleSharp.Dom;
using AngleSharp.Html.Parser;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

/// <summary>
/// Reads the community Hard Farming list (<c>/syfarm</c>): a "Created by ..., Revised by ..." line, then headings, each
/// followed by wiki page URLs written as links and/or plain text. Only URLs on the wiki host count. Parsing never
/// throws and nothing parsed is logged.
/// </summary>
public sealed class HardFarmListParser : IPageParser<HardFarmList>
{
    public const int MinEntries = 10;
    public const string ContentMarker = "#page-content";
    public const string HeadingMarker = "h1-h6 headings in #page-content";
    public const string UngroupedName = "Ungrouped";

    private const string Strategy = "headings-and-urls";
    private const int MaxCreditLength = 120;
    private const int MaxGroupNameLength = 100;

    private static readonly Regex UrlPattern = new(
        @"https?://aqwwiki\.wikidot\.com/[^\s<>""']+", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant, TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));

    public string Name => "hard-farm-list";
    public string Version => "1";

    public bool CanParse(PageSnapshot snapshot) =>
        WikiUrls.IsWikiPage(snapshot.Url) && WikiUrls.Slug(snapshot.Url) == WikiUrls.HardFarmSlug;

    public ParseResult<HardFarmList> Parse(PageSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        var document = new HtmlParser().ParseDocument(snapshot.Payload);
        var content = document.QuerySelector(ContentMarker);
        if (content is null)
        {
            return ParseResult<HardFarmList>.Failed(
                "the page content was not found", new ParseDiagnostics(Name, Version, null, [ContentMarker], 0));
        }

        var groups = new List<(string Name, List<string> Slugs)>();
        string? credit = null;
        var current = (List<string>?)null;
        Walk(content);

        var result = new HardFarmList(
            groups.Where(g => g.Slugs.Count > 0).Select(g => new HardFarmGroup(g.Name, g.Slugs)).ToList(),
            credit);

        var missing = new List<string>();
        if (result.Groups.Count == 0)
        {
            missing.Add(HeadingMarker);
        }

        var diagnostics = new ParseDiagnostics(Name, Version, Strategy, missing, result.Count);
        if (result.Count == 0)
        {
            return ParseResult<HardFarmList>.Failed("no wiki page links were found", diagnostics with { MatchedStrategy = null });
        }

        return result.Groups.Count >= 1 && result.Count >= MinEntries
            ? ParseResult<HardFarmList>.Ok(result, diagnostics)
            : ParseResult<HardFarmList>.Suspicious(result, "the list is much shorter than expected", diagnostics);

        void Walk(INode node)
        {
            foreach (var child in node.ChildNodes)
            {
                switch (child)
                {
                    case IElement { LocalName: "a" } anchor:
                        Add(AbsoluteSlug(anchor.GetAttribute("href")) ?? SlugOfText(anchor.TextContent));
                        break;
                    case IElement element when IsHeading(element):
                        StartGroup(element.TextContent);
                        break;
                    case IElement element when element.LocalName is "script" or "style":
                        break;
                    case IElement element:
                        if (current is null && credit is null && element.LocalName is "p" or "em" or "div"
                            && element.TextContent.Contains("Created by", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                            && element.TextContent.Length < 400)
                        {
                            credit = TextCleaner.NonBlank(TextCleaner.Clean(element.TextContent, MaxCreditLength));
                        }

                        Walk(element);
                        break;
                    case IText text:
                        foreach (var slug in SlugsInText(text.Data))
                        {
                            Add(slug);
                        }

                        break;
                }
            }
        }

        void StartGroup(string heading)
        {
            var name = TextCleaner.Clean(heading, MaxGroupNameLength);
            if (name.Length == 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            var existing = groups.FindIndex(g => g.Name.EqualsIgnoreCase(name));
            if (existing < 0)
            {
                groups.Add((name, []));
                existing = groups.Count - 1;
            }

            current = groups[existing].Slugs;
        }

        void Add(string? slug)
        {
            if (!WikiUrls.IsValidSlug(slug))
            {
                return;
            }

            if (current is null)
            {
                StartGroup(UngroupedName);
            }

            var target = current!;
            if (!target.Contains(slug, StringComparer.Ordinal))
            {
                target.Add(slug);
            }
        }
    }

    private static bool IsHeading(IElement element) =>
        element.LocalName.Length == 2 && element.LocalName[0] == 'h' && element.LocalName[1] is >= '1' and <= '6';

    /// <summary>Only absolute wiki URLs count on this page; a relative link is not a list entry.</summary>
    private static string? AbsoluteSlug(string? href) =>
        href is not null && href.TrimStart().StartsWith("http", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? WikiUrls.Slug(href) : null;

    private static string? SlugOfText(string text) => SlugsInText(text).FirstOrDefault();

    private static IEnumerable<string> SlugsInText(string text)
    {
        MatchCollection matches;
        try
        {
            matches = UrlPattern.Matches(text);
        }
        catch (RegexMatchTimeoutException)
        {
            yield break;
        }

        foreach (Match match in matches)
        {
            if (WikiUrls.Slug(match.Value) is { } slug)
            {
                yield return slug;
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Wiki/HardFarmModels.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

/// <summary>One entry of the Hard Farming list: the wiki page name and the group it was listed under.</summary>
public sealed record HardFarmEntry(string Slug, string Group);

public sealed record HardFarmGroup(string Name, IReadOnlyList<string> Slugs);

/// <summary>The imported list. <see cref="Entries"/> is flattened, distinct by slug (the first group wins).</summary>
public sealed record HardFarmList(IReadOnlyList<HardFarmGroup> Groups, string? Credit)
{
    public IReadOnlyList<HardFarmEntry> Entries { get; } = Flatten(Groups);

    public int Count => Entries.Count;

    private static List<HardFarmEntry> Flatten(IReadOnlyList<HardFarmGroup> groups)
    {
        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var entries = new List<HardFarmEntry>();
        foreach (var group in groups)
        {
            foreach (var slug in group.Slugs)
            {
                if (seen.Add(slug))
                {
                    entries.Add(new HardFarmEntry(slug, group.Name));
                }
            }
        }

        return entries;
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Wiki/RobotsTxt.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

/// <summary>
/// The rules of a robots.txt that apply to this app: the group for the exact <c>AqwCompanion</c> agent when present,
/// otherwise the <c>*</c> group. Patterns support <c>*</c> and a trailing <c>$</c>; the longest matching rule wins and
/// Allow wins a tie. Without a matching group everything is allowed.
/// </summary>
public sealed class RobotsTxt
{
    public const string AgentName = "AqwCompanion";

    private readonly IReadOnlyList<(bool Allow, string Pattern)> _rules;

    private RobotsTxt(IReadOnlyList<(bool Allow, string Pattern)> rules) => _rules = rules;

    public static RobotsTxt Parse(string? text)
    {
        var specific = new List<(bool, string)>();
        var general = new List<(bool, string)>();
        var hasSpecific = false;
        var agents = new List<string>();
        var inRules = false;

        foreach (var raw in (text ?? string.Empty).Split('\n'))
        {
            var line = raw;
            var hash = line.IndexOf('#', StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (hash >= 0)
            {
                line = line[..hash];
            }

            line = line.Trim();
            var colon = line.IndexOf(':', StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (colon <= 0)
            {
                continue;
            }

            var field = line[..colon].Trim();
            var value = line[(colon + 1)..].Trim();

            if (field.EqualsIgnoreCase("user-agent"))
            {
                if (inRules)
                {
                    agents.Clear();
                    inRules = false;
                }

                agents.Add(value);
                hasSpecific |= value.EqualsIgnoreCase(AgentName);
            }
            else if (field.EqualsIgnoreCase("disallow") || field.EqualsIgnoreCase("allow"))
            {
                inRules = true;
                if (value.Length == 0)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                var rule = (field.EqualsIgnoreCase("allow"), value);
                if (agents.Any(agent => agent.EqualsIgnoreCase(AgentName)))
                {
                    specific.Add(rule);
                }

                if (agents.Contains("*", StringComparer.Ordinal))
                {
                    general.Add(rule);
                }
            }
        }

        return new RobotsTxt(hasSpecific ? specific : general);
    }

    /// <summary>True when the path (with its query, if any) may be fetched.</summary>
    public bool IsAllowed(string path)
    {
        var target = string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) ? "/" : path;
        var bestLength = -1;
        var allowed = true;
        foreach (var (allow, pattern) in _rules)
        {
            if (!Matches(pattern, target))
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (pattern.Length > bestLength || (pattern.Length == bestLength && allow))
            {
                bestLength = pattern.Length;
                allowed = allow;
            }
        }

        return allowed;
    }

    private static bool Matches(string pattern, string path)
    {
        var anchored = pattern.EndsWith('$');
        if (anchored)
        {
            pattern = pattern[..^1];
        }

        var parts = pattern.Split('*');
        var position = 0;
        for (var i = 0; i < parts.Length; i++)
        {
            var part = parts[i];
            if (i == 0)
            {
                if (!path.StartsWith(part, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    return false;
                }

                position = part.Length;
            }
            else if (i == parts.Length - 1 && anchored)
            {
                if (path.Length - part.Length < position || !path.EndsWith(part, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    return false;
                }

                position = path.Length;
            }
            else
            {
                var index = path.IndexOf(part, position, StringComparison.Ordinal);
                if (index < 0)
                {
                    return false;
                }

                position = index + part.Length;
            }
        }

        return !anchored || position == path.Length;
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Wiki/WikiIndexParser.cs`:

```cs
using AngleSharp.Dom;
using AngleSharp.Html.Parser;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

/// <summary>
/// Reads a wiki type index page (<c>/classes</c>, <c>/armors</c> ...): entries are <c>&lt;a href="/slug"&gt;Name&lt;/a&gt;</c>
/// inside <c>#page-content</c>. In-page anchors, <c>system:</c>/<c>forum:</c> links and the sort-by menu are ignored; names
/// are cleaned. Parsing never throws and nothing parsed is logged.
/// </summary>
public sealed class WikiIndexParser : IPageParser<WikiIndex>
{
    public const string ContentMarker = "#page-content";
    public const string EntryMarker = "#page-content a[href^='/']";

    private const string ListStrategy = "list-pages-items";
    private const string AnchorStrategy = "content-anchors";
    private const int MaxNameLength = 200;

    public string Name => "wiki-type-index";
    public string Version => "1";

    public bool CanParse(PageSnapshot snapshot) =>
        WikiUrls.IsWikiPage(snapshot.Url) && WikiUrls.Slug(snapshot.Url) is { } slug && WikiUrls.IsTypeIndex(slug);

    public ParseResult<WikiIndex> Parse(PageSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        var indexSlug = WikiUrls.Slug(snapshot.Url) ?? string.Empty;
        var document = new HtmlParser().ParseDocument(snapshot.Payload);
        var content = document.QuerySelector(ContentMarker);
        if (content is null)
        {
            return Failed("the page content was not found", ContentMarker);
        }

        // The real pages list entries inside .list-pages-item boxes; the sort-by menu above them is not an entry.
        var strategy = ListStrategy;
        var anchors = content.QuerySelectorAll(".list-pages-item a[href]").ToList();
        if (anchors.Count == 0)
        {
            strategy = AnchorStrategy;
            anchors = content.QuerySelectorAll("a[href]").ToList();
        }

        var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        var entries = new List<WikiIndexEntry>();
        foreach (var anchor in anchors)
        {
            var href = anchor.GetAttribute("href");
            if (href is null || href.StartsWith('#'))
            {
                continue;
            }

            var slug = WikiUrls.Slug(href);
            var name = TextCleaner.Clean(anchor.TextContent, MaxNameLength);
            if (!WikiUrls.IsValidSlug(slug) || name.Length == 0 || IsNavigation(name) || !seen.Add(slug))
            {
                continue;
            }

            entries.Add(new WikiIndexEntry(slug, name));
        }

        if (entries.Count == 0)
        {
            return Failed("no entries were found", EntryMarker);
        }

        return ParseResult<WikiIndex>.Ok(
            new WikiIndex(indexSlug, WikiTypes.ForIndex(indexSlug), entries),
            new ParseDiagnostics(Name, Version, strategy, [], entries.Count));
    }

    private static bool IsNavigation(string name) =>
        name.EqualsIgnoreCase("Back to Top") || name.EqualsIgnoreCase("Go to");

    private ParseResult<WikiIndex> Failed(string reason, string marker) =>
        ParseResult<WikiIndex>.Failed(reason, new ParseDiagnostics(Name, Version, null, [marker], 0));
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Wiki/WikiPageFetcher.cs`:

```cs
using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

/// <summary>
/// One read-only GET against aqwwiki.wikidot.com. https and the wiki host only (also for redirects, validated hop by
/// hop, at most 3), a per-call timeout (30 s by default), an 8 MiB cap, text/html only (text/plain for robots.txt). No cookies, no
/// credentials. The caller supplies an <see cref="HttpClient"/> with automatic redirects and cookies turned off.
/// Pacing between requests and the robots.txt rules are the caller's job.
/// </summary>
public sealed class WikiPageFetcher(HttpClient http, string appVersion, ILogger<WikiPageFetcher> logger) : IWikiPageFetcher
{
    public const int MaxBytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
    public static readonly TimeSpan DefaultTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

    public static readonly TimeSpan MinTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
    public static readonly TimeSpan MaxTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120);

    /// <summary>No value means the default; anything else is held between one second and two minutes (never zero, negative or infinite).</summary>
    public static TimeSpan NormalizeTimeout(TimeSpan? timeout) =>
        timeout is not { } value ? DefaultTimeout : value == Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan ? MaxTimeout : value < MinTimeout ? MinTimeout : value > MaxTimeout ? MaxTimeout : value;

    private const int MaxRedirects = 3;
    private const string HtmlType = "text/html";
    private const string TextType = "text/plain";

    public Task<PageFetchResult> FetchPageAsync(string url, TimeSpan? timeout = null, CancellationToken ct = default) =>
        FetchAsync(url, HtmlType, NormalizeTimeout(timeout), ct);

    public Task<PageFetchResult> FetchRobotsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default) =>
        FetchAsync(WikiUrls.Robots, TextType, DefaultTimeout, ct);

    private async Task<PageFetchResult> FetchAsync(string url, string expectedType, TimeSpan timeout, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (!TryAllow(url, null, out var uri))
        {
            // The address is not trusted, so it is not logged at all.
            logger.LogWarning("Wiki fetch failed: {Kind} {SafePage}", PageFailureKind.Blocked, "(not a wiki page)");
            return PageFetchResult.Failure("Only https pages on aqwwiki.wikidot.com can be read.", PageFailureKind.Blocked);
        }

        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
        deadline.CancelAfter(timeout);

        try
        {
            for (var hop = 0; hop <= MaxRedirects; hop++)
            {
                using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, uri);
                request.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("User-Agent", $"AqwCompanion/{appVersion} (read-only personal companion)");
                request.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Accept", expectedType);

                using var response = await http.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, deadline.Token)
                    .ConfigureAwait(false);

                if (IsRedirect(response.StatusCode))
                {
                    if (response.Headers.Location is null)
                    {
                        return Fail(uri, PageFailureKind.Http, $"The server answered HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode}.", (int)response.StatusCode);
                    }

                    if (!TryAllow(response.Headers.Location.OriginalString, uri, out var next))
                    {
                        return Fail(uri, PageFailureKind.Blocked, "The server redirected to a page that is not allowed.");
                    }

                    uri = next;
                    continue;
                }

                return await ReadAsync(response, uri, expectedType, deadline.Token).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }

            return Fail(uri, PageFailureKind.Network, "The server redirected too many times.");
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!ct.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            return Fail(uri, PageFailureKind.Timeout, "The request timed out.");
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is HttpRequestException or IOException or InvalidOperationException)
        {
            // Type only: exception messages can contain the request URL.
            logger.LogWarning("Wiki fetch failed: {Kind} {SafePage} {ExceptionType}", PageFailureKind.Network, PageLabel(uri), ex.GetType().Name);
            return PageFetchResult.Failure("The request failed.", PageFailureKind.Network);
        }
    }

    private async Task<PageFetchResult> ReadAsync(HttpResponseMessage response, Uri uri, string expectedType, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode)
        {
            return Fail(uri, PageFailureKind.Http, $"The server answered HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode}.", (int)response.StatusCode);
        }

        if (!(response.Content.Headers.ContentType?.MediaType).EqualsIgnoreCase(expectedType))
        {
            return Fail(
                uri,
                PageFailureKind.NotHtml,
                expectedType == HtmlType
                    ? "The server did not answer with an HTML page."
                    : "The server did not answer with a text file.");
        }

        if (response.Content.Headers.ContentLength > MaxBytes)
        {
            return Fail(uri, PageFailureKind.TooLarge, "The page is larger than the allowed size.");
        }

        await using var stream = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(ct).ConfigureAwait(false);
        using var buffer = new MemoryStream();
        var chunk = new byte[16 * 1024];
        int read;
        while ((read = await stream.ReadAsync(chunk, ct).ConfigureAwait(false)) > 0)
        {
            if (buffer.Length + read > MaxBytes)
            {
                return Fail(uri, PageFailureKind.TooLarge, "The page is larger than the allowed size.");
            }

            buffer.Write(chunk, 0, read);
        }

        var text = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(buffer.GetBuffer(), 0, (int)buffer.Length);
        return PageFetchResult.Success(PageSnapshot.Create(uri.AbsoluteUri, text, appVersion, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow));
    }

    // Logs the kind and the page (path only: no query, no content); the wiki's page names are public and validated.
    private PageFetchResult Fail(Uri uri, PageFailureKind kind, string message, int? status = null)
    {
        logger.LogWarning("Wiki fetch failed: {Kind} {SafePage}", kind, PageLabel(uri));
        return PageFetchResult.Failure(message, kind, status);
    }

    private static string PageLabel(Uri uri)
    {
        var slug = WikiUrls.Slug(uri.AbsolutePath);
        return slug is not null && (WikiUrls.IsValidSlug(slug) || slug == WikiUrls.RobotsSlug) ? "/" + slug : "(page)";
    }

    private static bool IsRedirect(HttpStatusCode status) =>
        status is HttpStatusCode.MovedPermanently or HttpStatusCode.Found or HttpStatusCode.SeeOther
            or HttpStatusCode.TemporaryRedirect or HttpStatusCode.PermanentRedirect;

    private static bool TryAllow(string? candidate, Uri? baseUri, out Uri uri)
    {
        uri = null!;
        if (candidate is null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        var ok = baseUri is null
            ? Uri.TryCreate(candidate, UriKind.Absolute, out var absolute)
            : Uri.TryCreate(baseUri, candidate, out absolute);

        if (!ok || absolute is null || !WikiUrls.IsWikiPage(absolute.AbsoluteUri))
        {
            return false;
        }

        uri = absolute;
        return true;
    }
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Wiki/WikiTypes.cs`:

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

/// <summary>The closed set of item types, in priority order (the first wins when a page is in several indexes).</summary>
public enum WikiType
{
    Class,
    Armor,
    Weapon,
    Helm,
    Cape,
    Pet,
    House,
    Other,
}

public static class WikiTypes
{
    /// <summary>The type of the items listed on a type index page; Other for every index without its own type.</summary>
    public static WikiType ForIndex(string indexSlug) => indexSlug switch
    {
        WikiUrls.ClassesSlug => WikiType.Class,
        WikiUrls.ArmorsSlug => WikiType.Armor,
        WikiUrls.WeaponsSlug => WikiType.Weapon,
        WikiUrls.HelmetsSlug => WikiType.Helm,
        WikiUrls.CapesSlug => WikiType.Cape,
        WikiUrls.PetsSlug or WikiUrls.BattlePetsSlug => WikiType.Pet,
        WikiUrls.HousesSlug => WikiType.House,
        _ => WikiType.Other,
    };

    /// <summary>The type to keep when a page is found in two indexes: the one earlier in the enum wins.</summary>
    public static WikiType Prefer(WikiType a, WikiType b) => a <= b ? a : b;
}
```

`src/AqwCompanion.Core/Wiki/WikiUrls.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Common;

namespace AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

/// <summary>Addresses of the AQW Wiki pages the companion reads. Every page constant lives here.</summary>
public static class WikiUrls
{
    public const string Host = "aqwwiki.wikidot.com";
    public const string Root = "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/";

    public const string RobotsSlug = "robots.txt";
    public const string HardFarmSlug = "syfarm";

    public const string ClassesSlug = "classes";
    public const string ArmorsSlug = "armors";
    public const string WeaponsSlug = "weapons";
    public const string HelmetsSlug = "helmets-hoods";
    public const string CapesSlug = "capes-back-items";
    public const string PetsSlug = "pets";
    public const string BattlePetsSlug = "battle-pets";
    public const string HousesSlug = "houses";
    public const string FloorItemsSlug = "floor-items";
    public const string WallItemsSlug = "wall-items";
    public const string MiscItemsSlug = "misc-items";
    public const string UseItemsSlug = "use-items";
    public const string NecklacesSlug = "necklaces";
    public const string GroundsSlug = "grounds";
    public const string EnhancementsSlug = "enhancements";

    /// <summary>The longest page name accepted.</summary>
    public const int MaxSlugLength = 100;

    // robots.txt is the one fixed address that is not a page name (it has a dot).
    public static readonly string Robots = Root + RobotsSlug;
    public static readonly string HardFarm = Page(HardFarmSlug);

    /// <summary>The type index pages, in the order they are fetched; <see cref="ClassesSlug"/> comes first.</summary>
    public static readonly IReadOnlyList<string> TypeIndexSlugs =
    [
        ClassesSlug, ArmorsSlug, WeaponsSlug, HelmetsSlug, CapesSlug, PetsSlug, BattlePetsSlug, HousesSlug,
        FloorItemsSlug, WallItemsSlug, MiscItemsSlug, UseItemsSlug, NecklacesSlug, GroundsSlug, EnhancementsSlug,
    ];

    /// <summary>
    /// True for a page name that is safe to put in an address: 1 to <see cref="MaxSlugLength"/> characters, the first a lower-case
    /// letter or digit, the rest lower-case letters, digits, '_' or '-'. Nothing else (no '/', '.', '?', '#', '%', ':', '@',
    /// white space, control or non-ASCII characters) is accepted, because page names come from third-party content.
    /// </summary>
    public static bool IsValidSlug([System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.NotNullWhen(true)] string? slug)
    {
        if (slug is null || slug.Length == 0 || slug.Length > MaxSlugLength)
        {
            return false;
        }

        for (var i = 0; i < slug.Length; i++)
        {
            var c = slug[i];
            var alnum = c is >= 'a' and <= 'z' or >= '0' and <= '9';
            if (!(alnum || (i > 0 && c is '_' or '-')))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>The https address of a wiki page; throws <see cref="ArgumentException"/> for a slug that is not <see cref="IsValidSlug"/>.</summary>
    public static string Page(string slug) =>
        TryPage(slug, out var url) ? url : throw new ArgumentException("The wiki page name is not valid.", nameof(slug));

    /// <summary>The https address of a wiki page, or false (and an empty <paramref name="url"/>) for an invalid slug.</summary>
    public static bool TryPage(string? slug, out string url)
    {
        if (IsValidSlug(slug))
        {
            url = Root + slug;
            return true;
        }

        url = string.Empty;
        return false;
    }

    /// <summary>True only for exactly <c>https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/</c> followed by a valid slug: the shape <see cref="Page"/> builds.</summary>
    public static bool IsSafePageUrl(string? url) =>
        url is not null
        && url.StartsWith(Root, StringComparison.Ordinal)
        && TryPage(url[Root.Length..], out var rebuilt)
        && string.Equals(rebuilt, url, StringComparison.Ordinal);

    public static bool IsTypeIndex(string slug) => TypeIndexSlugs.Contains(slug, StringComparer.Ordinal);

    /// <summary>True for an absolute https URL on the wiki host (default port, no user info).</summary>
    public static bool IsWikiPage(string? url) =>
        Uri.TryCreate(url, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri)
        && uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps
        && IsWikiHost(uri);

    /// <summary>
    /// The page name (the single path segment, lower-case) of <c>http(s)://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/slug</c> or <c>/slug</c>;
    /// null for another host, a deeper path, an empty path or anything else. Query and fragment are ignored.
    /// </summary>
    public static string? Slug(string? url)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))
        {
            return null;
        }

        var text = url.Trim();
        string path;
        if (text.StartsWith('/') && !text.StartsWith("//", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            path = text;
        }
        else if (Uri.TryCreate(text, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri)
            && (uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttp || uri.Scheme == Uri.UriSchemeHttps)
            && IsWikiHost(uri))
        {
            path = uri.AbsolutePath;
        }
        else
        {
            return null;
        }

        var end = path.IndexOfAny(['?', '#']);
        if (end >= 0)
        {
            path = path[..end];
        }

        var segment = path.Trim('/');
        if (segment.Length == 0 || segment.Contains('/'))
        {
            return null;
        }

        try
        {
            segment = Uri.UnescapeDataString(segment);
        }
        catch (UriFormatException)
        {
            return null;
        }

        return segment.Length == 0 || segment.Contains('/') ? null : segment.ToLowerInvariant();
    }

    private static bool IsWikiHost(Uri uri) =>
        uri.Host.EqualsIgnoreCase(Host) && uri.IsDefaultPort && uri.UserInfo.Length == 0;
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Architecture/AppIconTests.cs`:

```cs
using System.Buffers.Binary;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Architecture;

/// <summary>
/// The app icon is the project logo. These tests keep the two asset files well formed: the .ico carries every standard size
/// (the Windows shell picks the one it needs) and the .png is the 256 px window and tray icon.
/// </summary>
public class AppIconTests
{
    private static readonly byte[] PngSignature = [0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A];

    [Fact]
    public void The_ico_holds_every_standard_size_as_a_png()
    {
        var bytes = File.ReadAllBytes(AssetPath("app.ico"));

        Assert.Equal(0, BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16LittleEndian(bytes.AsSpan(0)));
        Assert.Equal(1, BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16LittleEndian(bytes.AsSpan(2)));
        var count = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16LittleEndian(bytes.AsSpan(4));

        var sizes = new List<int>();
        for (var i = 0; i < count; i++)
        {
            var entry = bytes.AsSpan(6 + (i * 16), 16);
            sizes.Add(entry[0] == 0 ? 256 : entry[0]);
            Assert.Equal(sizes[^1], entry[1] == 0 ? 256 : entry[1]);
            var length = (int)BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32LittleEndian(entry[8..]);
            var offset = (int)BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt32LittleEndian(entry[12..]);
            Assert.True(offset + length <= bytes.Length);
            Assert.True(bytes.AsSpan(offset, length)[..8].SequenceEqual(PngSignature), "Each entry is a PNG image.");
        }

        Assert.Equal([16, 32, 48, 64, 128, 256], sizes.Order());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_png_is_the_256_pixel_window_icon()
    {
        var bytes = File.ReadAllBytes(AssetPath("app.png"));

        Assert.True(bytes.AsSpan(0, 8).SequenceEqual(PngSignature));
        Assert.Equal(256, BinaryPrimitives.ReadInt32BigEndian(bytes.AsSpan(16)));
        Assert.Equal(256, BinaryPrimitives.ReadInt32BigEndian(bytes.AsSpan(20)));
    }

    private static string AssetPath(string name)
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
        while (dir is not null)
        {
            var candidate = Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "src", "AqwCompanion.App", "Assets", name);
            if (File.Exists(candidate))
            {
                return candidate;
            }

            dir = dir.Parent;
        }

        throw new FileNotFoundException(name + " not found above " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Xml.Linq;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Architecture;

/// <summary>
/// The Game data capture opens network devices and starts by itself when the app opens, so the executable must ask Windows for
/// administrator rights in its manifest. Losing that line would silently turn the capture into "needs administrator".
/// </summary>
public class AppManifestTests
{
    private static readonly XNamespace V3 = "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:asm.v3";

    [Fact]
    public void The_manifest_asks_for_administrator_rights()
    {
        var level = Manifest()
            .Descendants(V3 + "requestedExecutionLevel")
            .Select(e => (string?)e.Attribute("level"))
            .SingleOrDefault();

        Assert.Equal("requireAdministrator", level);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_manifest_declares_windows_10_support_so_the_app_does_not_run_in_legacy_mode()
    {
        var ids = Manifest()
            .Descendants(XName.Get("supportedOS", "urn:schemas-microsoft-com:compatibility.v1"))
            .Select(e => (string?)e.Attribute("Id"))
            .ToList();

        Assert.Contains("{8e0f7a12-bfb3-4fe8-b9a5-48fd50a15a9a}", ids);
    }

    private static XDocument Manifest()
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
        while (dir is not null)
        {
            var candidate = Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "src", "AqwCompanion.App", "app.manifest");
            if (File.Exists(candidate))
            {
                return XDocument.Load(candidate);
            }

            dir = dir.Parent;
        }

        throw new FileNotFoundException("app.manifest not found above " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
```

```cs
using System.Xml.Linq;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Architecture;

/// <summary>The parchment palette must keep readable text on every surface it is drawn on (WCAG 2.x contrast).</summary>
public class AqwThemeTests
{
    private const double Normal = 4.5;

    private static readonly XNamespace Xaml = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml";

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("AqwText")]
    [InlineData("AqwTextBright")]
    [InlineData("AqwTextMuted")]
    [InlineData("AqwTextSecondary")]
    [InlineData("AqwLink")]
    [InlineData("AqwDangerText")]
    public void Text_colors_are_readable_on_the_page_the_paper_and_the_darker_band(string text)
    {
        var colors = Colors();

        foreach (var surface in new[] { "AqwWindowBackground", "AqwSurface", "AqwSurfaceRaised" })
        {
            Assert.True(
                Contrast(colors[text + "Color"], colors[surface + "Color"]) >= Normal,
                $"{text} on {surface} is below {Normal}:1");
        }
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("AqwAccentText", "AqwAccent")]
    [InlineData("AqwSuccessText", "AqwSuccess")]
    [InlineData("AqwOnTopBar", "AqwTopBar")]
    [InlineData("AqwSuccess", "AqwSurface")]
    public void Text_on_its_own_fill_is_readable(string text, string fill)
    {
        var colors = Colors();

        Assert.True(Contrast(colors[text + "Color"], colors[fill + "Color"]) >= Normal, $"{text} on {fill} is below {Normal}:1");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_window_background_is_the_parchment_of_the_aqw_site()
    {
        Assert.Equal("#FEF0C2", Colors()["AqwWindowBackgroundColor"], ignoreCase: true);
    }

    private static Dictionary<string, string> Colors() =>
        Load("Themes", "AqwTheme.axaml").Root!
            .Elements()
            .Where(e => e.Name.LocalName == "Color")
            .ToDictionary(e => (string)e.Attribute(Xaml + "Key")!, e => e.Value.Trim());

    private static double Contrast(string a, string b)
    {
        var (light, dark) = (Luminance(a), Luminance(b));
        if (light < dark)
        {
            (light, dark) = (dark, light);
        }

        return (light + 0.05) / (dark + 0.05);
    }

    private static double Luminance(string hex)
    {
        var rgb = new[] { 1, 3, 5 }
            .Select(i => Convert.ToInt32(hex.Substring(i, 2), 16) / 255.0)
            .Select(c => c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : Math.Pow((c + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4))
            .ToArray();
        return 0.2126 * rgb[0] + 0.7152 * rgb[1] + 0.0722 * rgb[2];
    }

    private static XDocument Load(params string[] relative)
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
        while (dir is not null)
        {
            var candidate = Path.Combine([dir.FullName, "src", "AqwCompanion.App", .. relative]);
            if (File.Exists(candidate))
            {
                return XDocument.Load(candidate);
            }

            dir = dir.Parent;
        }

        throw new FileNotFoundException(Path.Combine(relative) + " not found above " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
```

```cs
        Assert.DoesNotContain(referenced, name => name.Contains("AqwCompanion.App", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));

        Assert.True(typeof(IPacketSource).IsAssignableFrom(typeof(PcapStreamSource)));
    }

    {
        var referenced = assembly.GetReferencedAssemblies().Select(a => a.Name ?? string.Empty).ToList();

        Assert.DoesNotContain(referenced,
            name => CaptureLibraries.Any(l => name.Contains(l, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)));
    }

    private static void AssertProjectHasNone(string csprojPath)
    {
        var csproj = File.ReadAllText(csprojPath);

        foreach (var library in CaptureLibraries)
        {
            Assert.DoesNotContain(library, csproj, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }
    }

    private static string FindProject(string folder, string name)
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
        while (dir is not null)
        {
            var candidate = Path.Combine(dir.FullName, folder, name, name + ".csproj");
            if (File.Exists(candidate))
            {
                return candidate;
            }
            dir = dir.Parent;
        }
        throw new FileNotFoundException(name + ".csproj not found above " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Architecture/LogTemplateTests.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Architecture;

/// <summary>
/// The log guard rewrites property values but not the message template, so a value must never be interpolated into a template.
/// Messages are fixed text with {Placeholders}; the guard masks what fills them.
/// </summary>
public partial class LogTemplateTests
{
    // Log.Error($"..."), Log.Error(ex, $"..."), logger.LogWarning($"..."), _log.Information(ex, $@"...") and the like.
    [GeneratedRegex(
        """\b(?:Log|_log|log|_logger|logger)\.(?:Verbose|Debug|Information|Warning|Error|Fatal|Write|LogTrace|LogDebug|LogInformation|LogWarning|LogError|LogCritical)\(\s*(?:[A-Za-z_][\w.]*\s*,\s*)?\$@?"{1,3}""")]
    private static partial Regex InterpolatedLogCall();

    [Fact]
    public void No_log_call_interpolates_a_value_into_the_template()
    {
        var offenders = new List<string>();
        foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(Path.Combine(SolutionRoot(), "src"), "*.cs", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
        {
            var text = File.ReadAllText(file);
            foreach (Match match in InterpolatedLogCall().Matches(text))
            {
                var line = text.AsSpan(0, match.Index).Count('\n') + 1;
                offenders.Add($"{Path.GetRelativePath(SolutionRoot(), file)}:{line}");
            }
        }

        Assert.True(offenders.Count == 0, "Interpolated log templates: " + string.Join(", ", offenders));
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("Log.Error($\"failed {value}\");")]
    [InlineData("Log.Error(ex, $\"failed {value}\");")]
    [InlineData("_logger.LogWarning($\"failed {value}\");")]
    [InlineData("Log.Information(ex, $@\"failed {value}\");")]
    public void The_pattern_recognises_interpolated_templates(string code) =>
        Assert.Matches(InterpolatedLogCall(), code);

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("Log.Error(\"failed {SafeValue}\", value);")]
    [InlineData("Log.Error(ex, \"failed {SafeValue}\", value);")]
    [InlineData("var text = $\"failed {value}\";")]
    public void The_pattern_leaves_placeholder_templates_alone(string code) =>
        Assert.DoesNotMatch(InterpolatedLogCall(), code);

    private static string SolutionRoot()
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
        while (dir is not null)
        {
            if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(dir.FullName, "AqwCompanion.slnx")))
            {
                return dir.FullName;
            }

            dir = dir.Parent;
        }

        throw new FileNotFoundException("AqwCompanion.slnx not found above " + AppContext.BaseDirectory);
    }
}
```

```cs
namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Architecture;

public class SingleLogConfigurationPointTests
{
    private static string FindRepositoryRoot()
    {
        var directory = new DirectoryInfo(AppContext.BaseDirectory);
        while (directory is not null && !File.Exists(Path.Combine(directory.FullName, "AqwCompanion.slnx")))
        {
            directory = directory.Parent;
        }

        return directory?.FullName ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("AqwCompanion.slnx not found above the test folder.");
    }

    private static IEnumerable<string> SourceFiles() =>
        Directory.EnumerateFiles(Path.Combine(FindRepositoryRoot(), "src"), "*.cs", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
            .Where(f =>
            {
                var relative = Path.GetRelativePath(Path.Combine(FindRepositoryRoot(), "src"), f);
                return !relative.Split(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar).Any(part => part is "obj" or "bin");
            });

    private static bool IsLoggingSetup(string file) =>
        string.Equals(Path.GetFileName(file), "LoggingSetup.cs", StringComparison.Ordinal);

    [Fact]
    public void Logger_configuration_is_created_only_in_LoggingSetup()
    {
        var files = SourceFiles().ToList();
        Assert.Contains(files, IsLoggingSetup);

        var offenders = files
            .Where(f => !IsLoggingSetup(f) && File.ReadAllText(f).Contains("new LoggerConfiguration(", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .ToList();

        Assert.Empty(offenders);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void No_log_destination_is_added_outside_LoggingSetup()
    {
        var offenders = SourceFiles()
            .Where(f => !IsLoggingSetup(f) && File.ReadAllText(f).Contains(".WriteTo.", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .ToList();

        Assert.Empty(offenders);
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/AutoStart/ScheduledTaskAutoStartTests.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.AutoStart;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.AutoStart;

public class ScheduledTaskAutoStartTests
{
    private sealed class FakeRunner(params int[] exitCodes) : IProcessRunner
    {
        private readonly Queue<int> _codes = new(exitCodes);

        public List<(string File, string[] Args)> Calls { get; } = [];

        public int Run(string file, IReadOnlyList<string> args)
        {
            Calls.Add((file, [.. args]));
            return _codes.Count > 0 ? _codes.Dequeue() : 0;
        }
    }

    private const string Exe = @"C:\Program Files\Questkeeper\AqwCompanion.exe";

    private static ScheduledTaskAutoStart Build(FakeRunner runner, bool windows = true, string? exe = Exe) =>
        new(runner, exe, @"PC\player", () => windows);

    [Fact]
    public void It_is_supported_only_on_windows_with_a_known_exe()
    {
        Assert.True(Build(new FakeRunner()).IsSupported);
        Assert.False(Build(new FakeRunner(), windows: false).IsSupported);
        Assert.False(Build(new FakeRunner(), exe: null).IsSupported);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Unsupported_never_runs_anything()
    {
        var runner = new FakeRunner();
        var autoStart = Build(runner, windows: false);

        Assert.False(autoStart.IsEnabled());
        Assert.False(autoStart.TrySet(true));
        Assert.Empty(runner.Calls);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(0, true)]
    [InlineData(1, false)]
    public void It_is_enabled_when_the_task_exists(int exitCode, bool expected)
    {
        var runner = new FakeRunner(exitCode);

        Assert.Equal(expected, Build(runner).IsEnabled());

        var call = Assert.Single(runner.Calls);
        Assert.Equal("schtasks.exe", call.File);
        Assert.Equal(["/Query", "/TN", ScheduledTaskAutoStart.TaskName], call.Args);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Turning_it_on_creates_a_logon_task_that_runs_elevated_in_the_background()
    {
        var runner = new FakeRunner(0);

        Assert.True(Build(runner).TrySet(true));

        var call = Assert.Single(runner.Calls);
        Assert.Equal("schtasks.exe", call.File);
        Assert.Equal(
            [
                "/Create", "/TN", ScheduledTaskAutoStart.TaskName, "/TR", "\"" + Exe + "\" --background", "/SC", "ONLOGON",
                "/RL", "HIGHEST", "/RU", @"PC\player", "/IT", "/DELAY", "0000:15", "/F",
            ],
            call.Args);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_failed_create_is_reported()
    {
        Assert.False(Build(new FakeRunner(1)).TrySet(true));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Turning_it_off_deletes_the_task_when_it_exists()
    {
        var runner = new FakeRunner(0, 0);

        Assert.True(Build(runner).TrySet(false));

        Assert.Equal(2, runner.Calls.Count);
        Assert.Equal(["/Delete", "/TN", ScheduledTaskAutoStart.TaskName, "/F"], runner.Calls[1].Args);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Turning_it_off_when_there_is_no_task_succeeds_without_deleting()
    {
        var runner = new FakeRunner(1);

        Assert.True(Build(runner).TrySet(false));

        Assert.Single(runner.Calls);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_failed_delete_is_reported()
    {
        Assert.False(Build(new FakeRunner(0, 1)).TrySet(false));
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Capture/CaptureEngineLiveTests.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.Json;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;
using static AqwCompanion.Tests.Capture.GameCaptureBuilder;
using static AqwCompanion.Tests.Capture.SecretScan;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Capture;

public class CaptureEngineLiveTests
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Now = new(2026, 11, 8, 12, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    private sealed class FixedClock : TimeProvider
    {
        public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => Now;
    }

    /// <summary>One engine with the events it raises, in order.</summary>
    private sealed class Rig
    {
        public CaptureEngine Engine { get; } = new(new FixedClock());

        public List<CharacterSnapshot> Captured { get; } = [];

        public List<CharacterSnapshot> Updated { get; } = [];

        public List<string> Order { get; } = [];

        public Rig()
        {
            Engine.CharacterCaptured += snapshot =>
            {
                Captured.Add(snapshot);
                Order.Add("captured");
            };
            Engine.CharacterUpdated += snapshot =>
            {
                Updated.Add(snapshot);
                Order.Add("updated");
            };
        }

        /// <summary>Runs a full login on a client port and returns the handle to keep talking on that connection.</summary>
        public Line Login(int clientPort = ClientPort, string name = "Fictional Hero", uint isn = 1000)
        {
            var traffic = Connection(clientPort: clientPort, name: name, isn: isn);
            foreach (var segment in traffic.All)
            {
                Engine.Accept(segment);
            }

            return new Line(this, clientPort, traffic.NextServerSequence);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>One connection after its login: sends server messages one segment at a time.</summary>
    private sealed class Line(Rig rig, int clientPort, uint sequence)
    {
        public uint Sequence { get; private set; } = sequence;

        public int ClientPort { get; } = clientPort;

        public void Send(params byte[][] messages)
        {
            var payload = messages.SelectMany(m => m.Append((byte)0)).ToArray();
            rig.Engine.Accept(ServerData(Sequence, payload, ClientPort));
            Sequence += (uint)payload.Length;
        }

        public void Fin() => rig.Engine.Accept(Closing(Sequence, ClientPort, rst: false));

        public void Rst() => rig.Engine.Accept(Closing(Sequence, ClientPort, rst: true));
    }

    private static TcpSegment Closing(uint sequence, int clientPort, bool rst) =>
        new(PcapBuilder.ServerAddress, GamePort, PcapBuilder.ClientAddress, clientPort, sequence, false, [], IsFin: !rst, IsRst: rst);

    private static Dictionary<string, object?> Body(params (string Key, object? Value)[] fields) =>
        fields.ToDictionary(f => f.Key, f => f.Value);

    private static byte[] GoldExp(object gold, object exp) =>
        PlainJson(Envelope("addGoldExp", Body(("intGold", gold), ("intExp", exp), ("typ", "m"), ("id", 4))));

    private static byte[] Plain(string cmd) => PlainJson(Envelope(cmd, Body(("id", 1))));

    [Fact]
    public void The_live_diagnostics_start_at_zero()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();

        Assert.Equal(CaptureLiveDiagnostics.Empty, rig.Engine.Live);
        Assert.Equal(new CaptureLiveDiagnostics(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0), rig.Engine.Live);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_plain_gold_event_after_the_login_raises_character_updated_with_the_gold_increased()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();
        var line = rig.Login();

        line.Send(GoldExp(40, 15));

        var updated = Assert.Single(rig.Updated);
        Assert.Equal(9876543210L + 40, updated.Profile.Gold);
        Assert.Equal(123456L + 15, updated.Profile.Exp);
        Assert.Equal("Fictional Hero", updated.Profile.Name);
        var captured = Assert.Single(rig.Captured);
        Assert.Equal(9876543210L, captured.Profile.Gold);
        Assert.Equal(["captured", "updated"], rig.Order);
        var live = rig.Engine.Live;
        Assert.Equal((1, 1, 0, 0, 40L, 15L), (live.LiveConnections, live.LiveEventsApplied, live.LiveEventsIgnored, live.LiveEventsUnmatched, live.LastGoldGain, live.LastExpGain));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Events_pile_up_on_the_newest_snapshot_of_the_connection()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();
        var line = rig.Login();

        line.Send(GoldExp(40, 15));
        line.Send(GoldExp(10, 5), PlainJson(Envelope("updateClass", Body(("iCP", 777)))));

        Assert.Equal(3, rig.Updated.Count);
        Assert.Equal(9876543210L + 50, rig.Updated[^1].Profile.Gold);
        Assert.Equal(777, rig.Updated[^1].Profile.ClassPoints);
        Assert.Equal((10L, 5L), (rig.Engine.Live.LastGoldGain, rig.Engine.Live.LastExpGain));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_live_event_in_the_same_segment_as_the_end_of_the_login_is_applied_after_the_capture()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();

        foreach (var segment in Connection(segmentSize: 1_000_000, extraServerMessages: [GoldExp(7, 3)]).All)
        {
            rig.Engine.Accept(segment);
        }

        Assert.Equal(["captured", "updated"], rig.Order);
        Assert.Equal(9876543210L + 7, Assert.Single(rig.Updated).Profile.Gold);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_same_event_inside_an_encoded_blob_is_never_decoded()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();
        var line = rig.Login();
        var decodedBefore = rig.Engine.Counters.MessagesDecoded;
        var skippedBefore = rig.Engine.Live.LiveEncodedSkipped;
        var failuresBefore = rig.Engine.Decoding.Failures.Values.Sum();

        line.Send(EncodeBlob(Envelope("addGoldExp", Body(("intGold", 500), ("intExp", 500), ("typ", "m")))));

        Assert.Empty(rig.Updated);
        Assert.Equal(decodedBefore, rig.Engine.Counters.MessagesDecoded);
        Assert.Equal(skippedBefore + 1, rig.Engine.Live.LiveEncodedSkipped);
        Assert.Equal(failuresBefore, rig.Engine.Decoding.Failures.Values.Sum());
        Assert.Equal(0, rig.Engine.Decoding.Command("addGoldExp"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Other_players_profile_messages_after_the_login_are_never_decoded()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();
        var line = rig.Login();

        line.Send(
            EncodeBlob(Envelope("initUserDatas", Body(("a", new List<object?> { new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["data"] = ProfileData(SecretPlayer, own: false) } })))),
            EncodeBlob(InitUserData(ProfileData(SecretPlayer + "-3"))),
            EncodeBlob(StandardInventory()));

        Assert.Single(rig.Captured);
        Assert.Empty(rig.Updated);
        Assert.Equal(2, rig.Engine.Counters.MessagesDecoded);
        Assert.Equal(5, rig.Engine.Live.LiveEncodedSkipped);
        Assert.Equal(0, rig.Engine.Decoding.Command("initUserDatas"));
        Assert.Equal(1, rig.Engine.Decoding.Command("initUserData"));
        Assert.Equal(1, rig.Engine.Decoding.InitUserDataAccepted);
        Assert.Equal((1, 1), (rig.Engine.Stages.ProfilePartsSeen, rig.Engine.Stages.InventoryPartsSeen));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Text_and_xml_messages_on_a_live_connection_are_skipped_without_reading()
    {

        var before = rig.Engine.Live.LiveEncodedSkipped;

        Assert.Equal(before + 2, rig.Engine.Live.LiveEncodedSkipped);
        Assert.Equal(2, rig.Engine.Counters.MessagesDecoded);

    [Fact]
    public void An_unknown_plain_command_is_counted_by_name_without_parsing_the_json()
    {

        var brokenUnknown = Bytes("{\"t\":\"xt\",\"b\":{\"r\":-1,\"o\":{\"cmd\":\"zzz\",\"x\":[1,2,}}}" + SecretPlayer);
        var brokenKnown = Bytes("{\"t\":\"xt\",\"b\":{\"r\":-1,\"o\":{\"cmd\":\"ct\",\"p\":{\"" + SecretPlayer + "\":}}}");

        var thrown = Record.Exception(() => line.Send(brokenUnknown, brokenUnknown, brokenKnown));

        Assert.Null(thrown);
        var decoding = rig.Engine.Decoding;
        Assert.Equal([KeyValuePair.Create("zzz", 2)], decoding.OtherNames);
        Assert.Equal(2, decoding.Command("other"));
        Assert.Equal(1, decoding.Command("ct"));
        Assert.Equal(0, decoding.Failure(DecodeFailure.InvalidJson));
        Assert.Equal(2, rig.Engine.Counters.MessagesDecoded);
        Assert.Empty(rig.Updated);
        AssertNoSecrets(decoding);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_live_command_with_broken_json_is_ignored_without_an_exception()

    [Fact]
    public void The_command_name_is_only_looked_for_in_the_first_256_bytes()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();
        var line = rig.Login();
        var late = Bytes("{\"t\":\"xt\",\"pad\":\"" + new string('a', 300) + "\",\"b\":{\"o\":{\"cmd\":\"addGoldExp\",\"intGold\":900,\"intExp\":900}}}");
        var early = Bytes("{\"t\":\"xt\",\"b\":{\"o\":{\"cmd\":\"addGoldExp\",\"intGold\":900,\"intExp\":900}},\"pad\":\"" + new string('a', 300) + "\"}");

        line.Send(late);
        Assert.Empty(rig.Updated);
        Assert.Equal(1, rig.Engine.Decoding.Command("other"));

        line.Send(early);
        Assert.Single(rig.Updated);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("add Gold")]

    [Fact]

        Assert.Null(LiveCommandScan.ReadName(Bytes("{\"cmd\":\"")));
        Assert.Null(LiveCommandScan.ReadName(Bytes("{\"cmd\":\"unterminated")));
        Assert.Null(LiveCommandScan.ReadName(Bytes("{\"cmd\": \"spaced\"}")));
        Assert.Null(LiveCommandScan.ReadName(Bytes("{\"command\":\"x\"}")));
        Assert.Null(LiveCommandScan.ReadName([]));
        Assert.Equal(256, LiveCommandScan.MaxScanBytes);
        Assert.Equal(40, LiveCommandScan.MaxNameLength);

    [Fact]

    [Fact]
    public void When_sixteen_connections_are_live_the_oldest_idle_one_makes_room_for_a_new_login()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();
        var lines = Enumerable.Range(0, CaptureEngine.MaxConnections)
            .Select(i => rig.Login(51000 + i, $"Hero {i}", isn: (uint)(1000 + i * 100_000)))
            .ToList();
        lines[0].Send(GoldExp(1, 1));
        lines[1].Send(GoldExp(1, 1));

        var latest = rig.Login(52000, "Late Hero", isn: 5_000_000);
        latest.Send(GoldExp(5, 5));

        Assert.Equal(CaptureEngine.MaxConnections, rig.Engine.Live.LiveConnections);
        Assert.Equal("Late Hero", rig.Updated[^1].Profile.Name);
        var updatesBefore = rig.Updated.Count;
        lines[2].Send(GoldExp(1, 1));
        Assert.Equal(updatesBefore, rig.Updated.Count);
        lines[0].Send(GoldExp(1, 1));
        Assert.Equal(updatesBefore + 1, rig.Updated.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Drop_item_and_get_drop_on_one_connection_add_the_item_and_never_cross_to_another()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();
        var first = rig.Login(50001, "First Hero");
        var second = rig.Login(50002, "Second Hero", isn: 77000);
        var definition = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["ItemID"] = "77", ["sName"] = "Fictional Axe", ["sType"] = "Axe", ["iLvl"] = 30, ["iQty"] = 1, ["iStk"] = 1, ["bCoins"] = 1 };
        var drop = PlainJson(Envelope("dropItem", Body(("items", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["77"] = definition }))));
        var pick = PlainJson(Envelope("getDrop", Body(("bSuccess", 1), ("ItemID", 77), ("CharItemID", 8800), ("iQty", 1), ("iQtyNow", 1), ("bBank", 0))));

        first.Send(drop);
        second.Send(pick);
        Assert.Empty(rig.Updated);
        Assert.Equal(1, rig.Engine.Live.LiveEventsUnmatched);

        first.Send(pick);
        var updated = Assert.Single(rig.Updated);
        Assert.Equal("First Hero", updated.Profile.Name);
        Assert.Equal("Fictional Axe", updated.Items[^1].Name);
        Assert.Equal(8800, updated.Items[^1].CharItemId);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Events_that_change_nothing_are_counted_but_raise_nothing()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();
        var line = rig.Login();

        line.Send(
            PlainJson(Envelope("addItems", Body(("items", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["1"] = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["CharItemID"] = 1, ["iQtyNow"] = 5 } })))),
            PlainJson(Envelope("updateClass", Body(("sClassName", "X")))));

        Assert.Empty(rig.Updated);
        var live = rig.Engine.Live;
        Assert.Equal((0, 1, 1), (live.LiveEventsApplied, live.LiveEventsIgnored, live.LiveEventsUnmatched));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_failing_update_subscriber_does_not_stop_the_capture()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();
        rig.Engine.CharacterUpdated += _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("boom");
        var line = rig.Login();

        var thrown = Record.Exception(() => line.Send(GoldExp(1, 1), GoldExp(2, 2)));

        Assert.Null(thrown);
        Assert.Equal(2, rig.Updated.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Markers_never_leak_into_the_diagnostics_or_the_snapshots()
    {
        var rig = new Rig();
        var line = rig.Login();
        var noisy = Envelope("addGoldExp", Body(("intGold", 5), ("intExp", 5), ("strEmail", SecretEmail), ("strIP", SecretIp), ("uName", SecretPlayer)));

        line.Send(
            PlainJson(noisy),
            EncodeBlob(noisy),
            Bytes("{\"t\":\"xt\",\"b\":{\"o\":{\"cmd\":\"" + SecretEmail + "\",\"x\":}}}"),
            Bytes("%xt%" + SecretPassword + "%"),
            PlainJson(Envelope("ct", Body(("p", new Dictionary<string, object?> { [SecretPlayer] = 1 })))));

        foreach (var snapshot in rig.Captured.Concat(rig.Updated))
        {
            AssertNoSecrets(snapshot);
        }

        AssertNoSecrets(rig.Engine.Live);
        AssertNoSecrets(rig.Engine.Decoding);
        AssertNoSecrets(rig.Engine.Connections);
        AssertNoSecrets(rig.Engine.Counters);
        AssertNoSecrets(rig.Engine.Stages);
        Assert.DoesNotContain(SecretToken, JsonSerializer.Serialize(rig.Engine.Decoding), StringComparison.Ordinal);
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Capture/CaptureEngineTests.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;
using static AqwCompanion.Tests.Capture.GameCaptureBuilder;
using static AqwCompanion.Tests.Capture.SecretScan;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Capture;

public class CaptureEngineTests
{
    private static readonly DateTimeOffset Now = new(2026, 11, 7, 12, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero);

    private sealed class FixedClock : TimeProvider
    {
        public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => Now;
    }

    private static (CaptureEngine Engine, List<CharacterSnapshot> Captured) NewEngine()
    {
        var engine = new CaptureEngine(new FixedClock());
        var captured = new List<CharacterSnapshot>();
        engine.CharacterCaptured += captured.Add;
        return (engine, captured);
    }

    private static void Feed(CaptureEngine engine, IEnumerable<TcpSegment> segments)
    {
        foreach (var segment in segments)
        {
            engine.Accept(segment);
        }
    }

    private static void AssertStandardSnapshot(CharacterSnapshot snapshot, string name = "Fictional Hero")
    {
        Assert.Equal(name, snapshot.Profile.Name);
        Assert.Equal(60, snapshot.Profile.Level);
        Assert.Equal(9876543210L, snapshot.Profile.Gold);
        Assert.Equal(Now, snapshot.CapturedAtUtc);
        Assert.Equal(
            [(5, 3, 5000, 1400, 6400), (6, 10, 302500, 0, 0), (7, 1, 0, 0, 900)],
            snapshot.Factions.Select(f => (f.FactionId, f.Rank, f.Rep, f.SpillRep, f.RepToRank)));
        Assert.Equal(["Fictional Blade", "Fictional Class"], snapshot.Items.Select(i => i.Name));
        Assert.Equal(9, snapshot.Items[1].ClassId);
        Assert.Equal(ItemFlags.House, Assert.Single(snapshot.HouseItems).Flags);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void One_full_login_gives_one_snapshot_with_the_expected_values()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();

        Feed(engine, Connection().All);

        AssertStandardSnapshot(Assert.Single(captured));
        Assert.Equal(1, engine.Counters.CharactersCaptured);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_inventory_arriving_before_the_profile_gives_the_same_snapshot()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();

        Feed(engine, Connection(inventoryFirst: true).All);

        AssertStandardSnapshot(Assert.Single(captured));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Split_and_shuffled_segments_still_give_the_snapshot()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();
        var traffic = Connection(segmentSize: 300);
        var data = traffic.Server.Skip(1).OrderBy(_ => 0).ToList();
        var random = new Random(7);
        var shuffled = data.OrderBy(_ => random.Next()).ToList();

        engine.Accept(traffic.Server[0]);
        Feed(engine, shuffled);

        Assert.True(data.Count < StreamReassembler.MaxPendingSegments);
        AssertStandardSnapshot(Assert.Single(captured));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Two_interleaved_connections_give_two_snapshots_with_different_names()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();
        var first = Connection(clientPort: 50001, name: "First Hero", segmentSize: 500).Server;
        var second = Connection(clientPort: 50002, name: "Second Hero", isn: 77000, segmentSize: 500).Server;

        for (var i = 0; i < Math.Max(first.Count, second.Count); i++)
        {
            if (i < first.Count)
            {
                engine.Accept(first[i]);
            }
            if (i < second.Count)
            {
                engine.Accept(second[i]);
            }
        }

        Assert.Equal(["First Hero", "Second Hero"], captured.Select(c => c.Profile.Name).Order());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_connection_that_never_sends_the_inventory_gives_no_snapshot()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();

        Feed(engine, Connection(includeInventory: false).All);

        Assert.Empty(captured);
        Assert.Equal(0, engine.Counters.CharactersCaptured);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_connection_that_never_sends_the_profile_gives_no_snapshot()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();

        Feed(engine, Connection(includeProfile: false).All);

        Assert.Empty(captured);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void After_completion_further_encoded_messages_are_skipped_not_decoded()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();
        var traffic = Connection();
        Feed(engine, traffic.Server);
        var before = engine.Counters;
        var skippedBefore = engine.Live.LiveEncodedSkipped;

        var extra = EncodeBlob(StandardInventory());
        engine.Accept(ServerData(traffic.NextServerSequence, [.. extra, 0]));
        engine.Accept(ServerData(traffic.NextServerSequence + (uint)extra.Length + 1, [.. extra, 0]));

        var after = engine.Counters;
        Assert.Single(captured);
        Assert.Equal(before.MessagesDecoded, after.MessagesDecoded);
        Assert.Equal(before.CharactersCaptured, after.CharactersCaptured);
        Assert.Equal(before.SegmentsDropped, after.SegmentsDropped);
        Assert.Equal(before.SegmentsSeen + 2, after.SegmentsSeen);
        Assert.Equal(skippedBefore + 2, engine.Live.LiveEncodedSkipped);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Messages_after_completion_in_the_same_segment_are_not_decoded()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();
        var traffic = Connection(segmentSize: 1_000_000, extraServerMessages: [EncodeBlob(StandardInventory()), EncodeBlob(InitUserData(ProfileData("Second Name")))]);

        Feed(engine, traffic.Server);

        Assert.Equal("Fictional Hero", Assert.Single(captured).Profile.Name);
        Assert.Equal(2, engine.Counters.MessagesDecoded);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Client_to_server_segments_are_dropped_and_counted_never_decoded()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();

        // Even a valid game message from the client must never reach a decoder.
        engine.Accept(ClientData(1, PlainJson(Envelope("loadInventoryBig", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["items"] = new List<object?>() }))));
        engine.Accept(ClientData(2, EncodeBlob(InitUserData())));
        Feed(engine, Connection().Client);

        Assert.Empty(captured);
        Assert.Equal(new CaptureCounters(4, 4, 0, 0), engine.Counters);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void In_a_full_login_the_client_segments_are_dropped_and_only_server_messages_are_decoded()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();
        var traffic = Connection();

        Feed(engine, traffic.Client);
        Feed(engine, traffic.Server);

        Assert.Single(captured);
        // Dropped: the client segments plus the server segments that arrive after the character is complete.
        Assert.True(engine.Counters.SegmentsDropped >= traffic.Client.Count);
        Assert.Equal(traffic.Client.Count + traffic.Server.Count, engine.Counters.SegmentsSeen);
        // The text and XML messages are not decoded, the other players' blobs come after completion: only the two parts count.
        Assert.Equal(2, engine.Counters.MessagesDecoded);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_stage_counters_count_the_parts_of_a_login_and_nothing_else()
    {
        var (engine, _) = NewEngine();
        Assert.Equal(default, engine.Stages);

        Feed(engine, Connection().All);

        Assert.Equal(new CaptureStageCounters(0, 1, 1, 0), engine.Stages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_long_message_that_cannot_be_read_is_unreadable_but_text_and_xml_are_not()
    {
        var (engine, _) = NewEngine();
        var garbage = Bytes("Z" + new string('A', 60));
        var text = Bytes("%xt%" + new string('x', 60));
        var xml = Bytes("<msg>" + new string('x', 60) + "</msg>");
        var shortGarbage = Bytes("ZAAAA");
        var stream = new[] { garbage, text, xml, shortGarbage }.SelectMany(m => m.Append((byte)0)).ToArray();

        engine.Accept(SynAck(1000));
        engine.Accept(ServerData(1001, stream));

        Assert.Equal(new CaptureStageCounters(1, 0, 0, 0), engine.Stages);
        Assert.Equal(0, engine.Counters.MessagesDecoded);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_readable_message_with_another_command_counts_as_other()

        var (engine, _) = NewEngine();
        var message = PlainJson(Envelope("mtls", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["id"] = 1 }));

        engine.Accept(SynAck(1000));

        Assert.Equal(new CaptureStageCounters(0, 0, 0, 1), engine.Stages);
        Assert.Equal(1, engine.Counters.MessagesDecoded);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Segments_between_other_ports_are_dropped()
    {
        var (engine, _) = NewEngine();

        engine.Accept(new TcpSegment(PcapBuilder.ServerAddress, 443, PcapBuilder.ClientAddress, 50000, 1, false, [1, 2, 3]));

        Assert.Equal(new CaptureCounters(1, 1, 0, 0), engine.Counters);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_segment_between_two_game_ports_is_ambiguous_and_dropped()
    {
        var (engine, _) = NewEngine();

        // A client whose own port falls in the game range: its segments to the server must still never enter the pipeline.
        engine.Accept(new TcpSegment(
            PcapBuilder.ClientAddress, 5590, PcapBuilder.ServerAddress, GameCaptureBuilder.GamePort, 1, false,
            GameCaptureBuilder.Terminated("{\"b\":{\"o\":{\"cmd\":\"initUserData\"}}}")));

        Assert.Equal(new CaptureCounters(1, 1, 0, 0), engine.Counters);

    [Fact]
    public void The_seventeenth_connection_is_ignored()
    {
        var (engine, captured) = NewEngine();
        var partial = Enumerable.Range(0, CaptureEngine.MaxConnections)
            .Select(i => Connection(clientPort: 51000 + i, name: $"Hero {i}", includeInventory: false))
            .ToList();
        foreach (var traffic in partial)
        {
            Feed(engine, traffic.Server);
        }

        Feed(engine, Connection(clientPort: 52000, name: "Late Hero").Server);

        Assert.Empty(captured);

        // The tracked ones can still finish.
        var rest = EncodeBlob(StandardInventory());
```
