`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Shell/PrivacyLogSinkTests.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Logging;
using Serilog.Core;
using Serilog.Events;
using Serilog.Parsing;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Shell;

public sealed class PrivacyLogSinkTests
{
    private sealed class Collector : ILogEventSink
    {
        public List<LogEvent> Events { get; } = [];

        public void Emit(LogEvent logEvent) => Events.Add(logEvent);
    }

    private sealed class CustomType
    {
        public override string ToString() => "SECRET-TOSTRING";
    }

    private static LogEvent Event(string template, Exception? ex = null, params (string Name, LogEventPropertyValue Value)[] props) =>
        new(
            DateTimeOffset.Parse("2026-11-07T10:00:00Z", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            LogEventLevel.Warning,
            ex,
            new MessageTemplateParser().Parse(template),
            props.Select(p => new LogEventProperty(p.Name, p.Value)));

    private static LogEvent Run(LogEvent input)
    {
        var inner = new Collector();
        new PrivacyLogSink(inner).Emit(input);
        return Assert.Single(inner.Events);
    }

    private static string Scalar(LogEvent e, string name) => (string)((ScalarValue)e.Properties[name]).Value!;

    [Fact]
    public void Masks_strings_and_passes_safe_names_and_plain_data()
    {
        var output = Run(Event(
            "t",
            null,
            ("Value", new ScalarValue("SECRET")),
            ("ExceptionType", new ScalarValue("IOException")),
            ("SafeOperation", new ScalarValue("Load")),
            ("AppVersion", new ScalarValue("1.0")),
            ("Count", new ScalarValue(5)),
            ("Flag", new ScalarValue(true)),
            ("Kind", new ScalarValue(DayOfWeek.Monday)),
            ("Span", new ScalarValue(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1))),
            ("Id", new ScalarValue(Guid.Empty)),
            ("Char", new ScalarValue('x'))));

        Assert.Equal("***", Scalar(output, "Value"));
        Assert.Equal("IOException", Scalar(output, "ExceptionType"));
        Assert.Equal("Load", Scalar(output, "SafeOperation"));
        Assert.Equal("1.0", Scalar(output, "AppVersion"));
        Assert.Equal(5, ((ScalarValue)output.Properties["Count"]).Value);
        Assert.Equal(true, ((ScalarValue)output.Properties["Flag"]).Value);
        Assert.Equal(DayOfWeek.Monday, ((ScalarValue)output.Properties["Kind"]).Value);
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1), ((ScalarValue)output.Properties["Span"]).Value);
        Assert.Equal(Guid.Empty, ((ScalarValue)output.Properties["Id"]).Value);
        Assert.Equal("***", Scalar(output, "Char"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Masks_nested_structures_sequences_and_dictionaries()
    {
        var structure = new StructureValue(
            [
                new LogEventProperty("Name", new ScalarValue("SECRET-A")),
                new LogEventProperty("N", new ScalarValue(3)),
                new LogEventProperty("List", new SequenceValue([new ScalarValue("SECRET-B"), new ScalarValue(7)])),
            ],
            "Thing");
        var dictionary = new DictionaryValue(
            new Dictionary<ScalarValue, LogEventPropertyValue> { [new ScalarValue("SECRET-KEY")] = new ScalarValue("SECRET-V") });

        var output = Run(Event("t", null, ("S", structure), ("D", dictionary)));

        var rendered = output.Properties["S"].ToString() + output.Properties["D"];
        Assert.DoesNotContain("SECRET", rendered);
        var rebuilt = (StructureValue)output.Properties["S"];
        Assert.Equal("Thing", rebuilt.TypeTag);
        Assert.Contains("3", rendered);
        Assert.Contains("7", rendered);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Replaces_the_exception_by_a_summary_without_messages()
    {
        var ex = new InvalidOperationException("SECRET-MESSAGE", new ArgumentException("SECRET-INNER"));

        var output = Run(Event("t", ex));

        Assert.Null(output.Exception);
        var summary = Scalar(output, "ExceptionSummary");
        Assert.Contains("System.InvalidOperationException", summary);
        Assert.Contains("--- inner: System.ArgumentException", summary);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("SECRET", summary);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Leaves_template_level_and_timestamp_untouched()
    {
        var input = Event("literal text {Value}", null, ("Value", new ScalarValue("x")));

        var output = Run(input);

        Assert.Equal(input.MessageTemplate.Text, output.MessageTemplate.Text);
        Assert.Equal(input.Level, output.Level);
        Assert.Equal(input.Timestamp, output.Timestamp);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Masks_a_scalar_of_a_custom_type_that_renders_as_text()
    {
        var output = Run(Event("t", null, ("Thing", new ScalarValue(new CustomType()))));

        Assert.Equal("***", Scalar(output, "Thing"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Emits_a_fixed_event_when_sanitising_fails()
    {
        var hostile = new HostileValue();

        var output = Run(Event("SECRET-TEMPLATE {Value}", null, ("Value", hostile)));

        Assert.Equal("A log event could not be sanitised", output.MessageTemplate.Text);
        Assert.Empty(output.Properties);
        Assert.Equal(LogEventLevel.Warning, output.Level);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Dispose_disposes_the_inner_sink()
    {
        var inner = new DisposableSink();

        new PrivacyLogSink(inner).Dispose();

        Assert.True(inner.Disposed);
    }

    private sealed class HostileValue : LogEventPropertyValue
    {
        public override void Render(TextWriter output, string? format = null, IFormatProvider? formatProvider = null) =>
            output.Write("x");
    }

    private sealed class DisposableSink : ILogEventSink, IDisposable
    {
        public bool Disposed { get; private set; }

        public void Emit(LogEvent logEvent)
        {
        }

        public void Dispose() => Disposed = true;
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Shell/SingleInstanceTests.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Shell;

public class SingleInstanceTests
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan Wait = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

    private static string UniqueName() => "AqwCompanionTest" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");

    [Fact]
    public void The_first_becomes_primary()
    {
        using var first = new SingleInstance(UniqueName());

        Assert.True(first.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_second_instance_with_the_same_name_does_not()
    {
        var name = UniqueName();
        using var first = new SingleInstance(name);
        using var second = new SingleInstance(name);
        Assert.True(first.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));

        Assert.False(second.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Another_name_is_independent()
    {
        using var first = new SingleInstance(UniqueName());
        using var other = new SingleInstance(UniqueName());
        Assert.True(first.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));

        Assert.True(other.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task After_the_first_is_disposed_the_second_can_become_primary_within_the_wait()
    {
        var name = UniqueName();
        var first = new SingleInstance(name);
        using var second = new SingleInstance(name);
        Assert.True(first.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
        var release = Task.Run(async () =>
        {
            await Task.Delay(100);
            first.Dispose();
        });

        var became = second.TryBecomePrimary(Wait);

        Assert.True(became);
        await release.WaitAsync(Wait);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Becoming_primary_twice_answers_true_again()
    {
        using var first = new SingleInstance(UniqueName());

        Assert.True(first.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
        Assert.True(first.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_signal_runs_the_primary_callback_once_per_signal()
    {
        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
        {
            // Named events exist only on Windows; elsewhere the guard degrades to no signal.
            return;
        }

        var name = UniqueName();
        using var primary = new SingleInstance(name);
        using var second = new SingleInstance(name);
        Assert.True(primary.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
        using var calls = new SemaphoreSlim(0);
        primary.ListenForSignals(() => calls.Release());

        second.SignalPrimary();
        Assert.True(await calls.WaitAsync(Wait));
        second.SignalPrimary();
        Assert.True(await calls.WaitAsync(Wait));

        Assert.Equal(0, calls.CurrentCount);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Dispose_stops_the_listening()
    {
        var name = UniqueName();
        var primary = new SingleInstance(name);
        using var second = new SingleInstance(name);
        Assert.True(primary.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
        var count = 0;
        primary.ListenForSignals(() => Interlocked.Increment(ref count));

        primary.Dispose();
        second.SignalPrimary();
        await Task.Delay(200);

        Assert.Equal(0, Volatile.Read(ref count));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Disposing_twice_is_safe()
    {
        var instance = new SingleInstance(UniqueName());
        instance.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero);
        instance.ListenForSignals(() => { });

        instance.Dispose();
        instance.Dispose();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Signalling_after_dispose_does_not_throw()
    {
        var instance = new SingleInstance(UniqueName());
        instance.Dispose();

        instance.SignalPrimary();
        Assert.False(instance.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_guard_that_is_not_supported_always_answers_primary_and_never_throws()
    {
        var name = UniqueName();
        using var first = new SingleInstance(name, supported: false);
        using var second = new SingleInstance(name, supported: false);

        Assert.True(first.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
        Assert.True(second.TryBecomePrimary(TimeSpan.Zero));
        first.SignalPrimary();
        first.ListenForSignals(() => throw new InvalidOperationException());
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Shell/TrayControllerTests.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.GameData;
using AqwCompanion.App.Shell;
using AqwCompanion.Capture;
using AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;
using static AqwCompanion.Tests.Capture.GameCaptureBuilder;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Shell;

public class TrayControllerTests
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan Wait = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

    private sealed class RecordingExit(List<string> log) : IApplicationExit
    {
        public int Calls { get; private set; }

        public void Exit()
        {
            Calls++;
            log.Add("exit");
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Toggling_debug_from_the_tray_flips_the_debug_mode()
    {
        var settings = new AqwCompanion.App.Settings.SettingsViewModel(
            new FakeAppSettingsStore(), new AqwCompanion.Core.Forgetting.ForgetCoordinator(() => true, () => []));
        var host = new FakeDebugWindowHost();
        var setup = new Setup();
        var controller = new TrayController(
            setup.Rig.Session, setup.Window, setup.Exit, debug: new AqwCompanion.App.Debug.DebugModeController(settings, host));

        controller.ToggleDebug();
        Assert.True(host.IsOpen);

        controller.ToggleDebug();
        Assert.False(host.IsOpen);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Toggling_debug_without_a_debug_mode_does_nothing()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();

        var ex = Record.Exception(setup.Controller.ToggleDebug);

        Assert.Null(ex);
    }

    private sealed class Setup
    {
        public Setup(TimeSpan? stopTimeout = null)
        {
            Exit = new RecordingExit(Log);
            Window = new FakeMainWindowHost(Log);
            Rig = new CaptureRig();
            Controller = new TrayController(Rig.Session, Window, Exit, stopTimeout);
        }

        public List<string> Log { get; } = [];

        public RecordingExit Exit { get; }

        public FakeMainWindowHost Window { get; }

        public CaptureRig Rig { get; }

        public TrayController Controller { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>A source that feeds the segments, signals, then waits for the token.</summary>
    private static (FakePacketSource Source, TaskCompletionSource Started) Holding(IEnumerable<AqwCompanion.Core.Capture.TcpSegment>? segments = null)
    {
        var started = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var source = new FakePacketSource(async (onSegment, token) =>
        {
            foreach (var segment in segments ?? [])
            {
                onSegment(segment);
            }

            started.SetResult();
            try
            {
                await new TaskCompletionSource().Task.WaitAsync(token);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
        });
        return (source, started);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_close_by_the_user_hides_the_window_and_is_cancelled()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();

        var cancel = setup.Controller.ShouldCancelClose(userInitiated: true);

        Assert.True(cancel);
        Assert.Equal(1, setup.Window.HideCalls);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_close_that_is_not_from_the_user_goes_through_and_does_not_hide()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();

        var cancel = setup.Controller.ShouldCancelClose(userInitiated: false);

        Assert.False(cancel);
        Assert.Equal(0, setup.Window.HideCalls);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task After_exit_started_no_close_is_cancelled()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();

        await setup.Controller.ExitAsync();

        Assert.True(setup.Controller.IsExiting);
        Assert.False(setup.Controller.ShouldCancelClose(userInitiated: true));
        Assert.Equal(0, setup.Window.HideCalls);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Exit_stops_a_running_capture_before_it_exits()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();
        var started = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        setup.Rig.Source = new FakePacketSource(async (_, token) =>
        {
            started.SetResult();
            try
            {
                await new TaskCompletionSource().Task.WaitAsync(token);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }

            await Task.Delay(50);
            lock (setup.Log)
            {
                setup.Log.Add("closed");
            }
        });
        var run = setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(Wait);

        await setup.Controller.ExitAsync().WaitAsync(Wait);

        Assert.Equal(["closed", "exit"], setup.Log);
        Assert.Equal(CaptureState.Done, setup.Rig.Session.State);
        await run.WaitAsync(Wait);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Exit_waits_at_most_the_timeout_for_a_source_that_ignores_the_cancellation()
    {
        var setup = new Setup(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100));
        var started = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        var release = new TaskCompletionSource(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        setup.Rig.Source = new FakePacketSource(async (_, _) =>
        {
            started.SetResult();
            await release.Task;
        });
        try
        {
            var run = setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();
            await started.Task.WaitAsync(Wait);

            await setup.Controller.ExitAsync().WaitAsync(Wait);

            Assert.Equal(1, setup.Exit.Calls);
            Assert.False(run.IsCompleted);
        }
        finally
        {
            release.TrySetResult();
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Exit_is_idempotent()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();

        await setup.Controller.ExitAsync();
        await setup.Controller.ExitAsync();

        Assert.Equal(1, setup.Exit.Calls);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Exit_works_with_an_idle_session()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();

        await setup.Controller.ExitAsync().WaitAsync(Wait);

        Assert.Equal(1, setup.Exit.Calls);
        Assert.Equal(CaptureState.Idle, setup.Rig.Session.State);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Open_shows_the_window()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();

        setup.Controller.Open();

        Assert.Equal(1, setup.Window.ShowCalls);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Toggle_starts_a_capture_when_idle_and_stops_it_when_listening()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();
        var (source, started) = Holding();
        setup.Rig.Source = source;

        setup.Controller.ToggleCapture();
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(Wait);
        Assert.Equal(CaptureState.Listening, setup.Rig.Session.State);

        setup.Controller.ToggleCapture();

        Assert.Equal(CaptureState.Done, setup.Rig.Session.State);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Toggle_starts_again_after_a_finished_capture()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();
        var (first, firstStarted) = Holding();
        setup.Rig.Source = first;
        var run = setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();
        await firstStarted.Task.WaitAsync(Wait);
        setup.Rig.Session.Stop();
        await run.WaitAsync(Wait);
        Assert.Equal(CaptureState.Done, setup.Rig.Session.State);
        var (source, started) = Holding();
        setup.Rig.Source = source;

        setup.Controller.ToggleCapture();
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(Wait);

        Assert.Equal(CaptureState.Listening, setup.Rig.Session.State);
        setup.Controller.ToggleCapture();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Tooltip_and_menu_text_follow_the_state()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();
        Assert.Equal("Questkeeper - not capturing", setup.Controller.ToolTip);
        Assert.Equal("Start capture", setup.Controller.CaptureMenuText);

        var (source, started) = Holding();
        setup.Rig.Source = source;
        var run = setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(Wait);
        Assert.Equal("Questkeeper - waiting for a login", setup.Controller.ToolTip);
        Assert.Equal("Stop capture", setup.Controller.CaptureMenuText);

        setup.Rig.Session.Stop();
        await run.WaitAsync(Wait);
        Assert.Equal("Questkeeper - not capturing", setup.Controller.ToolTip);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Tooltip_counts_the_characters_captured_in_this_session()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();
        var (source, started) = Holding(Connection(clientPort: 50000, name: "First Hero").All);
        setup.Rig.Source = source;
        var run = setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();
        await started.Task.WaitAsync(Wait);
        Assert.Equal("Questkeeper - capturing, 1 character", setup.Controller.ToolTip);
        setup.Rig.Session.Stop();
        await run.WaitAsync(Wait);

        var (second, secondStarted) = Holding(Connection(clientPort: 50001, name: "Second Hero").All);
        setup.Rig.Source = second;
        var again = setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();
        await secondStarted.Task.WaitAsync(Wait);

        Assert.Equal("Questkeeper - capturing, 2 characters", setup.Controller.ToolTip);
        setup.Rig.Session.Stop();
        await again.WaitAsync(Wait);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Tooltip_names_the_states_that_prevent_the_capture()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();
        setup.Rig.Npcap = NpcapStatus.Missing;
        await setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();
        Assert.Equal("Questkeeper - Npcap is not installed", setup.Controller.ToolTip);

        setup.Rig.Npcap = NpcapStatus.Available;
        setup.Rig.Elevation.IsElevated = false;
        await setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();
        Assert.Equal("Questkeeper - needs administrator rights", setup.Controller.ToolTip);

        setup.Rig.Elevation.IsElevated = true;
        setup.Rig.Source = new FakePacketSource((_, _) => Task.FromException(new InvalidOperationException()));
        await setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();
        Assert.Equal("Questkeeper - capture failed", setup.Controller.ToolTip);

        setup.Rig.IsWindows = false;
        await setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();
        Assert.Equal("Questkeeper - capture not available", setup.Controller.ToolTip);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Changed_is_raised_when_the_session_changes()
    {
        var setup = new Setup();
        var raised = 0;
        setup.Controller.Changed += (_, _) => Interlocked.Increment(ref raised);

        await setup.Rig.Session.StartAsync();

        Assert.True(raised > 0);
    }
```

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App;
using AqwCompanion.App.GameData;
using AqwCompanion.App.Shell;
using AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.Headless.XUnit;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Shell;

public class TrayWindowTests
{
    private static MainWindow Create(out ServiceProvider services, out TrayController controller, out FakeApplicationExit exit)
    {
        var paths = new AppPaths(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "aqw-tests", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")));
        services = CompositionRoot.Build(paths);
        var host = services.GetRequiredService<AvaloniaMainWindowHost>();
        exit = new FakeApplicationExit();
        controller = new TrayController(
            services.GetRequiredService<CaptureSession>(), host, exit);
        var window = new MainWindow { DataContext = services.GetRequiredService<MainViewModel>() };
        host.Attach(window);
        window.KeepInTray(controller);
        return window;
    }

    [AvaloniaFact]
    public void Closing_the_window_as_the_user_hides_it_and_keeps_it_alive()
    {
        var window = Create(out var services, out var controller, out _);
        using (services)
        {
            window.Show();
            var closed = false;
            window.Closed += (_, _) => closed = true;

            window.Close();

            Assert.False(window.IsVisible);
            Assert.False(closed);

            controller.Open();
            Assert.True(window.IsVisible);
            Assert.Equal(WindowState.Normal, window.WindowState);
        }
    }

    [AvaloniaFact]
    public async Task After_exit_started_closing_the_window_really_closes_it()
    {
        var window = Create(out var services, out var controller, out var exit);
        using (services)
        {
            window.Show();
            var closed = false;
            window.Closed += (_, _) => closed = true;

            await controller.ExitAsync();
            window.Close();

            Assert.True(closed);
            Assert.Equal(1, exit.ExitCalls);
        }
    }

    [AvaloniaFact]
    public void The_tray_icon_can_be_built_under_the_headless_platform()
    {
        var paths = new AppPaths(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "aqw-tests", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")));
        using var services = CompositionRoot.Build(paths);
        using var setup = new TrayIconSetup(services.GetRequiredService<TrayController>());

        Assert.Equal("Questkeeper - not capturing", setup.Icon.ToolTipText);
        Assert.Equal(5, setup.Icon.Menu!.Items.Count);
    }
}
```

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App;
using AqwCompanion.App.GameData;
using AqwCompanion.Capture;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

/// <summary>A real <see cref="CaptureSession"/> over fakes; change the settings before the first start.</summary>
public sealed class CaptureRig
{
    public FakeProcessElevation Elevation { get; } = new();

    public FakeApplicationExit Exit { get; } = new();

    public FakeGameDataStore Store { get; } = new();

    /// <summary>The wait before live updates are saved; completes at once unless a test sets its Gate.</summary>
    public FakeDelay Delay { get; } = new();

    public NpcapStatus Npcap { get; set; } = NpcapStatus.Available;

    public bool IsWindows { get; set; } = true;

    public FakePacketSource Source { get; set; } = new((_, _) => Task.CompletedTask);

    public CaptureSession Session { get; }

    public CaptureRig() => Session = new CaptureSession(
        () => Source, Elevation, () => Npcap, () => IsWindows, Store, Delay, TimeProvider.System, Exit,
        new AppPaths("/tmp/aqw-fictional-root"));

    /// <summary>A source that hands over the segments and ends at once.</summary>
    public static FakePacketSource Feeding(IEnumerable<TcpSegment> segments) =>
        new((onSegment, _) =>
        {
            foreach (var segment in segments)
            {
                onSegment(segment);
            }

            return Task.CompletedTask;
        });

    public GameDataViewModel CreateViewModel(Action<Action>? onUiThread = null) => new(Session, onUiThread);
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/TestDoubles/FakeDelay.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

/// <summary>Completes at once unless a test sets <see cref="Gate"/> to hold the delay open. Safe to read while a background task asks for delays.</summary>
public sealed class FakeDelay : IDelay
{
    private readonly object _lock = new();
    private readonly List<TimeSpan> _delays = [];

    /// <summary>A copy of the delays asked for so far, in order.</summary>
    public IReadOnlyList<TimeSpan> Delays
    {
        get
        {
            lock (_lock)
            {
                return [.. _delays];
            }
        }
    }

    public TaskCompletionSource? Gate { get; set; }

    public CancellationToken LastToken { get; private set; }

    public Task DelayAsync(TimeSpan delay, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        lock (_lock)
        {
            _delays.Add(delay);
        }

        LastToken = ct;
        return Gate is null ? Task.CompletedTask : Gate.Task.WaitAsync(ct);
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/TestDoubles/FakePacketSource.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Capture;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

/// <summary>A packet source whose run is a delegate; counts its runs and reports <see cref="Text"/> as its diagnostics.</summary>
public sealed class FakePacketSource(Func<Action<TcpSegment>, CancellationToken, Task> run) : IPacketSource, ICaptureDiagnostics
{
    private int _runs;
    private volatile string _text = string.Empty;

    /// <summary>What <see cref="Describe"/> returns; change it at any time.</summary>
    public string Text
    {
        get => _text;
        set => _text = value;
    }

    public string Describe() => _text;

    public int Runs => Volatile.Read(ref _runs);

    public Task RunAsync(Action<TcpSegment> onSegment, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        Interlocked.Increment(ref _runs);
        return run(onSegment, cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/TestDoubles/InMemoryStoredDataStore.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure.Persistence;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Persistence;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

public sealed class InMemoryStoredDataStore : IStoredDataStore
{
    public Dictionary<string, (object Value, DateTimeOffset At)> Items { get; } = [];
    public bool ThrowOnSave { get; set; }
    public bool ThrowOnLoad { get; set; }
    /// <summary>The version each key was saved under; a key put straight into <see cref="Items"/> counts as version 1.</summary>
    public Dictionary<string, int> Versions { get; } = [];
    public bool FailNext { get; set; }
    public int SaveCalls { get; private set; }
    public int ClearCalls { get; private set; }
    public bool ClearResult { get; set; } = true;

    /// <summary>The stored data module over this store, with the real obsolete keys and no failure report.</summary>
    public StoredData Module(Action<string, string>? onFailure = null) => new(this, StoredKeys.Obsolete, onFailure);

    public StoredValue<T>? Load<T>(string key, int version)
    {
        MaybeThrow(ThrowOnLoad);
        return Items.TryGetValue(key, out var item) && item.Value is T value
            && Versions.GetValueOrDefault(key, 1) == version
            ? new StoredValue<T>(value, item.At)
            : null;
    }

    public void Save<T>(string key, int version, T value, DateTimeOffset readAtUtc)
    {
        SaveCalls++;
        MaybeThrow(ThrowOnSave);
        Items[key] = (value!, readAtUtc);
        Versions[key] = version;
    }

    public void Remove(string key)
    {
        MaybeThrow(false);
        Items.Remove(key);
        Versions.Remove(key);
    }

    public bool Clear()
    {
        ClearCalls++;
        MaybeThrow(false);
        Items.Clear();
        Versions.Clear();
        return ClearResult;
    }

    private void MaybeThrow(bool always)
    {
        if (always || FailNext)
        {
            FailNext = false;
            throw new IOException("simulated store failure");
        }
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/TestDoubles/ListLogger.cs`:

```cs
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

public sealed record LogEntry(
    LogLevel Level,
    string Message,
    IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> Properties,
    Exception? Exception);

public sealed class ListLogger<T> : ILogger<T>
{
    public List<LogEntry> Entries { get; } = [];

    public IDisposable? BeginScope<TState>(TState state) where TState : notnull => null;

    public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

    public void Log<TState>(
        LogLevel logLevel,
        EventId eventId,
        TState state,
        Exception? exception,
        Func<TState, Exception?, string> formatter)
    {
        var properties = state is IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, object?>> pairs
            ? pairs.ToDictionary(p => p.Key, p => p.Value)
            : new Dictionary<string, object?>();
        Entries.Add(new LogEntry(logLevel, formatter(state, exception), properties, exception));
    }
}
```

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App;
using AqwCompanion.App.Debug;

using AqwCompanion.App.GameData;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

/// <summary>A <see cref="MainViewModel"/> over a capture rig and fakes, with nothing stored or opened.</summary>
public static class MainViewModelBuilder
{
    public sealed record Built(
        MainViewModel Main, CaptureRig Rig, FakeActiveInventory Inventory, FakeSettingsDialog Dialog, FakeDebugWindowHost DebugHost,
        FakeAppSettingsStore Settings, FakeHardFarmSync Sync);

    public static Built Create(CaptureRig? rig = null, Action<Action>? onUiThread = null)
    {

        var inventory = new FakeActiveInventory();
        var dialog = new FakeSettingsDialog();
        var debugHost = new FakeDebugWindowHost();
        var settingsStore = new FakeAppSettingsStore();

        var settings = new SettingsViewModel(settingsStore, new ForgetCoordinator(() => true, () => []));
        var paths = new AppPaths(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "aqw-tests", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")));
        var main = new MainViewModel(
            new DiagnosticsViewModel(paths, new DiagnosticsExporter(new SnapshotRedactor())),
            new HardFarmsViewModel(new HardFarmStore(new InMemoryStoredDataStore().Module()), sync, inventory, new FakeUrlLauncher()),
            rig.CreateViewModel(onUiThread),
            settings,
            dialog,
            new DebugModeController(settings, debugHost));
        return new Built(main, rig, inventory, dialog, debugHost, settingsStore, sync);
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/TestDoubles/RecordingForgettable.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Forgetting;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

/// <summary>Records each call as "Quiesce:Name", "Resume:Name" or "Forget:Name" in a shared list, and can be told to throw.</summary>
public sealed class RecordingForgettable(string name, List<string> log) : IForgettable
{
    public string Name { get; } = name;

    public bool ThrowOnQuiesce { get; set; }

    public bool ThrowOnResume { get; set; }

    public bool ThrowOnForget { get; set; }

    public void Quiesce()
    {
        log.Add($"Quiesce:{Name}");
        if (ThrowOnQuiesce)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("quiesce failed");
        }
    }

    public void Resume()
    {
        log.Add($"Resume:{Name}");
        if (ThrowOnResume)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("resume failed");
        }
    }

    public void Forget()
    {
        log.Add($"Forget:{Name}");
        if (ThrowOnForget)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("forget failed");
        }
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/TestDoubles/TableRowsTestParser.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

/// <summary>Test-only parser that demonstrates the fixture-driven parsing workflow.</summary>
public sealed partial class TableRowsTestParser : IPageParser<IReadOnlyList<string>>
{
    public string Name => "test-table-rows";
    public string Version => "1";

    public bool CanParse(PageSnapshot snapshot) =>
        snapshot.Url.EndsWith("/Inventory", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    public ParseResult<IReadOnlyList<string>> Parse(PageSnapshot snapshot)
    {
        if (!snapshot.Payload.Contains("id=\"inventoryTable\"", StringComparison.Ordinal))
        {
            return ParseResult<IReadOnlyList<string>>.Failed(
                "inventory table marker missing",
                new ParseDiagnostics(Name, Version, null, ["#inventoryTable"], 0));
        }

        IReadOnlyList<string> names = NameCell().Matches(snapshot.Payload).Select(m => m.Groups[1].Value).ToList();
        var diagnostics = new ParseDiagnostics(Name, Version, "table-rows", [], names.Count);

        return names.Count == 0
            ? ParseResult<IReadOnlyList<string>>.Suspicious(names, "table present but no rows", diagnostics)
            : ParseResult<IReadOnlyList<string>>.Ok(names, diagnostics);
    }

    [GeneratedRegex("""<td class="name">(.*?)</td>""")]
    private static partial Regex NameCell();
}
```

```cs
using Avalonia;
using Avalonia.Controls;
using Avalonia.VisualTree;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

/// <summary>Finds controls by <c>x:Name</c> through the visual tree; every UserControl has its own name scope, so FindControl on an outer view cannot see inside child views.</summary>
public static class VisualTreeFinder
{
    public static T Named<T>(this Visual root, string name) where T : Control =>
        root.GetVisualDescendants().OfType<T>().FirstOrDefault(c => c.Name == name)
        ?? throw new InvalidOperationException($"Control {name} not found in the visual tree");
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/TestDoubles/WikiTestDoubles.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.App.HardFarms;
using AqwCompanion.App.Infrastructure;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

/// <summary>Serves canned pages by slug and records the order of requests (and of pauses, when <see cref="Log"/> is shared).</summary>
public sealed class FakeWikiFetcher : IWikiPageFetcher
{
    public List<string> Log { get; init; } = [];

    public Dictionary<string, string> Pages { get; } = [];

    public Dictionary<string, string> Errors { get; } = [];

    public string Robots { get; set; } = "User-agent: *\nDisallow: /system:\n";

    public string? RobotsError { get; set; }

    public Action<string>? OnFetch { get; set; }

    /// <summary>Scripted answers per slug, used one by one before <see cref="Pages"/> and <see cref="Errors"/> apply again.</summary>
    public Dictionary<string, Queue<PageFetchResult>> Scripts { get; } = [];

    /// <summary>The timeout every page request asked for, in order.</summary>
    public List<(string Slug, TimeSpan? Timeout)> Timeouts { get; } = [];

    /// <summary>Makes the next requests of <paramref name="slug"/> fail like this (once each), then serve the page again.</summary>
    public void Script(string slug, params PageFetchResult[] answers)
    {
        if (!Scripts.TryGetValue(slug, out var queue))
        {
            Scripts[slug] = queue = new Queue<PageFetchResult>();
        }

        foreach (var answer in answers)
        {
            queue.Enqueue(answer);
        }
    }

    public static PageFetchResult Timeout() => PageFetchResult.Failure("The request timed out.", PageFailureKind.Timeout);

    public static PageFetchResult Http(int status) => PageFetchResult.Failure($"The server answered HTTP {status}.", PageFailureKind.Http, status);

    public List<string> Requested => Log.Where(e => e.StartsWith("fetch:", StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(e => e[6..]).ToList();

    public Task<PageFetchResult> FetchRobotsAsync(CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        Log.Add("fetch:robots.txt");
        return Task.FromResult(RobotsError is { } error
            ? PageFetchResult.Failure(error)
            : PageFetchResult.Success(PageSnapshot.Create(WikiUrls.Robots, Robots, "1.0.0", DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch)));
    }

    public Task<PageFetchResult> FetchPageAsync(string url, TimeSpan? timeout = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        var slug = WikiUrls.Slug(url)!;
        Log.Add("fetch:" + slug);
        Timeouts.Add((slug, timeout));
        OnFetch?.Invoke(slug);
        if (Scripts.TryGetValue(slug, out var script) && script.Count > 0)
        {
            return Task.FromResult(script.Dequeue());
        }

        if (Errors.TryGetValue(slug, out var error))
        {
            return Task.FromResult(PageFetchResult.Failure(error));
        }

        return Task.FromResult(Pages.TryGetValue(slug, out var html)
            ? PageFetchResult.Success(PageSnapshot.Create(url, html, "1.0.0", DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch))
            : PageFetchResult.Failure("HTTP 404", PageFailureKind.Http, 404));
    }
}

/// <summary>Writes "delay" into a shared log and completes at once, so no test waits real seconds.</summary>
public sealed class LoggingDelay(List<string> log) : IDelay
{
    public List<TimeSpan> Delays { get; } = [];

    public Task DelayAsync(TimeSpan delay, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
        Delays.Add(delay);
        log.Add("delay");
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

public sealed class FakeUrlLauncher : IUrlLauncher
{
    public List<string> Opened { get; } = [];

    public bool Open(string url)
    {
        Opened.Add(url);
        return true;
    }
}

/// <summary>A sync whose result the test controls; <see cref="Gate"/> holds it open to observe the Updating state.</summary>
public sealed class FakeHardFarmSync : IHardFarmSync
{
    public SyncResult Result { get; set; } = new(SyncStatus.Failed, "not set", []);

    public IReadOnlyList<string> Pending { get; set; } = [.. WikiUrls.TypeIndexSlugs];

    public TaskCompletionSource? Gate { get; set; }

    public Action<SyncProgress>? Progress { get; private set; }

    public Action<SyncUpdate>? Saved { get; private set; }

    public CancellationToken Token { get; private set; }

    public int Calls { get; private set; }

    public bool Throw { get; set; }

    public IReadOnlyList<string> GetPending() => Pending;

    public async Task<SyncResult> RunAsync(Action<SyncProgress>? progress, Action<SyncUpdate>? saved, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        Calls++;
        Progress = progress;
        Saved = saved;
        Token = ct;
        if (Throw)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("boom");
        }

        if (Gate is not null)
        {
            await Gate.Task.ConfigureAwait(false);
        }

        return Result;
    }
}

/// <summary>Hand-written fake wiki HTML shaped like the real pages.</summary>
public static class WikiPages
{
    public static string HardFarm(params (string Group, string[] Slugs)[] groups) =>
        "<html><body><div id=\"page-content\"><p><em>Created by Tester, Revised by Checker</em></p>"
        + string.Concat(groups.Select(g => $"<h1><span>{g.Group}</span></h1>"
            + string.Concat(g.Slugs.Select(s => $"<a href=\"http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/{s}\">http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/{s}</a><br />\n"))))
        + "</div></body></html>";

    public static string Index(params (string Slug, string Name)[] items) =>
        "<html><body><div id=\"page-content\"><div class=\"list-pages-box\">"
        + string.Concat(items.Select(i => $"<div class=\"list-pages-item\"><p><a href=\"/{i.Slug}\">{i.Name}</a></p></div>"))
        + "</div></div></body></html>";

    public static string[] Slugs(string prefix, int count) =>
        Enumerable.Range(1, count).Select(i => $"{prefix}-{i}").ToArray();
}

/// <summary>A clock that only moves when the test (or a fake fetcher) advances it; it also serves as the timestamp source.</summary>
public sealed class ManualClock(DateTimeOffset start) : TimeProvider
{
    private DateTimeOffset _now = start;
    private long _ticks;

    public override long TimestampFrequency => TimeSpan.TicksPerSecond;

    public override DateTimeOffset GetUtcNow() => _now;

    public override long GetTimestamp() => _ticks;

    public void Advance(TimeSpan by)
    {
        _now += by;
        _ticks += by.Ticks;
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Wiki/HardFarmListParserTests.cs`:

```cs
using System.Text;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Wiki;

public class HardFarmListParserTests
{
    private readonly HardFarmListParser _parser = new();

    private static PageSnapshot Snapshot(string html, string url = "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/syfarm") =>
        PageSnapshot.Create(url, html, "1.0.0", DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch);

    private static string Link(string slug) =>
        $"<a href=\"http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/{slug}\">http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/{slug}</a><br />\n";

    private static string Page(string body, string credit = "<p><em>Created by Tester, Revised by Checker</em></p>") =>
        $"<html><body><div id=\"nav\"><a href=\"http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/menu-link\">x</a></div><div id=\"page-content\">\n{credit}\n{body}\n</div><div id=\"footer\"><a href=\"http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/footer-link\">f</a></div></body></html>";

    private static string Section(string heading, int count, string prefix, string tag = "h1") =>
        $"<{tag}><span>{heading}</span></{tag}>\n" + string.Concat(Enumerable.Range(1, count).Select(i => Link($"{prefix}-{i}")));

    [Fact]
    public void Can_parse_only_the_syfarm_page_on_the_wiki()
    {
        Assert.True(_parser.CanParse(Snapshot("")));
        Assert.True(_parser.CanParse(Snapshot("", "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/SyFarm")));
        Assert.False(_parser.CanParse(Snapshot("", "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/classes")));
        Assert.False(_parser.CanParse(Snapshot("", "https://evil.example.com/syfarm")));
        Assert.False(_parser.CanParse(Snapshot("", "http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/syfarm")));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Reads_groups_entries_and_credit_in_page_order()
    {
        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("Nation", 6, "nat") + Section("Legion", 5, "leg"))));

        Assert.Equal(ParseOutcome.Ok, result.Outcome);
        var list = result.Data!;
        Assert.Equal(["Nation", "Legion"], list.Groups.Select(g => g.Name));
        Assert.Equal(["nat-1", "nat-2", "nat-3", "nat-4", "nat-5", "nat-6"], list.Groups[0].Slugs);
        Assert.Equal(5, list.Groups[1].Slugs.Count);
        Assert.Equal(11, list.Count);
        Assert.Equal(new HardFarmEntry("nat-1", "Nation"), list.Entries[0]);
        Assert.Equal(new HardFarmEntry("leg-1", "Legion"), list.Entries[6]);
        Assert.Equal("Created by Tester, Revised by Checker", list.Credit);
        Assert.Equal("headings-and-urls", result.Diagnostics.MatchedStrategy);
        Assert.Equal(11, result.Diagnostics.ItemCount);
        Assert.Empty(result.Diagnostics.MissingMarkers);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Each_url_written_as_href_and_text_counts_once_and_text_only_urls_count_too()
    {
        var body = "<h1>Nation</h1>"
            + Link("a") + Link("b") + Link("a")
            + "<p>http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/c<br />https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/d</p>"
            + string.Concat(Enumerable.Range(1, 8).Select(i => Link($"x{i}")));

        var list = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(body))).Data!;

        Assert.Equal(["a", "b", "c", "d", "x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6", "x7", "x8"], list.Groups[0].Slugs);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_link_whose_text_differs_from_its_href_uses_the_href()
    {
        var body = "<h1>Other</h1><a href=\"http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/real-page\">Some title</a>" + Section("More", 10, "m");

        Assert.Equal("real-page", _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(body))).Data!.Groups[0].Slugs.Single());
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_slug_in_two_groups_is_listed_in_both_but_counted_once_for_the_first_group()
    {
        var body = "<h1>One</h1>" + Link("shared") + Link("a1") + "<h1>Two</h1>" + Link("shared") + Link("b1")
            + Section("Pad", 10, "p");

        var list = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(body))).Data!;

        Assert.Contains("shared", list.Groups[1].Slugs);
        Assert.Equal(1, list.Entries.Count(e => e.Slug == "shared"));
        Assert.Equal("One", list.Entries.Single(e => e.Slug == "shared").Group);
        Assert.Equal(13, list.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Urls_on_other_hosts_and_non_page_links_are_ignored()
    {
        var body = "<h1>Nation</h1>"
            + "<a href=\"https://evil.example.com/steal\">https://evil.example.com/steal</a>"
            + "<a href=\"https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com.evil.example/steal2\">https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com.evil.example/steal2</a>"
            + "<a href=\"/relative-page\">relative</a>"
            + "<a href=\"#top\">top</a><a href=\"http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/a/b\">deep</a>"
            + "<a href=\"http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/forum:thread\">forum</a>"
            + Section("Real", 10, "r").Replace("<h1><span>Real</span></h1>", string.Empty);

        var list = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(body))).Data!;

        Assert.Equal(Enumerable.Range(1, 10).Select(i => $"r-{i}"), list.Groups.Single().Slugs);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("h1")]
    [InlineData("h2")]
    [InlineData("h3")]
    [InlineData("h4")]
    [InlineData("h5")]
    public void Any_heading_level_starts_a_group(string tag)
    {
        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("Daily Quest", 12, "q", tag))));

        Assert.Equal("Daily Quest", result.Data!.Groups.Single().Name);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Entries_before_any_heading_go_to_an_ungrouped_group_and_same_named_headings_merge()
    {
        var body = Link("early") + Section("Other", 5, "o") + Section("Low Drop Rate", 2, "l") + Section("other", 5, "o2");

        var list = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(body))).Data!;

        Assert.Equal([HardFarmListParser.UngroupedName, "Other", "Low Drop Rate"], list.Groups.Select(g => g.Name));
        Assert.Equal(10, list.Groups[1].Slugs.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_heading_without_entries_makes_no_group()
    {
        var list = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page("<h1>Empty</h1>" + Section("Full", 10, "f")))).Data!;

        Assert.Equal(["Full"], list.Groups.Select(g => g.Name));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Links_outside_the_page_content_are_ignored()
    {
        var list = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("Nation", 10, "n")))).Data!;

        Assert.DoesNotContain(list.Entries, e => e.Slug is "menu-link" or "footer-link");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_credit_is_capped_cleaned_and_optional()
    {
        var long_ = "<p><em>Created by " + new string('x', 300) + "</em></p>";
        Assert.Equal(120, _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("N", 10, "n"), long_))).Data!.Credit!.Length);

        Assert.Null(_parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("N", 10, "n"), "<p>Nothing here</p>"))).Data!.Credit);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_short_list_is_suspicious_but_keeps_its_data()
    {
        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("Nation", 9, "n"))));

        Assert.Equal(ParseOutcome.Suspicious, result.Outcome);
        Assert.Equal(9, result.Data!.Count);
        Assert.Equal(9, result.Diagnostics.ItemCount);
        Assert.NotNull(result.Reason);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Exactly_the_minimum_is_ok()
    {
        Assert.Equal(ParseOutcome.Ok, _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("Nation", 10, "n")))).Outcome);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("<html><body><div id=\"page-content\"><h1>Nation</h1><p>No links</p></div></body></html>")]
    [InlineData("<html><body><p>Nothing</p></body></html>")]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData("not html at all \u0000 <<<")]
    public void A_page_without_entries_or_content_fails(string html)
    {
        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(html));

        Assert.Equal(ParseOutcome.Failed, result.Outcome);
        Assert.Null(result.Data);
        Assert.NotEmpty(result.Diagnostics.MissingMarkers);
        Assert.Equal(0, result.Diagnostics.ItemCount);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Does_not_leak_page_text_into_the_diagnostics()
    {
        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot("<div id=\"page-content\">SECRET-TEXT</div>"));

        Assert.DoesNotContain("SECRET-TEXT", result.Reason);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("SECRET-TEXT", string.Join(' ', result.Diagnostics.MissingMarkers));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_large_list_parses()
    {
        var sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (var g = 0; g < 10; g++)
        {
            sb.Append(Section("Group " + g, 300, "g" + g));
        }

        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(sb.ToString())));

        Assert.Equal(3000, result.Data!.Count);
    }

    public static TheoryData<string> HostileSlugs => new()
    {
        "a%3Fb", "a%23b", "a%25b", "a%0D%0Ab", "..", "a/b", "a:b", "a%3Ab", "a%40b", "a%20b", "caf%C3%A9", "%D0%B0bc", "a.b", "-a", "a%2Fb", "a%2E%2E", new string('a', 101),
    };

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(HostileSlugs))]
    public void Entries_with_an_invalid_slug_are_skipped_whether_linked_or_written_as_text(string hostile)
    {
        var body = Section("Nation", 10, "ok")
            + $"<a href=\"http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/{hostile}\">x</a>\n"
            + $"<p>http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/{hostile}</p>\n"
            + Link(hostile);

        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(body)));

        Assert.Equal(ParseOutcome.Ok, result.Outcome);
        Assert.Equal(Enumerable.Range(1, 10).Select(i => $"ok-{i}"), result.Data!.Groups.Single().Slugs);
        Assert.Equal(10, result.Data.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Upper_case_slugs_are_normalised_and_kept()
    {
        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("Nation", 10, "ok") + Link("Void-Highlord"))));

        Assert.Contains("void-highlord", result.Data!.Groups.Single().Slugs);
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Wiki/RobotsTxtTests.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Wiki;

public class RobotsTxtTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData("")]
    [InlineData(null)]
    [InlineData("# only a comment\n")]
    [InlineData("User-agent: *\nDisallow:\n")]
    [InlineData("User-agent: Googlebot\nDisallow: /\n")]
    public void Everything_is_allowed_without_a_matching_rule(string? text)
    {
        var robots = RobotsTxt.Parse(text);

        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/syfarm"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Disallow_is_a_prefix_match()
    {
        var robots = RobotsTxt.Parse("User-agent: *\nDisallow: /admin\nDisallow: /search:\n");

        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/admin"));
        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/admin:manage/x"));
        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/search:site/q/a"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/syfarm"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/adm"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Disallow_slash_blocks_everything()
    {
        var robots = RobotsTxt.Parse("User-agent: *\nDisallow: /\n");

        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/syfarm"));
        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Wildcards_and_the_end_anchor_work()
    {
        var robots = RobotsTxt.Parse("User-agent: *\nDisallow: /*/edit\nDisallow: /*.pdf$\nDisallow: /exact$\n");

        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/page/edit"));
        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/a/b/edit/more"));
        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/file.pdf"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/file.pdf?x=1"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/file.pdfx"));
        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/exact"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/exact/more"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/syfarm"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_longest_rule_wins_and_allow_wins_a_tie()
    {
        var robots = RobotsTxt.Parse("User-agent: *\nDisallow: /private\nAllow: /private/open\nDisallow: /tie\nAllow: /tie\n");

        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/private/closed"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/private/open/page"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/tie"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_exact_agent_group_wins_over_the_star_group()
    {
        var robots = RobotsTxt.Parse("User-agent: *\nDisallow: /\n\nUser-agent: AqwCompanion\nDisallow: /secret\n");

        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/syfarm"));
        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/secret"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void An_agent_group_with_no_rules_allows_everything_even_when_star_blocks()
    {
        var robots = RobotsTxt.Parse("User-agent: *\nDisallow: /\n\nUser-agent: aqwcompanion\nDisallow:\n");

        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/syfarm"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Several_agent_lines_share_one_group_and_comments_and_case_are_tolerated()
    {
        var robots = RobotsTxt.Parse(
            "USER-AGENT: Bingbot\r\nuser-agent: *   # everyone\r\nDISALLOW: /nope # why\r\n\r\nUser-agent: Other\r\nDisallow: /other\r\n");

        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/nope"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/other"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Garbage_lines_are_ignored()
    {
        var robots = RobotsTxt.Parse("<html>nope</html>\n::\nDisallow /x\nSitemap: https://x/y\nUser-agent: *\nDisallow: /z\n");

        Assert.False(robots.IsAllowed("/z"));
        Assert.True(robots.IsAllowed("/x"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void An_empty_path_is_the_root()
    {
        Assert.False(RobotsTxt.Parse("User-agent: *\nDisallow: /\n").IsAllowed(""));
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Wiki/WikiIndexParserTests.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Wiki;

public class WikiIndexParserTests
{
    private readonly WikiIndexParser _parser = new();

    private static PageSnapshot Snapshot(string html, string url = "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/classes") =>
        PageSnapshot.Create(url, html, "1.0.0", DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch);

    private const string Nav =
        "<p><sub><a name=\"top\"></a> Go to <a href=\"#Numbers\">#</a>, <a href=\"#A\">A</a>, <a href=\"#B\">B</a></sub></p>";

    private static string Item(string slug, string name) =>
        $"<div class=\"list-pages-item\">\n<p><a href=\"/{slug}\">{name}</a></p>\n<img src=\"https://aqwwiki.wdfiles.com/x.png\" alt=\"x.png\" /></div>\n";

    private static string Section(string letter, string items) =>
        $"<p><a name=\"{letter}\"></a> <strong>{letter}</strong></p>\n<div class=\"list-pages-box\">{items}</div>\n<div style=\"text-align: right;\"><p><sub><a href=\"#top\">Back to Top</a></sub></p></div>\n";

    private static string Page(string body) =>
        $"<html><body><a href=\"/menu\">Menu</a><div id=\"page-content\">{body}</div><a href=\"/footer\">Footer</a></body></html>";

    [Fact]
    public void Can_parse_only_the_type_indexes_on_the_wiki()
    {
        Assert.True(_parser.CanParse(Snapshot("")));
        Assert.True(_parser.CanParse(Snapshot("", "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/helmets-hoods")));
        Assert.False(_parser.CanParse(Snapshot("", "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/syfarm")));
        Assert.False(_parser.CanParse(Snapshot("", "https://evil.example.com/classes")));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Reads_slug_and_name_pairs_in_page_order_and_skips_the_navigation()
    {
        var body = Nav + Section("A", Item("abyssal-angel-legend", "Abyssal Angel (Legend)") + Item("alpha-class", "Alpha &amp; Omega"))
            + Section("B", Item("berserker", "  Berserker\n"));

        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(body)));

        Assert.Equal(ParseOutcome.Ok, result.Outcome);
        var index = result.Data!;
        Assert.Equal("classes", index.IndexSlug);
        Assert.Equal(WikiType.Class, index.Type);
        Assert.Equal(
            [new WikiIndexEntry("abyssal-angel-legend", "Abyssal Angel (Legend)"), new WikiIndexEntry("alpha-class", "Alpha & Omega"), new WikiIndexEntry("berserker", "Berserker")],
            index.Entries);
        Assert.Equal(3, result.Diagnostics.ItemCount);
        Assert.Equal("list-pages-items", result.Diagnostics.MatchedStrategy);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_type_follows_the_index_page()
    {
        var html = Page(Section("A", Item("x", "X")));

        Assert.Equal(WikiType.Pet, _parser.Parse(Snapshot(html, "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/battle-pets")).Data!.Type);
        Assert.Equal(WikiType.Other, _parser.Parse(Snapshot(html, "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/necklaces")).Data!.Type);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_sort_by_menu_above_the_lists_is_not_an_entry()
    {
        var menu = "<p><sub>Sort by: <a href=\"/sort-by-rare-classes\">Rare</a> - <a href=\"http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/classes-with-no-rank-10-passive\">No Rank 10</a></sub></p>";

        var index = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(menu + Nav + Section("A", Item("a1", "A1"))))).Data!;

        Assert.Equal(["a1"], index.Entries.Select(e => e.Slug));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Without_list_boxes_all_content_anchors_are_used_but_anchors_and_special_links_are_not()
    {
        var body = Nav
            + "<ul><li><a href=\"/axes\">Axes</a></li><li><a href=\"/system:recent-changes\">Recent</a></li>"
            + "<li><a href=\"/forum:start\">Forum</a></li><li><a href=\"#top\">Back to Top</a></li>"
            + "<li><a href=\"https://evil.example.com/x\">Evil</a></li><li><a href=\"/a/b\">Deep</a></li>"
            + "<li><a href=\"/bows\"><img src=\"x.png\" /></a></li><li><a href=\"/back\">Back to Top</a></li>"
            + "<li><a href=\"http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/swords\">Swords</a></li></ul>";

        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(body), "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/weapons"));

        Assert.Equal(["axes", "swords"], result.Data!.Entries.Select(e => e.Slug));
        Assert.Equal("content-anchors", result.Diagnostics.MatchedStrategy);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Duplicate_slugs_keep_the_first_name_and_slugs_are_lower_cased()
    {
        var index = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("A", Item("Dup-Item", "First") + Item("dup-item", "Second"))))).Data!;

        Assert.Equal(new WikiIndexEntry("dup-item", "First"), Assert.Single(index.Entries));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Names_are_cleaned_and_capped()
    {
        var index = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("A", Item("long", new string('n', 500)) + Item("ctl", "Ab\u0007c"))))).Data!;

        Assert.Equal(200, index.Entries[0].Name.Length);
        Assert.Equal("Abc", index.Entries[1].Name);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("<html><body><div id=\"page-content\"><p>Nothing listed</p></div></body></html>")]
    [InlineData("<html><body><a href=\"/menu\">Menu</a></body></html>")]
    [InlineData("<div id=\"page-content\"><a href=\"#A\">A</a></div>")]
    [InlineData("")]
    public void A_page_without_entries_fails(string html)
    {
        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(html));

        Assert.Equal(ParseOutcome.Failed, result.Outcome);
        Assert.Null(result.Data);
        Assert.NotEmpty(result.Diagnostics.MissingMarkers);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void A_large_index_parses()
    {
        var items = string.Concat(Enumerable.Range(0, 3000).Select(i => Item($"item-{i}", $"Item {i}")));

        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("A", items))));

        Assert.Equal(3000, result.Data!.Entries.Count);
    }

    public static TheoryData<string> HostileSlugs => new()
    {
        "a%3Fb", "a%23b", "a%25b", "a%0D%0Ab", "..", "a/b", "a:b", "a%3Ab", "a%40b", "a%20b", "caf%C3%A9", "%D0%B0bc", "a.b", "-a", "a%2Fb", "a%2E%2E", new string('a', 101),
    };

    [Theory]
    [MemberData(nameof(HostileSlugs))]
    public void Entries_with_an_invalid_slug_are_skipped(string hostile)
    {
        var items = Item("good-one", "Good One") + Item(hostile, "Hostile") + Item("good-two", "Good Two");

        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("A", items))));

        Assert.Equal(ParseOutcome.Ok, result.Outcome);
        Assert.Equal(["good-one", "good-two"], result.Data!.Entries.Select(e => e.Slug));
        Assert.Equal(2, result.Diagnostics.ItemCount);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void An_index_whose_only_entries_are_invalid_fails()
    {
        var result = _parser.Parse(Snapshot(Page(Section("A", Item("a%3Fb", "Bad") + Item("a/b", "Deep")))));

        Assert.Equal(ParseOutcome.Failed, result.Outcome);
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Wiki/WikiPageFetcherTests.cs`:

```cs
using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Ingestion;
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;
using AqwCompanion.Tests.TestDoubles;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Wiki;

public class WikiPageFetcherTests
{
    private const string PageUrl = "https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/syfarm";

    private sealed class StubHandler(Func<HttpRequestMessage, HttpResponseMessage> respond) : HttpMessageHandler
    {
        public List<HttpRequestMessage> Requests { get; } = [];

        protected override Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            Requests.Add(request);
            return Task.FromResult(respond(request));
        }
    }

    private sealed class HangingHandler : HttpMessageHandler
    {
        protected override async Task<HttpResponseMessage> SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, cancellationToken);
            return new HttpResponseMessage();
        }
    }

    private static HttpResponseMessage Reply(string body, string mediaType = "text/html", HttpStatusCode status = HttpStatusCode.OK) =>
        new(status) { Content = new StringContent(body, Encoding.UTF8, mediaType) };

    private static HttpResponseMessage Redirect(string to)
    {
        var redirect = new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.Found);
        redirect.Headers.Location = new Uri(to, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute);
        return redirect;
    }

    private static (WikiPageFetcher Fetcher, StubHandler Handler, ListLogger<WikiPageFetcher> Log) Build(
        Func<HttpRequestMessage, HttpResponseMessage> respond)
    {
        var handler = new StubHandler(respond);
        var log = new ListLogger<WikiPageFetcher>();
        return (new WikiPageFetcher(new HttpClient(handler), "1.2.3", log), handler, log);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task An_html_page_is_returned_with_the_identifying_headers_and_nothing_else()
    {
        var (fetcher, handler, _) = Build(_ => Reply("<html/>"));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl);

        Assert.True(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.Equal("<html/>", result.Snapshot!.Payload);
        Assert.Equal(PageUrl, result.Snapshot.Url);
        var request = Assert.Single(handler.Requests);
        Assert.Equal(HttpMethod.Get, request.Method);
        Assert.Equal("AqwCompanion/1.2.3 (read-only personal companion)", request.Headers.UserAgent.ToString());
        Assert.Equal("text/html", request.Headers.Accept.ToString());
        Assert.Null(request.Headers.Authorization);
        Assert.False(request.Headers.Contains("Cookie"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Robots_txt_is_fetched_from_the_fixed_address_and_accepted_as_plain_text()
    {
        var (fetcher, handler, _) = Build(_ => Reply("User-agent: *\n", "text/plain"));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchRobotsAsync();

        Assert.True(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.Equal("User-agent: *\n", result.Snapshot!.Payload);
        var request = Assert.Single(handler.Requests);
        Assert.Equal("https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/robots.txt", request.RequestUri!.AbsoluteUri);
        Assert.Equal("text/plain", request.Headers.Accept.ToString());
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("text/plain")]
    [InlineData("application/json")]
    [InlineData("application/xhtml+xml")]
    public async Task A_page_that_is_not_html_is_refused(string mediaType)
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply("x", mediaType));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl);

        Assert.False(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.NotNull(result.Error);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Robots_txt_served_as_html_is_refused()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply("<html/>", "text/html"));

        Assert.False((await fetcher.FetchRobotsAsync()).IsSuccess);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task An_html_content_type_with_a_charset_is_accepted()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ =>
        {
            var response = Reply("<p/>");
            response.Content.Headers.ContentType = System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue.Parse("text/html; charset=utf-8");
            return response;
        });

        Assert.True((await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl)).IsSuccess);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/syfarm")]
    [InlineData("https://evil.example.com/syfarm")]
    [InlineData("https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com.evil.example/syfarm")]
    [InlineData("https://account.aq.com/Home")]
    [InlineData("https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com:8443/syfarm")]
    [InlineData("https://user:pw@aqwwiki.wikidot.com/syfarm")]
    [InlineData("/syfarm")]
    [InlineData("")]
    public async Task Other_hosts_schemes_and_forms_are_refused_without_a_request(string url)
    {
        var (fetcher, handler, _) = Build(_ => Reply("<html/>"));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(url);

        Assert.False(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.Empty(handler.Requests);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("https://evil.example.com/syfarm")]
    [InlineData("http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/syfarm")]
    [InlineData("https://account.aq.com/Home")]
    public async Task A_redirect_to_a_forbidden_target_is_refused(string target)
    {
        var (fetcher, handler, _) = Build(_ => Redirect(target));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl);

        Assert.False(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.Single(handler.Requests);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Redirects_inside_the_wiki_are_followed_up_to_three_hops()
    {
        var calls = 0;
        var (fetcher, handler, _) = Build(_ => calls++ < 3 ? Redirect("/next" + calls) : Reply("<p/>"));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl);

        Assert.True(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.Equal(4, handler.Requests.Count);
        Assert.Equal("https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/next3", result.Snapshot!.Url);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_fourth_redirect_hop_is_refused()
    {
        var (fetcher, handler, _) = Build(_ => Redirect("/again"));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl);

        Assert.False(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.Equal(4, handler.Requests.Count);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_page_over_the_cap_is_refused_while_one_at_the_cap_is_accepted()
    {
        var (big, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply(new string('x', WikiPageFetcher.MaxBytes + 1)));
        var (exact, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply(new string('x', WikiPageFetcher.MaxBytes)));

        Assert.False((await big.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl)).IsSuccess);
        Assert.True((await exact.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl)).IsSuccess);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void The_limits_are_the_agreed_ones()
    {
        Assert.Equal(8 * 1024 * 1024, WikiPageFetcher.MaxBytes);
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30), WikiPageFetcher.DefaultTimeout);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(HttpStatusCode.NotFound)]
    [InlineData(HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError)]
    [InlineData(HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)]
    public async Task An_http_error_is_a_failure_that_names_the_status(HttpStatusCode status)
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply("nope", status: status));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl);

        Assert.False(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.Contains(((int)status).ToString(), result.Error);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_network_error_is_a_failure_logged_by_exception_type_only()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, log) = Build(_ => throw new HttpRequestException("secret https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/syfarm?q=1"));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl);

        Assert.False(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("secret", result.Error);
        Assert.All(log.Entries, entry => Assert.DoesNotContain("secret", entry.Message));
        Assert.Contains(log.Entries, entry => entry.Message.Contains(nameof(HttpRequestException)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_cancelled_request_is_reported_by_cancellation_not_as_a_failure_result()
    {
        using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
        await cts.CancelAsync();
        var fetcher = new WikiPageFetcher(new HttpClient(new HangingHandler()), "1.0.0", new ListLogger<WikiPageFetcher>());

        await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<OperationCanceledException>(() => fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl, null, cts.Token));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_page_that_does_not_answer_in_time_is_a_timeout_failure_not_a_cancellation()
    {
        var fetcher = new WikiPageFetcher(new HttpClient(new HangingHandler()), "1.0.0", new ListLogger<WikiPageFetcher>());

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl, TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(30));

        Assert.False(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.Timeout, result.Kind);
        Assert.Null(result.HttpStatus);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task The_timeout_is_per_call_and_a_generous_one_lets_a_slow_answer_through()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply("<p/>"));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5));

        Assert.True(result.IsSuccess);
        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.None, result.Kind);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(HttpStatusCode.NotFound)]
    [InlineData(HttpStatusCode.Forbidden)]
    [InlineData(HttpStatusCode.TooManyRequests)]
    [InlineData(HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError)]
    [InlineData(HttpStatusCode.ServiceUnavailable)]
    public async Task A_non_success_answer_is_an_http_failure_with_its_status(HttpStatusCode status)
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply("nope", status: status));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl);

        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.Http, result.Kind);
        Assert.Equal((int)status, result.HttpStatus);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_connection_error_is_a_network_failure()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => throw new HttpRequestException("down"));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl);

        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.Network, result.Kind);
        Assert.Null(result.HttpStatus);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_page_that_is_not_html_is_a_not_html_failure()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply("x", "application/json"));

        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.NotHtml, (await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl)).Kind);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_page_over_the_cap_is_a_too_large_failure()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply(new string('x', WikiPageFetcher.MaxBytes + 1)));

        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.TooLarge, (await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl)).Kind);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/syfarm")]
    [InlineData("https://evil.example.com/syfarm")]
    public async Task A_forbidden_address_is_a_blocked_failure(string url)
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply("<p/>"));

        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.Blocked, (await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(url)).Kind);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_redirect_to_a_forbidden_target_is_a_blocked_failure()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Redirect("https://evil.example.com/x"));

        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.Blocked, (await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl)).Kind);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_redirect_without_a_location_is_an_http_failure_not_a_blocked_one()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => new HttpResponseMessage(HttpStatusCode.Found));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl);

        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.Http, result.Kind);
        Assert.Equal(302, result.HttpStatus);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData("http://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/next")]
    [InlineData("https://other.example.com/next")]
    public async Task A_redirect_to_another_host_or_to_http_stays_blocked(string target)
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Redirect(target));

        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.Blocked, (await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl)).Kind);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(null, 30)]
    [InlineData(0.0, 1)]
    [InlineData(-5.0, 1)]
    [InlineData(0.2, 1)]
    [InlineData(45.0, 45)]
    [InlineData(500.0, 120)]
    public void The_timeout_is_defaulted_and_clamped_between_one_and_120_seconds(double? seconds, double expected)
    {
        var timeout = seconds is { } s ? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(s) : (TimeSpan?)null;

        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(expected), WikiPageFetcher.NormalizeTimeout(timeout));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void An_infinite_timeout_is_clamped_to_the_maximum()
    {
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120), WikiPageFetcher.NormalizeTimeout(Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan));
        Assert.Equal(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120), WikiPageFetcher.NormalizeTimeout(TimeSpan.MaxValue));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task The_failure_log_names_the_kind_and_the_page_but_never_the_query_or_the_content()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, log) = Build(_ => Reply("SECRET-CONTENT", status: HttpStatusCode.ServiceUnavailable));

        await fetcher.FetchPageAsync(PageUrl + "?token=SECRET-QUERY");

        var entry = Assert.Single(log.Entries);
        Assert.Contains("Http", entry.Message);
        Assert.Contains("/syfarm", entry.Message);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("SECRET", entry.Message);
        Assert.DoesNotContain("token", entry.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task A_timeout_is_logged_with_its_kind_and_page()
    {
        var log = new ListLogger<WikiPageFetcher>();
        var fetcher = new WikiPageFetcher(new HttpClient(new HangingHandler()), "1.0.0", log);

        await fetcher.FetchPageAsync("https://aqwwiki.wikidot.com/pets", TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(20));

        Assert.Contains(log.Entries, e => e.Message.Contains("Timeout") && e.Message.Contains("/pets"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Robots_txt_failures_are_classified_too()
    {
        var (fetcher, _, _) = Build(_ => Reply("x", status: HttpStatusCode.NotFound));

        var result = await fetcher.FetchRobotsAsync();

        Assert.Equal(PageFailureKind.Http, result.Kind);
        Assert.Equal(404, result.HttpStatus);
    }
}
```

`tests/AqwCompanion.Tests/Wiki/WikiTypesTests.cs`:

```cs
using AqwCompanion.Core.Wiki;

namespace AqwCompanion.Tests.Wiki;

public class WikiTypesTests
{
    [Theory]
    [InlineData("classes", WikiType.Class)]
    [InlineData("armors", WikiType.Armor)]
    [InlineData("weapons", WikiType.Weapon)]
    [InlineData("helmets-hoods", WikiType.Helm)]
    [InlineData("capes-back-items", WikiType.Cape)]
    [InlineData("pets", WikiType.Pet)]
    [InlineData("battle-pets", WikiType.Pet)]
    [InlineData("houses", WikiType.House)]
    [InlineData("floor-items", WikiType.Other)]
    [InlineData("wall-items", WikiType.Other)]
    [InlineData("misc-items", WikiType.Other)]
    [InlineData("use-items", WikiType.Other)]
    [InlineData("necklaces", WikiType.Other)]
    [InlineData("grounds", WikiType.Other)]
    [InlineData("enhancements", WikiType.Other)]
    public void Each_index_maps_to_its_type(string slug, WikiType expected) =>
        Assert.Equal(expected, WikiTypes.ForIndex(slug));

    [Fact]
    public void Every_fetched_index_has_a_type() =>
        Assert.All(WikiUrls.TypeIndexSlugs, slug => Assert.True(Enum.IsDefined(WikiTypes.ForIndex(slug))));

    [Fact]
    public void The_closed_set_is_in_priority_order() =>
        Assert.Equal(
            [WikiType.Class, WikiType.Armor, WikiType.Weapon, WikiType.Helm, WikiType.Cape, WikiType.Pet, WikiType.House, WikiType.Other],
            Enum.GetValues<WikiType>());

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(WikiType.Other, WikiType.Class, WikiType.Class)]
    [InlineData(WikiType.Class, WikiType.Armor, WikiType.Class)]
    [InlineData(WikiType.Weapon, WikiType.Armor, WikiType.Armor)]
    [InlineData(WikiType.House, WikiType.Pet, WikiType.Pet)]
    [InlineData(WikiType.Other, WikiType.Other, WikiType.Other)]
    public void The_higher_priority_type_wins(WikiType a, WikiType b, WikiType expected) =>
        Assert.Equal(expected, WikiTypes.Prefer(a, b));
}
```
